3.4.s:
.. vedavyāsa uvāca .. ..
evaṃ dvāparasaṃdhyāyā ante sūtena varṇitam ..
sūryacaṃdrānvayākhyānaṃ tanmayā kathitaṃ tava ..1..
3.4.d:
॥ वेदव्यास उवाच ॥ ॥
एवं द्वापरसंध्याया अन्ते सूतेन वर्णितम् ॥
सूर्यचंद्रान्वयाख्यानं तन्मया कथितं तव ॥1॥
3.4.m: Vedavyāsa said: / Thus at the close of the Dvāpara twilight, as narrated by the Sūta, / the story of the solar and lunar lineages has been told to you by me.

3.4.s:
viśālāyāṃ punargatvā vaitālena vinirmitam ..
kathayiṣyati sūtastamitihāsasamuccayam ..2..
3.4.d:
विशालायां पुनर्गत्वा वैतालेन विनिर्मितम् ॥
कथयिष्यति सूतस्तमितिहाससमुच्चयम् ॥2॥
3.4.m: Having gone again to Viśālā, the Sūta / will relate that Itihāsasamuccaya composed by Vetāla.

3.4.s:
tanmayā kathitaṃ sarvaṃ hṛṣīkottamapuṇyadam..
punarvikramabhūpena bhaviṣyati samāhvayaḥ .. 3 ..
3.4.d:
तन्मया कथितं सर्वं हृषीकोत्तमपुण्यदम्॥
पुनर्विक्रमभूपेन भविष्यति समाह्वयः ॥ 3 ॥
3.4.m: All that, yielding religious merit, O best of the senses, has been recounted by me. / Again there will be an assembly with King Vikrama.

3.4.s:
naimiṣāraṇyamāsādya śrāvayiṣyati vai kathām..
punaruktāni yānyeva purāṇāṣṭādaśāni vai .. 4 ..
3.4.d:
नैमिषारण्यमासाद्य श्रावयिष्यति वै कथाम्॥
पुनरुक्तानि यान्येव पुराणाष्टादशानि वै ॥ 4 ॥
3.4.m: Having reached the Naimiṣa forest, he will indeed recite the story. / The eighteen Purāṇas, indeed, which have been repeated,

3.4.s:
tāni copapurāṇāni bhaviṣyaṃti kalau yuge ..
teṣāṃ copapurāṇānāṃ dvādaśādhyāyamuttamam .. 5 ..
3.4.d:
तानि चोपपुराणानि भविष्यंति कलौ युगे ॥
तेषां चोपपुराणानां द्वादशाध्यायमुत्तमम् ॥ 5 ॥
3.4.m: and those Upapurāṇas will come to be in the Kali age. / Of those Upapurāṇas, the excellent twelfth chapter

3.4.s:
sārabhūtaśca kathitaṃ itihāsasamuccayaḥ ..
yaste mayā ca kathito hṛṣīkottama te mudā .. 6 ..
3.4.d:
सारभूतश्च कथितं इतिहाससमुच्चयः ॥
यस्ते मया च कथितो हृषीकोत्तम ते मुदा ॥ 6 ॥
3.4.m: which contains their essence, the Itihāsasamuccaya, / which has gladly been told to you by me, O best of masters of the senses.

3.4.s:
vikramākhyānakālāṃte'vatāraḥ kalayā hareḥ ..
sa ca śaktyāvatāro hi rādhākṛṣṇasya bhūtale .. 7 ..
3.4.d:
विक्रमाख्यानकालांतेऽवतारः कलया हरेः ॥
स च शक्त्यावतारो हि राधाकृष्णस्य भूतले ॥ 7 ॥
3.4.m: At the close of the period of the narrative of Vikrama, there will be an incarnation of Hari by a portion; / and that is indeed an incarnation of power of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa upon the earth.

3.4.s:
tatkathāṃ bhagavānsūto naimiṣāraṇyamāsthitaḥ ..
aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi śrāvayiṣyati vai munīm .. 8 ..
3.4.d:
तत्कथां भगवान्सूतो नैमिषारण्यमास्थितः ॥
अष्टाशीतिसहस्राणि श्रावयिष्यति वै मुनीम् ॥ 8 ॥
3.4.m: The venerable Sūta, staying in the Naimiṣa forest, / will narrate that story to the eighty-eight thousand sages.

3.4.s:
yattanmayā ca kathitaṃ haṣīkottama te mudā ..
punaste śaunakādyāśca kṛtvā snānādikāḥ kriyāḥ .. 9 ..
3.4.d:
यत्तन्मया च कथितं हषीकोत्तम ते मुदा ॥
पुनस्ते शौनकाद्याश्च कृत्वा स्नानादिकाः क्रियाः ॥ 9 ॥
3.4.m: That which has gladly been told to you by me, O best of the senses. / Then Śaunaka and the others, having performed rites such as bathing,

3.4.s:
sūtapārśvaṃ gamiṣyaṃti naimiṣāraṇyavāsinaḥ ..
tatpṛṣṭenaiva sūtena yaduktaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva bhoḥ .. 3.4.1.10 ..
3.4.d:
सूतपार्श्वं गमिष्यंति नैमिषारण्यवासिनः ॥
तत्पृष्टेनैव सूतेन यदुक्तं तच्छृणुष्व भोः ॥ 3.4.1.10 ॥
3.4.m: the dwellers of the Naimiṣa forest will approach the Sūta. / Listen, sir, to what was said by the Sūta when questioned by them!

3.4.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
śrutaṃ kṛṣṇasya caritaṃ bhagavanbhavatoditam ..
idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi rājñāṃ teṣāṃ kramātkulam .. ..11 ..
3.4.d:
॥ ऋषय ऊचुः ॥ ॥
श्रुतं कृष्णस्य चरितं भगवन्भवतोदितम् ॥
इदानीं श्रोतुमिच्छामि राज्ञां तेषां क्रमात्कुलम् ॥ ॥11 ॥
3.4.m: The sages said: / The deeds of Kṛṣṇa spoken by you have been heard, O venerable one; / now I wish to hear in order the lineage of those kings,

3.4.s:
caturṇāṃ vahnijātānāṃ paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ ..
sa haristriyugī proktaḥ kathaṃ jātaḥ kalau yuge .. 12 ..
3.4.d:
चतुर्णां वह्निजातानां परं कौतूहलं हि नः ॥
स हरिस्त्रियुगी प्रोक्तः कथं जातः कलौ युगे ॥ 12 ॥
3.4.m: the four born of fire, for our curiosity is immense. / That Hari is called the one who belongs to the three ages; how was he born in the Kali age?

3.4.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
kathayāmi muniśreṣṭhā yuṣmākaṃ praśnamuttamam ..
agnivaṃśanṛpāṇāṃ ca caritraṃ śṛṇu vistarāt .. 13 ..
3.4.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
कथयामि मुनिश्रेष्ठा युष्माकं प्रश्नमुत्तमम् ॥
अग्निवंशनृपाणां च चरित्रं शृणु विस्तरात् ॥ 13 ॥
3.4.m: The Sūta said: / I shall answer your excellent question, O best of sages; / and hear in detail the deeds of the kings of the fire lineage.

3.4.s:
pramaraśca mahīpālo dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāsthitaḥ ..
ambayā racitāṃ divyāṃ pramarāya purīṃ śubhām .. 14 ..
3.4.d:
प्रमरश्च महीपालो दक्षिणां दिशमास्थितः ॥
अम्बया रचितां दिव्यां प्रमराय पुरीं शुभाम् ॥ 14 ॥
3.4.m: King Pramara occupied the southern direction. / In the divine, auspicious city constructed for Pramara by Ambā,

3.4.s:
nivāsaṃ kṛtavānrājā sāmavedaparo balī ..
ṣaḍvarṣāṇi kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmājjāto mahāmaraḥ .. 15 ..
3.4.d:
निवासं कृतवान्राजा सामवेदपरो बली ॥
षड्वर्षाणि कृतं राज्यं तस्माज्जातो महामरः ॥ 15 ॥
3.4.m: the powerful king, devoted to the Sāmaveda, made his dwelling. / He ruled for six years; from him Mahāmara was born.

3.4.s:
trivarṣaṃ ca kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ devāpistanayo'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ devadūtastato'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ śṛṇu tatkāraṇaṃ mune .. 16 ..
3.4.d:
त्रिवर्षं च कृतं राज्यं देवापिस्तनयोऽभवत् ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं देवदूतस्ततोऽभवत् ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं शृणु तत्कारणं मुने ॥ 16 ॥
3.4.m: He ruled for three years, and Devāpi was his son. / He ruled equal to his father; then came Devadūta. / He ruled equal to his father. Hear the reason for that, O sage:

3.4.s:
aśoke nihate tasminbauddhabhūpe mahābale ..
kalirbhāskaramārādhya tapasā dhyānatatparaḥ .. 17 ..
3.4.d:
अशोके निहते तस्मिन्बौद्धभूपे महाबले ॥
कलिर्भास्करमाराध्य तपसा ध्यानतत्परः ॥ 17 ॥
3.4.m: When that mighty Buddhist king Aśoka was slain, / Kali, absorbed in meditation through asceticism, worshipped the sun.

3.4.s:
paṃcavarṣāntare sūryastasmai ca kalaye mudā ..
śakākhyaṃ nāma puruṣaṃ dadau tadbhaktitoṣitaḥ .. 18 ..
3.4.d:
पंचवर्षान्तरे सूर्यस्तस्मै च कलये मुदा ॥
शकाख्यं नाम पुरुषं ददौ तद्भक्तितोषितः ॥ 18 ॥
3.4.m: After five years, the sun, pleased with his devotion, / gladly gave to that Kali a man named Śaka.

3.4.s:
tadā prasannaḥ sa kaliḥ śakāya ca mahātmane ..
taittiraṃ nagaraṃ premṇā dadau harṣitamānasaḥ ..19..
3.4.d:
तदा प्रसन्नः स कलिः शकाय च महात्मने ॥
तैत्तिरं नगरं प्रेम्णा ददौ हर्षितमानसः ॥19॥
3.4.m: Then, being pleased, with a delighted mind, / that Kali affectionately gave the city of Taittira to the great-souled Śaka.

3.4.s:
tatra gopāndasyugaṇānvaśīkṛtya mahābalī ..
āryadeśavināśāya kṛtvovodyogaṃ punaḥpunaḥ ..
hatavānbhūpatīnbāṇaistasmātte svalpajīvinaḥ .. 3.4.1.20 ..
3.4.d:
तत्र गोपान्दस्युगणान्वशीकृत्य महाबली ॥
आर्यदेशविनाशाय कृत्वोवोद्योगं पुनःपुनः ॥
हतवान्भूपतीन्बाणैस्तस्मात्ते स्वल्पजीविनः ॥ 3.4.1.20 ॥
3.4.m: Having subdued the herdsmen and hordes of robbers there, that powerful one, / making constant efforts to destroy the land of the Āryas, / slew the kings with arrows; therefore they were short-lived.

3.4.s:
gaṃdharvasenaśca nṛpo devadūtātmajo balī ..
śatārddhābdaṃ padaṃ kṛtvā tapase punarāgataḥ .. 21 ..
3.4.d:
गंधर्वसेनश्च नृपो देवदूतात्मजो बली ॥
शतार्द्धाब्दं पदं कृत्वा तपसे पुनरागतः ॥ 21 ॥
3.4.m: And King Gandharvasena, the powerful son of Devadūta, / having held sovereignty for fifty years, retired again for penance.

3.4.s:
śivājñayā ca nṛpatirvikramastanayastataḥ ..
śatavarṣakṛtaṃ rājyaṃ devabhaktastato'bhavat ..
daśavarṣaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ śakairduṣṭairlayaṃ gataḥ .. 22 ..
3.4.d:
शिवाज्ञया च नृपतिर्विक्रमस्तनयस्ततः ॥
शतवर्षकृतं राज्यं देवभक्तस्ततोऽभवत् ॥
दशवर्षं कृतं राज्यं शकैर्दुष्टैर्लयं गतः ॥ 22 ॥
3.4.m: And by Śiva’s command, King Vikrama was then his son. / His reign lasted one hundred years; then came Devabhakta. / He ruled for ten years and met his destruction at the hands of the wicked Śakas.

3.4.s:
śālivāhana evāpi devabhaktasya cātmajaḥ ..
jitvā śakānsa ṣaṣṭyabdaṃ rājyaṃ kṛtvā divaṃ gataḥ .. 23 ..
3.4.d:
शालिवाहन एवापि देवभक्तस्य चात्मजः ॥
जित्वा शकान्स षष्ट्यब्दं राज्यं कृत्वा दिवं गतः ॥ 23 ॥
3.4.m: And Śālivāhana, the son of Devabhakta, / having defeated the Śakas and ruled for sixty years, went to heaven.

3.4.s:
śālihotrastasya suto rājyaṃ kṛtvā śatārddhakam ..
svargalokaṃ tataḥ prāptastatsutaḥ śālivarddhanaḥ ..24..
3.4.d:
शालिहोत्रस्तस्य सुतो राज्यं कृत्वा शतार्द्धकम् ॥
स्वर्गलोकं ततः प्राप्तस्तत्सुतः शालिवर्द्धनः ॥24॥
3.4.m: His son Śālihotra, having ruled for fifty years, / then attained the heavenly world; his son was Śālivardhana.

3.4.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ śakahantā tato'bhavat..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ suhotrastanayo'bhavat .. 25 ..
3.4.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं शकहन्ता ततोऽभवत्॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं सुहोत्रस्तनयोऽभवत् ॥ 25 ॥
3.4.m: He ruled equal to his father; then came Śakahantṛ. / He ruled equal to his father; Suhotra was his son.

3.4.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ havirhotrastato'bhavat..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyamiṃdrapālastato'bhavat .. 26 ..
3.4.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं हविर्होत्रस्ततोऽभवत्॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यमिंद्रपालस्ततोऽभवत् ॥ 26 ॥
3.4.m: He ruled equal to his father; Havirhotra came next. / He ruled equal to his father; then came Indrapāla.

3.4.s:
purīmiṃdrāvatīṃ kṛtvā tatra rājyamakārayat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ mālyavānnāma tatsutaḥ ..
purīṃ mālyavatīṃ kṛtvā pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 27 ..
3.4.d:
पुरीमिंद्रावतीं कृत्वा तत्र राज्यमकारयत् ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं माल्यवान्नाम तत्सुतः ॥
पुरीं माल्यवतीं कृत्वा पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥ 27 ॥
3.4.m: Having founded the city of Indrāvatī, he exercised his rule there. / He ruled equal to his father; his son was named Mālyavat. / Having founded the city of Mālyavatī, he held office equal to his father.

3.4.s:
anāvṛṣṭistataścāsīnmahatī caturabdikā ..
tataḥ kṣudhāturo rājā śvaviṣṭhādhānyagarhitam .. 28 ..
3.4.d:
अनावृष्टिस्ततश्चासीन्महती चतुरब्दिका ॥
ततः क्षुधातुरो राजा श्वविष्ठाधान्यगर्हितम् ॥ 28 ॥
3.4.m: Then there was a great drought lasting four years. / Thereupon the king, tormented by hunger, took grain defiled by dog excrement,

3.4.s:
saṃskṛtya maṃdire rājā śālagrāmāya cārpayat ..
tadā prasanno bhagavānvacanaṃ nabhaseritam .. 29 ..
3.4.d:
संस्कृत्य मंदिरे राजा शालग्रामाय चार्पयत् ॥
तदा प्रसन्नो भगवान्वचनं नभसेरितम् ॥ 29 ॥
3.4.m: cleansed it in the temple, and offered it to the Śālagrāma. / Then the Lord was pleased, and a voice uttered from the sky

3.4.s:
kṛtvā dadau varaṃ tasmai śṛṇu tanmunisattama..
kule yāvannṛpā bhāvyāstava bhūpatisattama..
anāvṛṣṭirna bhavitā tāvatte rāṣṭra uttame..3.4.1.30..
3.4.d:
कृत्वा ददौ वरं तस्मै शृणु तन्मुनिसत्तम॥
कुले यावन्नृपा भाव्यास्तव भूपतिसत्तम॥
अनावृष्टिर्न भविता तावत्ते राष्ट्र उत्तमे॥3.4.1.30॥
3.4.m: spoke, giving a boon to him; hear that, O best of sages: / 'As long as kings shall arise in your family, O best of kings, / so long shall there be no drought in your excellent kingdom!'

3.4.s:
suto mālyavataścāsīcchaṃbhudatto harapriyaḥ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ bhaumarājastato'bhavat..31..
3.4.d:
सुतो माल्यवतश्चासीच्छंभुदत्तो हरप्रियः॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं भौमराजस्ततोऽभवत्॥31॥
3.4.m: And the son of Mālyavat was Śambhudatta, dear to Hara. / He ruled equal to his father; then came Bhaumarāja.

3.4.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ vatsarājastato'bhavat..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ bhojarājastato'bhavat..32..
3.4.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं वत्सराजस्ततोऽभवत्॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं भोजराजस्ततोऽभवत्॥32॥
3.4.m: He ruled equal to his father; then came Vatsarāja. / He ruled equal to his father; then came Bhojarāja.

3.4.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ śaṃbhudattastato'bhavat..
daśahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ bhojarājapitussamam..33 ..
3.4.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं शंभुदत्तस्ततोऽभवत्॥
दशहीनं कृतं राज्यं भोजराजपितुस्समम्॥33 ॥
3.4.m: He ruled equal to his father; then came Śambhudatta. / He ruled for ten [years] less than King Bhojarāja, his father.

3.4.s:
śaṃbhudattasya tanayo biṃdupālastato'bhavat ..
biṃdukhaṇḍaṃ ca rāṣṭraṃ vai kṛtvā sa sukhito'bhavat ..
tena rājyaṃ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ vedavidā mune .. 34 ..
3.4.d:
शंभुदत्तस्य तनयो बिंदुपालस्ततोऽभवत् ॥
बिंदुखण्डं च राष्ट्रं वै कृत्वा स सुखितोऽभवत् ॥
तेन राज्यं पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं वेदविदा मुने ॥ 34 ॥
3.4.m: Then Bindupāla was born as the son of Śambhudatta; / and having established the Bindukhaṇḍa realm, he became happy. / He, knower of the Vedas, ruled equal to his father, O sage.

3.4.s:
biṃdupālasya tanayo rājapālastato'bhavat..
pitustulyakṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmājjāto mahīnaraḥ .. 35 ..
3.4.d:
बिंदुपालस्य तनयो राजपालस्ततोऽभवत्॥
पितुस्तुल्यकृतं राज्यं तस्माज्जातो महीनरः ॥ 35 ॥
3.4.m: Then Rājapāla was born as the son of Bindupāla. / He ruled equal to his father; from him was born Mahīnara.

3.4.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ somavarmā nṛpo'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ kāmavarmā suto'bhavat .. 36 ..
3.4.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं सोमवर्मा नृपोऽभवत् ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं कामवर्मा सुतोऽभवत् ॥ 36 ॥
3.4.m: He ruled equal to his father; King Somavarmā came next. / He ruled equal to his father; his son was Kāmavarmā.

3.4.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ bhūmipālastato'bhavat ..
bhūsarastena khanitaṃ puraṃ tatra śubhaṃ kṛtam .. 37 ..
3.4.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं भूमिपालस्ततोऽभवत् ॥
भूसरस्तेन खनितं पुरं तत्र शुभं कृतम् ॥ 37 ॥
3.4.m: He ruled equal to his father; then came Bhūmipāla. / A lake called Bhūsaras was excavated by him, and an auspicious city was built there.

3.4.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ raṃgapālastato'bhavat ..
bhūmipālastu nṛpatirjitvā bhūpānanekaśaḥ .. 38 ..
3.4.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं रंगपालस्ततोऽभवत् ॥
भूमिपालस्तु नृपतिर्जित्वा भूपाननेकशः ॥ 38 ॥
3.4.m: He ruled equal to his father; then came Raṅgapāla. / But King Bhūmipāla, having defeated numerous kings,

3.4.s:
vīrasiṃhastato nāmnā vikhyāto'bhūnmahītale ..
svarājye raṃgapālaṃ sa cābhiṣicya vanaṃ yayau ..
tapaḥ kṛtvā divaṃ yāto devadevaprasādataḥ .. 39 ..
3.4.d:
वीरसिंहस्ततो नाम्ना विख्यातोऽभून्महीतले ॥
स्वराज्ये रंगपालं स चाभिषिच्य वनं ययौ ॥
तपः कृत्वा दिवं यातो देवदेवप्रसादतः ॥ 39 ॥
3.4.m: Then Vīrasiṃha became famed by name on the surface of the earth. / Having consecrated Raṅgapāla in his own kingdom, he went to the forest. / Having performed asceticism, he went to heaven by the grace of the God of gods.

3.4.s:
kalpasiṃhastato jāto raṃgapālānnṛpottamāt ..
anapatyo hi nṛpatiḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 3.4.1.40 ..
3.4.d:
कल्पसिंहस्ततो जातो रंगपालान्नृपोत्तमात् ॥
अनपत्यो हि नृपतिः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥ 3.4.1.40 ॥
3.4.m: Then Kalpasiṃha was born from Raṅgapāla, that best of kings. / That king, being childless, held his position equal [in duration] to his father's.

3.4.s:
ekadā jāhnavītoye snānārthaṃ mudito yayau ..
dānaṃ dattvā dvijātibhyaḥ kalpakṣetramavāptavān .. 41 ..
3.4.d:
एकदा जाह्नवीतोये स्नानार्थं मुदितो ययौ ॥
दानं दत्त्वा द्विजातिभ्यः कल्पक्षेत्रमवाप्तवान् ॥ 41 ॥
3.4.m: Once he went, delighted, to bathe in the waters of the Jāhnavī. / Having given gifts to the twice-born, he reached Kalpakṣetra.

3.4.s:
puṇyabhūmiṃ samālokya śūnyabhūtāṃ sthalīmapi ..
nagaraṃ kārayāmāsa tatra sthāne mudānvitaḥ .. 42 ..
3.4.d:
पुण्यभूमिं समालोक्य शून्यभूतां स्थलीमपि ॥
नगरं कारयामास तत्र स्थाने मुदान्वितः ॥ 42 ॥
3.4.m: Beholding that holy land, though it was a desolate site, / he gladly caused a city to be built in that place.

3.4.s:
kalāpanagaraṃ nāmnā prasiddhamabhavadbhuvi ..
tatra rājyaṃ kṛtaṃ tena gaṃgāsiṃhastato'bhavat .. 43 ..
3.4.d:
कलापनगरं नाम्ना प्रसिद्धमभवद्भुवि ॥
तत्र राज्यं कृतं तेन गंगासिंहस्ततोऽभवत् ॥ 43 ॥
3.4.m: It became famed on earth by the name Kalāpanagara. / He ruled there; after him came Gaṅgāsiṃha.

3.4.s:
navatyabdavapurbhūtvā so'napatyo raṇaṃ gataḥ ..
tyaktvā prāṇānkurukṣetre svargalokamavāptavān ..
samāptimagamadvipra pramarasya kulaṃ śubham .. 44 ..
3.4.d:
नवत्यब्दवपुर्भूत्वा सोऽनपत्यो रणं गतः ॥
त्यक्त्वा प्राणान्कुरुक्षेत्रे स्वर्गलोकमवाप्तवान् ॥
समाप्तिमगमद्विप्र प्रमरस्य कुलं शुभम् ॥ 44 ॥
3.4.m: Having attained a body of ninety years, he, childless, went to battle. / Giving up his life at Kurukṣetra, he attained heaven. / O twice-born one, the auspicious lineage of Pramara came to an end.

3.4.s:
tadanvaye ca ye śeṣāḥ kṣatriyāstadanaṃtaram ..
tannārīṣvamitovipra babhūva varṇasaṃkaraḥ .. 45 ..
3.4.d:
तदन्वये च ये शेषाः क्षत्रियास्तदनंतरम् ॥
तन्नारीष्वमितोविप्र बभूव वर्णसंकरः ॥ 45 ॥
3.4.m: And the kṣatriyas who remained thereafter in that lineage, / on their women, O twice-born one, boundless mixture of castes occurred.

3.4.s:
vaiśyavṛttikarāḥ sarve mlecchatulyā mahītale ..
iti te kathitaṃ vipra kulaṃ dakṣiṇabhūpateḥ .. 46 ..
3.4.d:
वैश्यवृत्तिकराः सर्वे म्लेच्छतुल्या महीतले ॥
इति ते कथितं विप्र कुलं दक्षिणभूपतेः ॥ 46 ॥
3.4.m: They all follow the livelihood of vaiśyas, equal to mlecchas on the surface of the earth. / Thus has been related to you, O twice-born one, the lineage of the southern king.

3.4.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
vayahānirmahīpālo madhyadeśe svakaṃ padam ..
gṛhītvā brahmaracitamajameramavāsayat .. 1 ..
3.4.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
वयहानिर्महीपालो मध्यदेशे स्वकं पदम् ॥
गृहीत्वा ब्रह्मरचितमजमेरमवासयत् ॥ 1 ॥
3.4.m: Sūta said: / The earth-ruler Vayahāni, taking his own position in the Madhyadeśa, / founded Ajamera, which was fashioned by Brahmā.

3.4.s:
ajasya brahmaṇo mā ca lakṣmīstatra ramā gatā ..
tayā ca nagaraṃ ramyamajameramajaṃ smṛtam .. 2 ..
3.4.d:
अजस्य ब्रह्मणो मा च लक्ष्मीस्तत्र रमा गता ॥
तया च नगरं रम्यमजमेरमजं स्मृतम् ॥ 2 ॥
3.4.m: The "mā" of Aja Brahmā is Lakṣmī; Ramā went there. / By her, that lovely city is remembered as Ajamera, the unborn.

3.4.s:
daśavarṣaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tomarastatsuto'bhavat ..
pārthivaiḥ pūjayāmāsa varṣamātraṃ maheśvaram .. 3 ..
3.4.d:
दशवर्षं कृतं राज्यं तोमरस्तत्सुतोऽभवत् ॥
पार्थिवैः पूजयामास वर्षमात्रं महेश्वरम् ॥ 3 ॥
3.4.m: A reign of ten years was made; his son was Tomara. / He worshipped Maheśvara for merely a year with earthly [emblems].

3.4.s:
iṃdraprasthaṃ dadau tasmai prasanno nagaraṃ śivaḥ ..
tadanvaye ca ye jātāstomarāḥ kṣatriyāḥ smṛtāḥ .. 4 ..
3.4.d:
इंद्रप्रस्थं ददौ तस्मै प्रसन्नो नगरं शिवः ॥
तदन्वये च ये जातास्तोमराः क्षत्रियाः स्मृताः ॥ 4 ॥
3.4.m: Pleased, Śiva gave him the city Indraprastha. / And those born in his lineage are known as the Tomara kṣatriyas.

3.4.s:
tomarāvarajaścaiva cayahānisutaḥ śubhaḥ ..
nāmnā sāmaladevaśca praśrito'bhūnmahītale .. 5 ..
3.4.d:
तोमरावरजश्चैव चयहानिसुतः शुभः ॥
नाम्ना सामलदेवश्च प्रश्रितोऽभून्महीतले ॥ 5 ॥
3.4.m: And the younger brother of Tomara, the auspicious son of Cayahāni, / Sāmaladeva by name, was modest on the surface of the earth.

3.4.s:
saptavarṣaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ mahādevastato'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyamajayaśca tato bhavat .. 6 ..
3.4.d:
सप्तवर्षं कृतं राज्यं महादेवस्ततोऽभवत् ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यमजयश्च ततो भवत् ॥ 6 ॥
3.4.m: A reign of seven years was made; after him was Mahādeva. / A reign equal to his father's was made, and after him was Ajaya.

3.4.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ vīrasiṃhastato'bhavat ..
śatārddhābdaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tato biṃdusuro'bhavat .. 7 ..
3.4.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं वीरसिंहस्ततोऽभवत् ॥
शतार्द्धाब्दं कृतं राज्यं ततो बिंदुसुरोऽभवत् ॥ 7 ॥
3.4.m: A reign equal to his father's was made; after him was Vīrasiṃha. / A reign of half a hundred years was made; after him was Bindusura.

3.4.s:
piturarddhaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ madhyadeśe mahātmanā ..
tasmācca mithunaṃ jātaṃ vīrā vīravihāttakaḥ .. 8 ..
3.4.d:
पितुरर्द्धं कृतं राज्यं मध्यदेशे महात्मना ॥
तस्माच्च मिथुनं जातं वीरा वीरविहात्तकः ॥ 8 ॥
3.4.m: Half [the reign] of his father was made in Madhyadeśa by that great-souled one. / From him a pair was born: Vīrā and Vīravihāttaka.

3.4.s:
vikramāya dadau vīrāṃ pitā vedavidhānataḥ ..
svaputrāya svakaṃ rājyaṃ madhyadeśāntaraṃ mudā .. 9 ..
3.4.d:
विक्रमाय ददौ वीरां पिता वेदविधानतः ॥
स्वपुत्राय स्वकं राज्यं मध्यदेशान्तरं मुदा ॥ 9 ॥
3.4.m: The father gave Vīrā to Vikrama according to the Vedic rite, / and gladly gave his own kingdom within Madhyadeśa to his son.

3.4.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ māṇikyastatsutobhavat ..
śatārddhābdaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ mahāsiṃhastato'bhavat .. 3.4.2.10 ..
3.4.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं माणिक्यस्तत्सुतोभवत् ॥
शतार्द्धाब्दं कृतं राज्यं महासिंहस्ततोऽभवत् ॥ 3.4.2.10 ॥
3.4.m: A reign equal to his father's was made; Māṇikya was his son. / A reign of half a hundred years was made; after him was Mahāsiṃha.

3.4.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ caṃdraguptastato'bhavat..
piturddhaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tatsutaśca pratāpavān .. 11 ..
3.4.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं चंद्रगुप्तस्ततोऽभवत्॥
पितुर्द्धं कृतं राज्यं तत्सुतश्च प्रतापवान् ॥ 11 ॥
3.4.m: A reign equal to his father's was made; after him was Candragupta. / A reign of half [that of] his father was made by his majestic son.

3.4.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ mohanastatsuto'bhavat ..
triṃśadabdaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ śvetarāyastato'bhavat ..12..
3.4.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं मोहनस्तत्सुतोऽभवत् ॥
त्रिंशदब्दं कृतं राज्यं श्वेतरायस्ततोऽभवत् ॥12॥
3.4.m: A reign equal to his father's was made; Mohana was his son. / A reign of thirty years was made; after him was Śvetarāya.

3.4.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ nāgavāhastato'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ lohadhāra'statobhavat .. .. 13 ..
3.4.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं नागवाहस्ततोऽभवत् ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं लोहधारऽस्ततोभवत् ॥ ॥ 13 ॥
3.4.m: A reign equal to his father's was made; after him was Nāgavāha. / A reign equal to his father's was made; after him was Lohadhāra.

3.4.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ vīrasiṃhastato'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ vibudhastatsuto'bhavat .. 14 ..
3.4.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं वीरसिंहस्ततोऽभवत् ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं विबुधस्तत्सुतोऽभवत् ॥ 14 ॥
3.4.m: A reign equal to his father's was made; after him was Vīrasiṃha. / A reign equal to his father's was made; Vibudha was his son.

3.4.s:
śatārddhābdaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ caṃdrarāya statobhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tato hariharo'bhavat ..15..
3.4.d:
शतार्द्धाब्दं कृतं राज्यं चंद्रराय स्ततोभवत् ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं ततो हरिहरोऽभवत् ॥15॥
3.4.m: A reign of half a hundred years was made; after him was Candrarāya. / A reign equal to his father's was made; after him was Harihara.

3.4.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ vasaṃtastasya cātmajaḥ ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ balāṃga stanayo'bhavat .. 16 ..
3.4.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं वसंतस्तस्य चात्मजः ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं बलांग स्तनयोऽभवत् ॥ 16 ॥
3.4.m: A reign equal to his father's was made; Vasanta was his son. / A reign equal to his father's was made; Balāṅga was his son.

3.4.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ pramathastatsuto'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyamaṃgarāyastato'bhavat .. 17 ..
3.4.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं प्रमथस्तत्सुतोऽभवत् ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यमंगरायस्ततोऽभवत् ॥ 17 ॥
3.4.m: A reign equal to his father's was made; Pramatha was his son. / A reign equal to his father's was made; after him was Aṅgarāya.

3.4.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ viśālastasya cātmajaḥ ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ śārṅgadevastato'bhavat .. 18 ..
3.4.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं विशालस्तस्य चात्मजः ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं शार्ङ्गदेवस्ततोऽभवत् ॥ 18 ॥
3.4.m: A reign equal to his father's was made; Viśāla was his son. / A reign equal to his father's was made; after him was Śārṅgadeva.

3.4.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ maṃtradevastato'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ jayasiṃhastato'bhavat ..19..
3.4.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं मंत्रदेवस्ततोऽभवत् ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं जयसिंहस्ततोऽभवत् ॥19॥
3.4.m: A reign equal to his father's was made; after him was Mantradeva. / A reign equal to his father's was made; after him was Jayasiṃha.

3.4.s:
āryadeśāśca sakalā jitāstena mahātmanā ..
taddhanaiḥ kārayāmāsa yajñaṃ bahuphalapradam .. 3.4.2.20 ..
3.4.d:
आर्यदेशाश्च सकला जितास्तेन महात्मना ॥
तद्धनैः कारयामास यज्ञं बहुफलप्रदम् ॥ 3.4.2.20 ॥
3.4.m: All the Aryan lands were conquered by that great-souled one. / With their wealth, he performed a sacrifice yielding great fruit.

3.4.s:
tataścānaṃda devo hi jātaḥ putraḥ śubhānanaḥ ..
śatārddhābdaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ jayasiṃhena dhīmatā .. 21 ..
3.4.d:
ततश्चानंद देवो हि जातः पुत्रः शुभाननः ॥
शतार्द्धाब्दं कृतं राज्यं जयसिंहेन धीमता ॥ 21 ॥
3.4.m: Then indeed a son of auspicious face, Ānandadeva, was born. / A reign of half a hundred years was made by the wise Jayasiṃha.

3.4.s:
tatsutena pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ mahītale ..
someśvarastasya suto mahāśūro babhūva ha .. 22 ..
3.4.d:
तत्सुतेन पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं महीतले ॥
सोमेश्वरस्तस्य सुतो महाशूरो बभूव ह ॥ 22 ॥
3.4.m: A reign equal to his father's was made on the surface of the earth by his son. / His son was Someśvara, who was a great hero.

3.4.s:
anaṃgapālasya suto jyeṣṭhāṃ vai kīrtimālinīm ..
tāmudvāhya vidhānena tasyāṃ putrānajījanat .. 23 ..
3.4.d:
अनंगपालस्य सुतो ज्येष्ठां वै कीर्तिमालिनीम् ॥
तामुद्वाह्य विधानेन तस्यां पुत्रानजीजनत् ॥ 23 ॥
3.4.m: He properly married Kīrtimālinī, the eldest daughter / of the son of Anaṅgapāla, and engendered sons upon her.

3.4.s:
dhuṃdhukāraśca vai jyeṣṭho mathurārāṣṭrasaṃsthitaḥ ..
madhyaḥ kumārākhyasutaḥ pituḥ padasamāsthitaḥ ..24..
3.4.d:
धुंधुकारश्च वै ज्येष्ठो मथुराराष्ट्रसंस्थितः ॥
मध्यः कुमाराख्यसुतः पितुः पदसमास्थितः ॥24॥
3.4.m: Dhundhukāra was the eldest, established in the territory of Mathurā. / The middle son, named Kumāra, occupied his father's position.

3.4.s:
mahīrājastu balavāṃstṛtīyo dehalīpatiḥ ..
sahoddīnasya nṛpatervaśamāpya mṛtiṃ gataḥ .. 25 ..
3.4.d:
महीराजस्तु बलवांस्तृतीयो देहलीपतिः ॥
सहोद्दीनस्य नृपतेर्वशमाप्य मृतिं गतः ॥ 25 ॥
3.4.m: Mahīrāja, the mighty third [son], was the lord of Delhi. / Coming under the power of King Sahoddīna, he went to death.

3.4.s:
capahāneśca sa kulaṃ chāyayitvā divaṃ yayau ..
tasya vaṃśe tu rājanyāsteṣāṃ patnyaḥ piśācakaiḥ ..26..
3.4.d:
चपहानेश्च स कुलं छाययित्वा दिवं ययौ ॥
तस्य वंशे तु राजन्यास्तेषां पत्न्यः पिशाचकैः ॥26॥
3.4.m: Having brought a shadow upon the family of Capahāna, he went to heaven. / The noble women of his lineage, their wives, / were enjoyed by piśāca-like

3.4.s:
mlecchaiśca bhuktavatyastā babhūburvarṇasaṃkarāḥ ..
na vai āryā na vai mlecchā jaṭṭā jātyā ca mehanāḥ .. 27 ..
3.4.d:
म्लेच्छैश्च भुक्तवत्यस्ता बभूबुर्वर्णसंकराः ॥
न वै आर्या न वै म्लेच्छा जट्टा जात्या च मेहनाः ॥ 27 ॥
3.4.m: mlecchas, and became mixed in caste. / They are neither truly Aryans nor truly mlecchas; they are Jāṭs and, by caste, Mehanas.

3.4.s:
mehanā mlecchajātīyā jaṭṭā āryamayāḥ smṛtāḥ ..
kvacitkacicca ye śeṣāḥ kṣatriyāścapahānijāḥ .. 28 ..
3.4.d:
मेहना म्लेच्छजातीया जट्टा आर्यमयाः स्मृताः ॥
क्वचित्कचिच्च ये शेषाः क्षत्रियाश्चपहानिजाः ॥ 28 ॥
3.4.m: The Mehanas are of mleccha caste; the Jāṭs are considered of Aryan nature. / Here and there remain some kṣatriyas born of Capahāna.

3.4.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
śuklavaṃśaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu vipravarāditaḥ ..
yadā kṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ brahma tyaktvā bhūmiṃ svakaṃ padam .. 1 ..
3.4.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
शुक्लवंशं प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणु विप्रवरादितः ॥
यदा कृष्णः स्वयं ब्रह्म त्यक्त्वा भूमिं स्वकं पदम् ॥ 1 ॥
3.4.m: Sūta said: / I shall declare the Śukla dynasty from its beginning; listen, O best of the twice-born! / When Kṛṣṇa, who is Brahmā Himself, leaving the earth and his own realm,

3.4.s:
divyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ ramyaṃ prayayau bhūtale tadā ..
kalerāgamanaṃ jñātvā mlecchapā dvīpamadhyage .. 2 ..
3.4.d:
दिव्यं वृन्दावनं रम्यं प्रययौ भूतले तदा ॥
कलेरागमनं ज्ञात्वा म्लेच्छपा द्वीपमध्यगे ॥ 2 ॥
3.4.m: went to the divine and lovely Vṛndāvana, then, on the surface of the earth, / knowing the arrival of Kali, the mleccha rulers situated in the middle of the continent—

3.4.s:
sthitā dvīpeṣu vai nānā manujā vedatatparāḥ ..
kalinā mitradharmeṇa dūṣitāste babhūvire .. 3 ..
3.4.d:
स्थिता द्वीपेषु वै नाना मनुजा वेदतत्पराः ॥
कलिना मित्रधर्मेण दूषितास्ते बभूविरे ॥ 3 ॥
3.4.m: various men devoted to the Vedas dwelling across the continents / were corrupted by Kali through false friendship.

3.4.s:
aṣṭaṣaṣṭisahasrāṇāṃ varṣāṇāṃ munisattama ..
adyaprabhṛti vai jātaḥ kālaḥ kalisamāgame .. 4 ..
3.4.d:
अष्टषष्टिसहस्राणां वर्षाणां मुनिसत्तम ॥
अद्यप्रभृति वै जातः कालः कलिसमागमे ॥ 4 ॥
3.4.m: O best of sages, sixty-eight thousand / years of time have passed from today at the arrival of Kali.

3.4.s:
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi dvīparājyamacīkarat ..
sa kalirmlecchayā sārdhaṃ sūryapūjanatatparaḥ .. 5 ..
3.4.d:
षष्टिवर्षसहस्राणि द्वीपराज्यमचीकरत् ॥
स कलिर्म्लेच्छया सार्धं सूर्यपूजनतत्परः ॥ 5 ॥
3.4.m: For sixty thousand years he ruled the continents, / that Kali, together with his Mleccha wife, devoted to worshiping the sun.

3.4.s:
tatpaścādbhārate varṣe mlecchayā kalirāyayau ..
dṛṣṭvā tadbhārataṃ varṣaṃ lokapālaiśca pālitam .. 6 ..
3.4.d:
तत्पश्चाद्भारते वर्षे म्लेच्छया कलिराययौ ॥
दृष्ट्वा तद्भारतं वर्षं लोकपालैश्च पालितम् ॥ 6 ॥
3.4.m: Thereafter Kali came to the land of Bhārata with his Mleccha wife. / Seeing that land of Bhārata protected by the world protectors,

3.4.s:
bhayabhītastvarāviṣṭo gandharvāṇāṃ yaśaskaraḥ ..
sa kaliḥ sūryamārādhya samādhistho babhūva ha ..7..
3.4.d:
भयभीतस्त्वराविष्टो गन्धर्वाणां यशस्करः ॥
स कलिः सूर्यमाराध्य समाधिस्थो बभूव ह ॥7॥
3.4.m: terrified and seized with haste, that Kali, who brought fame to the Gandharvas, / worshipped the sun and became absorbed in deep meditation.

3.4.s:
tato varṣaśatābdāṃte saṃtuṣṭo ravirāgataḥ ..
soṃśubhirlokamātapya mahāvṛṣṭimakārayat .. 8 ..
3.4.d:
ततो वर्षशताब्दांते संतुष्टो रविरागतः ॥
सोंशुभिर्लोकमातप्य महावृष्टिमकारयत् ॥ 8 ॥
3.4.m: Then, at the end of a hundred years, the sun was pleased and came. / Scorching the world with his rays, he caused a great downpour of rain.

3.4.s:
caturvarṣasahasrāṇi caturvarṣaśatāni ca ..
vyatītāni muniśreṣṭha cādya prabhṛti saṃlape ..9..
3.4.d:
चतुर्वर्षसहस्राणि चतुर्वर्षशतानि च ॥
व्यतीतानि मुनिश्रेष्ठ चाद्य प्रभृति संलपे ॥9॥
3.4.m: Four thousand and four hundred years / have passed, O best of sages, and starting from today I speak [of this].

3.4.s:
saṃpannaṃ bhārataṃ varṣaṃ tadā jātaṃ samaṃtataḥ ..
nyūhākhyo yavano nāma tena vai pūritaṃ jagat ... ... 3.4.3.10 ..
3.4.d:
संपन्नं भारतं वर्षं तदा जातं समंततः ॥
न्यूहाख्यो यवनो नाम तेन वै पूरितं जगत् ॥॥॥ 3.4.3.10 ॥
3.4.m: Then the land of Bhārata became prosperous on all sides. / There was a Yavana named Nyūha, and by him indeed the world was filled.

3.4.s:
sahasrābdakalau prāpte mahendro devarāṭ svayam ..
kāśyapaṃ preṣayāmāsa brahmāvarte mahottame .. 11 ..
3.4.d:
सहस्राब्दकलौ प्राप्ते महेन्द्रो देवराट् स्वयम् ॥
काश्यपं प्रेषयामास ब्रह्मावर्ते महोत्तमे ॥ 11 ॥
3.4.m: When a thousand years of the Kali age had arrived, Mahendra, the king of the gods himself, / sent Kāśyapa to the most exalted Brahmāvarta.

3.4.s:
āryāvatī devaśaktistatkaraṃ cāgrahīnmudā ..
daśaputrānsamutpādya sa dvijo miśramāgamat .. 12 ..
3.4.d:
आर्यावती देवशक्तिस्तत्करं चाग्रहीन्मुदा ॥
दशपुत्रान्समुत्पाद्य स द्विजो मिश्रमागमत् ॥ 12 ॥
3.4.m: Āryāvatī, divine power [herself], joyfully took his hand [in marriage]. / Having begotten ten sons, that twice-born went to Miśra.

3.4.s:
miśradeśodbhavānmlecchānvaśīkṛtyāyutaṃ mudā ..
svadeśaṃ punarāgatya śiṣyāṃstānsa cakāra ha .. 13 ..
3.4.d:
मिश्रदेशोद्भवान्म्लेच्छान्वशीकृत्यायुतं मुदा ॥
स्वदेशं पुनरागत्य शिष्यांस्तान्स चकार ह ॥ 13 ॥
3.4.m: Having joyfully subdued ten thousand Mlecchas born in the land of Miśra, / he returned again to his own country and made them his disciples.

3.4.s:
naṣṭāyāṃ saptapuryāṃ ca brahmāvartaṃ mahottamam..
sarasvatīdṛṣadvatyormadhyagaṃ tatra cāvasat .. 14 ..
3.4.d:
नष्टायां सप्तपुर्यां च ब्रह्मावर्तं महोत्तमम्॥
सरस्वतीदृषद्वत्योर्मध्यगं तत्र चावसत् ॥ 14 ॥
3.4.m: And when the seven sacred cities were destroyed, he lived there in the most exalted Brahmāvarta, / situated between the Sarasvatī and the Dṛṣadvatī.

3.4.s:
svaputraṃ śuklamāhūya dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ tapodhanam ..
ājñāya raivataṃ śṛṃgaṃ tapase tu punaḥ svayam .. 15 ..
3.4.d:
स्वपुत्रं शुक्लमाहूय द्विजश्रेष्ठं तपोधनम् ॥
आज्ञाय रैवतं शृंगं तपसे तु पुनः स्वयम् ॥ 15 ॥
3.4.m: Having summoned his son Śukla, the best of the twice-born rich in penance, / and directed [him], he himself went again to the Raivata peak for penance.

3.4.s:
navaputrām̐stathā śiṣyānmanudharmaṃ sanātanam ..
śrāvayāmāsa dharmātmā sa rājā manudharmagaḥ .. 16 ..
3.4.d:
नवपुत्राम्̐स्तथा शिष्यान्मनुधर्मं सनातनम् ॥
श्रावयामास धर्मात्मा स राजा मनुधर्मगः ॥ 16 ॥
3.4.m: To his nine sons and likewise to his disciples, that righteous king, / adhering to the duty of Manu, proclaimed the eternal duty of Manu.

3.4.s:
śuklopi raivataṃ prāpya saccidānaṃdavigraham ..
vāsudevaṃ jagannāthaṃ tapasā samatoṣayat .. 17 ..
3.4.d:
शुक्लोपि रैवतं प्राप्य सच्चिदानंदविग्रहम् ॥
वासुदेवं जगन्नाथं तपसा समतोषयत् ॥ 17 ॥
3.4.m: Śukla too, having reached Raivata, satisfied with his penance / Vāsudeva, the Lord of the World, whose embodiment is being, consciousness, and bliss.

3.4.s:
tadā prasanno bhagavāndvāra kānāyako balī ..
kare gṛhītvā taṃ vipraṃ samudrāṃtamupāyayau .. 18 ..
3.4.d:
तदा प्रसन्नो भगवान्द्वार कानायको बली ॥
करे गृहीत्वा तं विप्रं समुद्रांतमुपाययौ ॥ 18 ॥
3.4.m: Then, pleased, the mighty Lord, the leader of Dvārakā, / took that Brahmin by the hand and went to the edge of the ocean.

3.4.s:
dvārakāṃ darśayāmāsa divyaśobhāsamanvitām ..
vyatīte dvisahasrābde kiñcijjāte bhṛgūttama .. 19 ..
3.4.d:
द्वारकां दर्शयामास दिव्यशोभासमन्विताम् ॥
व्यतीते द्विसहस्राब्दे किञ्चिज्जाते भृगूत्तम ॥ 19 ॥
3.4.m: He showed [him] Dvārakā endowed with celestial splendour. / When two thousand years had passed and a little more had begun, O best of the Bhṛgus,

3.4.s:
agnidvāreṇa prayayau sa śuklo'rbudaparvate ..
jitvā bauddhāndvijaiḥ sārdhaṃ tribhiranyaiśca baṃdhubhiḥ .. 3.4.3.20 ..
3.4.d:
अग्निद्वारेण प्रययौ स शुक्लोऽर्बुदपर्वते ॥
जित्वा बौद्धान्द्विजैः सार्धं त्रिभिरन्यैश्च बंधुभिः ॥ 3.4.3.20 ॥
3.4.m: that Śukla set out through the Fire Gate to Mount Arbuda. / Having conquered the Buddhists along with three other Brahmins and his kinsmen,

3.4.s:
dvārakāṃ kārayāmāsa hareśca kṛpayā hi saḥ ..
tatroṣya mudito rājā kṛṣṇadhyānaparobhavat .. 21 ..
3.4.d:
द्वारकां कारयामास हरेश्च कृपया हि सः ॥
तत्रोष्य मुदितो राजा कृष्णध्यानपरोभवत् ॥ 21 ॥
3.4.m: he built Dvārakā by the grace of Hari. / Residing there, delighted, the king was devoted to meditating on Kṛṣṇa.

3.4.s:
paścime bhārate varṣe daśābdaṃ kṛtavānpadam ..
nārāyaṇasya kṛpayā viṣvaksenaḥ suto'bhavat .. 22 ..
3.4.d:
पश्चिमे भारते वर्षे दशाब्दं कृतवान्पदम् ॥
नारायणस्य कृपया विष्वक्सेनः सुतोऽभवत् ॥ 22 ॥
3.4.m: In western Bhārata he established his realm for ten years. / By the grace of Nārāyaṇa, Viṣvaksena became his son.

3.4.s:
viṃśadabdaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ jayasenastato'bhavat ..
triṃśadabdaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ visenastasya cātmajaḥ ... .. 23 ..
3.4.d:
विंशदब्दं कृतं राज्यं जयसेनस्ततोऽभवत् ॥
त्रिंशदब्दं कृतं राज्यं विसेनस्तस्य चात्मजः ॥॥। 23 ॥
3.4.m: He ruled for twenty years; then Jayasena was born. / He ruled for thirty years, and Visena was his son.

3.4.s:
śatārdhābdaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ mithunaṃ tasya cābhavat ..
pramodo modasiṃhaśca vikramāya nijāṃ sutām .. 24 ..
3.4.d:
शतार्धाब्दं कृतं राज्यं मिथुनं तस्य चाभवत् ॥
प्रमोदो मोदसिंहश्च विक्रमाय निजां सुताम् ॥ 24 ॥
3.4.m: He ruled for fifty years, and twins were born to him: / Pramoda and Modasiṃha. And his own daughter to Vikrama

3.4.s:
visenaśca dadau prītyā rāṣṭraṃ putrāya cottamam ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ siṃdhuvarmā suto'bhavat .. 25 ..
3.4.d:
विसेनश्च ददौ प्रीत्या राष्ट्रं पुत्राय चोत्तमम् ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं सिंधुवर्मा सुतोऽभवत् ॥ 25 ॥
3.4.m: Visena gave with affection, and the excellent realm to his son. / He ruled like his father, and Sindhuvarmā became his son.

3.4.s:
siṃdhukūle kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tyaktvā tatpaitṛkaṃ padam ..
siṃdhudeśastato nāmnā prasiddhobhūnmahītale .. 26 ..
3.4.d:
सिंधुकूले कृतं राज्यं त्यक्त्वा तत्पैतृकं पदम् ॥
सिंधुदेशस्ततो नाम्ना प्रसिद्धोभून्महीतले ॥ 26 ॥
3.4.m: Leaving that ancestral domain, he established his kingdom on the bank of the Indus; / hence the land became renowned on earth by the name of the Sindhu country.

3.4.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ rājñā vai siṃdhuvarmaṇā ..
siṃdhudvīpastasya sutaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 27 ..
3.4.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं राज्ञा वै सिंधुवर्मणा ॥
सिंधुद्वीपस्तस्य सुतः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥ 27 ॥
3.4.m: King Sindhuvarmā ruled just like his father. / Sindhudvīpa was his son; he held the throne like his father.

3.4.s:
śrīpatistasya tanayo gautamānvayasaṃbhavām ..
kācchapīṃ mahiṣīṃ prāpya kacchadeśamupāyayau .. 28 ..
3.4.d:
श्रीपतिस्तस्य तनयो गौतमान्वयसंभवाम् ॥
काच्छपीं महिषीं प्राप्य कच्छदेशमुपाययौ ॥ 28 ॥
3.4.m: Śrīpati was his son. Having obtained as his queen Kācchapī, / born of Gautama's lineage, he went to the land of Kaccha.

3.4.s:
pulindānyavanāñjitvā tatra deśamakārayat ..
deśo vai śrīpatirnāmnā siṃdhukūle babhūva ha .. 29 ..
3.4.d:
पुलिन्दान्यवनाञ्जित्वा तत्र देशमकारयत् ॥
देशो वै श्रीपतिर्नाम्ना सिंधुकूले बभूव ह ॥ 29 ॥
3.4.m: Having conquered the Pulindas and Yavanas, he founded a land there. / Indeed, a land named Śrīpati arose on the bank of the Indus.

3.4.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ bhujavarmā tato'bhavat ..
jitvā sa śabarānbhillāṃstatra rāṣṭramakārayat .. .. 3.4.3.30 ..
3.4.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं भुजवर्मा ततोऽभवत् ॥
जित्वा स शबरान्भिल्लांस्तत्र राष्ट्रमकारयत् ॥ ॥ 3.4.3.30 ॥
3.4.m: He ruled like his father; then Bhujavarmā was born. / Having conquered the Śabaras and Bhillas, he created a realm there.

3.4.s:
bhujadeśastato jātaḥ prasiddho'bhūnmahītale ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ raṇavarmā suto'bhavat .. 31 ..
3.4.d:
भुजदेशस्ततो जातः प्रसिद्धोऽभून्महीतले ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं रणवर्मा सुतोऽभवत् ॥ 31 ॥
3.4.m: From that the land of Bhuja arose and became renowned on earth. / He ruled like his father, and Raṇavarmā became his son.

3.4.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ citravarmā suto'bhavat ..
kṛtvā sa citranagarīṃ vanamadhye nṛpottamaḥ .. 32 ..
3.4.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं चित्रवर्मा सुतोऽभवत् ॥
कृत्वा स चित्रनगरीं वनमध्ये नृपोत्तमः ॥ 32 ॥
3.4.m: He ruled like his father, and Citravarmā became his son. / Having built the city of Citranagarī in the midst of the forest, that best of kings

3.4.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ dharmavarmā suto'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ kṛṣṇa varmā suto'bhavat .. 33 ..
3.4.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं धर्मवर्मा सुतोऽभवत् ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं कृष्ण वर्मा सुतोऽभवत् ॥ 33 ॥
3.4.m: ruled like his father, and Dharmavarmā became his son. / He ruled like his father, and Kṛṣṇavarmā became his son.

3.4.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyamudayastatsuto'bhavat ..
kṛtvodayapuraṃ ramyaṃ vanamadhye nṛpottamaḥ .. 34 ..
3.4.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यमुदयस्तत्सुतोऽभवत् ॥
कृत्वोदयपुरं रम्यं वनमध्ये नृपोत्तमः ॥ 34 ॥
3.4.m: He ruled like his father, and Udaya became his son. / Having built lovely Udayapura in the midst of the forest, that best of kings

3.4.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ vāpyakarmā suto'bhavat ..
vāpīkūpataḍāgāni nānāharmyāṇi tena vai .. 35 ..
3.4.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं वाप्यकर्मा सुतोऽभवत् ॥
वापीकूपतडागानि नानाहर्म्याणि तेन वै ॥ 35 ॥
3.4.m: ruled like his father, and Vāpyakarmā became his son. / Step-wells, wells, ponds, and various palaces were by him

3.4.s:
dharmārthe kārayāmāsa dharmātmā sa ca vai puram ..
etasminnantare prāpto balado nāma bhūpatiḥ .. 36 ..
3.4.d:
धर्मार्थे कारयामास धर्मात्मा स च वै पुरम् ॥
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे प्राप्तो बलदो नाम भूपतिः ॥ 36 ॥
3.4.m: built for the sake of dharma, and that righteous one [built] a city. / In the meantime, a king named Balada arrived,

3.4.s:
lakṣasainyayuto vīro mahāmadamate sthitaḥ ..
tena sārdhamabhūyuddhaṃ rājño vai vāpyakarmaṇaḥ .. 37 ..
3.4.d:
लक्षसैन्ययुतो वीरो महामदमते स्थितः ॥
तेन सार्धमभूयुद्धं राज्ञो वै वाप्यकर्मणः ॥ 37 ॥
3.4.m: a hero endowed with an army of a hundred thousand, abiding in the doctrine of Mahāmada. / With him there was a battle of King Vāpyakarmā.

3.4.s:
jitvā paiśācakānmlecchānkṛṣṇotsavamakārayat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ guhilastatsuto'bhavat .. 38 ..
3.4.d:
जित्वा पैशाचकान्म्लेच्छान्कृष्णोत्सवमकारयत् ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं गुहिलस्तत्सुतोऽभवत् ॥ 38 ॥
3.4.m: Having conquered the fiendish Mlecchas, he celebrated the festival of Kṛṣṇa. / He ruled like his father, and Guhila became his son.

3.4.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ kālabhojaḥ suto'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ rāṣṭrapālastato'bhavat .. 39 ..
3.4.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं कालभोजः सुतोऽभवत् ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं राष्ट्रपालस्ततोऽभवत् ॥ 39 ॥
3.4.m: He ruled like his father, and Kālabhoja became his son. / He ruled like his father; then Rāṣṭrapāla was born.

3.4.s:
sa tyaktvā paitṛkaṃ sthānaṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ śaktimāgamat ..
tapasārādhayāmāsa śāradāṃ sarvamaṃgalām .. .. 3.4.3.40 ..
3.4.d:
स त्यक्त्वा पैतृकं स्थानं वैष्णवीं शक्तिमागमत् ॥
तपसाराधयामास शारदां सर्वमंगलाम् ॥ ॥ 3.4.3.40 ॥
3.4.m: Leaving his ancestral place, he took refuge in the Vaiṣṇava power. / Through penance he worshipped Śāradā, all-auspicious.

3.4.s:
prasannā sā tadā devī kārayāmāsa vai purīm ..
mahāvatīṃ mahāramyāṃ maṇidevena rakṣitām .. 41 ..
3.4.d:
प्रसन्ना सा तदा देवी कारयामास वै पुरीम् ॥
महावतीं महारम्यां मणिदेवेन रक्षिताम् ॥ 41 ॥
3.4.m: Then, pleased, the goddess caused a city to be built, / Mahāvatī, most lovely, protected by Maṇideva.

3.4.s:
tatroṣya nṛpatirdhīmāndaśābdaṃ rājyamāptavān ..
tasyobhau tanayau jātau vijayaḥ prajayastathā .. 42 ..
3.4.d:
तत्रोष्य नृपतिर्धीमान्दशाब्दं राज्यमाप्तवान् ॥
तस्योभौ तनयौ जातौ विजयः प्रजयस्तथा ॥ 42 ॥
3.4.m: Residing there, the wise king obtained sovereignty for ten years. / To him were born two sons, Vijaya and Prajaya.

3.4.s:
prajayaḥ pitarau tyaktvā gaṃgākūlamupāyayau ..
dvādaśābdaṃ ca tapasā pūjayāmāsa śāradām .. 43 ..
3.4.d:
प्रजयः पितरौ त्यक्त्वा गंगाकूलमुपाययौ ॥
द्वादशाब्दं च तपसा पूजयामास शारदाम् ॥ 43 ॥
3.4.m: Prajaya, leaving his parents, went to the bank of the Gaṅgā, / and for twelve years he worshipped Śāradā with penance.

3.4.s:
kanyā mūrtimayī devī veṇuvādanatatparā ..
hayamāruhya saṃprāptā vihasyāha mahīpatim .. 44..
3.4.d:
कन्या मूर्तिमयी देवी वेणुवादनतत्परा ॥
हयमारुह्य संप्राप्ता विहस्याह महीपतिम् ॥ 44॥
3.4.m: The goddess, embodied as a maiden, intent on playing the flute, / arrived mounted on a horse and smiling, said to the king:

3.4.s:
kinnimittaṃ bhūpasuta tvayā cārādhitā śivā ..
tatphalaṃ tvaṃ hi tapasā mattaḥ śīghramavāpsyasi .. 45 ..
3.4.d:
किन्निमित्तं भूपसुत त्वया चाराधिता शिवा ॥
तत्फलं त्वं हि तपसा मत्तः शीघ्रमवाप्स्यसि ॥ 45 ॥
3.4.m: ‘For what reason, O prince, have you worshipped Śivā? / By your penance you shall quickly attain that fruit from me.’

3.4.s:
iti śrutvā sa hovāca kumāri madhurasvare ..
navīnaṃ nagaraṃ mahyaṃ kuru devi namostu te .. 46 ..
3.4.d:
इति श्रुत्वा स होवाच कुमारि मधुरस्वरे ॥
नवीनं नगरं मह्यं कुरु देवि नमोस्तु ते ॥ 46 ॥
3.4.m: Having heard this, he said: ‘O maiden of sweet voice, / build a new city for me, O goddess! Homage to you!’

3.4.s:
iti śrutvā tu sā devī dadau tasmai hayaṃ śubham ..
puro bhūtvā vādyakarī dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāgatā .. 47 ..
3.4.d:
इति श्रुत्वा तु सा देवी ददौ तस्मै हयं शुभम् ॥
पुरो भूत्वा वाद्यकरी दक्षिणां दिशमागता ॥ 47 ॥
3.4.m: Having heard this, the goddess gave him an auspicious horse. / Going before him playing an instrument, she went toward the southern direction.

3.4.s:
sa bhūpo hayamāruhya netra ācchādya cāyayau ..
punaḥ sa bhūpatiḥ paścātpaścimāṃ diśamāgatā .. 48 ..
3.4.d:
स भूपो हयमारुह्य नेत्र आच्छाद्य चाययौ ॥
पुनः स भूपतिः पश्चात्पश्चिमां दिशमागता ॥ 48 ॥
3.4.m: Mounting the horse and covering his eyes, the king followed. / Then, behind that king, she went toward the western direction.

3.4.s:
tatonuprayayau pūrvamarkaṇo yatra pakṣirāṭ ..
bhayabhīto nṛpastena samunmīlya sa cakṣuṣī .. 49 ..
3.4.d:
ततोनुप्रययौ पूर्वमर्कणो यत्र पक्षिराट् ॥
भयभीतो नृपस्तेन समुन्मील्य स चक्षुषी ॥ 49 ॥
3.4.m: Then he followed toward the east, where Arkaṇa, the king of birds, [dwelt]. / Filled with terror, the king opened both his eyes.

3.4.s:
dadarśa nagaraṃ ramyaṃ kanyāyā racitaṃ śubham ..
uttare tasya vai gaṃgā dakṣiṇenāsa pāṇḍurā .. 3.4.3.50 ..
3.4.d:
ददर्श नगरं रम्यं कन्याया रचितं शुभम् ॥
उत्तरे तस्य वै गंगा दक्षिणेनास पाण्डुरा ॥ 3.4.3.50 ॥
3.4.m: He beheld a charming, auspicious city fashioned by the maiden. / To its north was the Gaṅgā, and to its south flowed the Pāṇḍurā.

3.4.s:
paścime īśasaritā pūrve pakṣī sa markaṇaḥ ..
kubjabhūtamabhūdgrāmaṃ kānyakubja iti smṛtaḥ .. 51 ..
3.4.d:
पश्चिमे ईशसरिता पूर्वे पक्षी स मर्कणः ॥
कुब्जभूतमभूद्ग्रामं कान्यकुब्ज इति स्मृतः ॥ 51 ॥
3.4.m: To the west was the Īśasarit river, and to the east was that bird Arkaṇa. / The village became curved; hence it is known as Kānyakubja.

3.4.s:
daśavarṣaṃ ca tenaiva jayapālena vai padam ..
kṛtaṃ tasya suto jāto veṇuvādyācca veṇukaḥ .. 52 ..
3.4.d:
दशवर्षं च तेनैव जयपालेन वै पदम् ॥
कृतं तस्य सुतो जातो वेणुवाद्याच्च वेणुकः ॥ 52 ॥
3.4.m: For ten years that very Jayapāla exercised his rule. / His son was born, Veṇuka, called after the flute-music.

3.4.s:
sa veṇuśca mahīpālo devīdattāṃ manoharām ..
patnīṃ kanyāvatīṃ nāmnā samudvāhya rarāja ha .. 53 ..
3.4.d:
स वेणुश्च महीपालो देवीदत्तां मनोहराम् ॥
पत्नीं कन्यावतीं नाम्ना समुद्वाह्य रराज ह ॥ 53 ॥
3.4.m: And King Veṇu shone, having married the charming wife / named Kanyāvatī, who had been bestowed by the Goddess.

3.4.s:
tasyāṃ sapta sutā jātā mātṝṇāṃ maṃgalāḥ kalāḥ ..
śītalā pārvatī kanyā tathā puṣpavatī smṛtā .. 54 ..
3.4.d:
तस्यां सप्त सुता जाता मातॄणां मंगलाः कलाः ॥
शीतला पार्वती कन्या तथा पुष्पवती स्मृता ॥ 54 ॥
3.4.m: From her were born seven daughters, the auspicious portions of the Mothers: / known as Śītalā, Pārvatī, Kanyā, and likewise Puṣpavatī,

3.4.s:
govardhanī ca siṃdūrā kālī nāmnā prakīrtitā ..
brāhmī māheśvarī caiva kaumārī vaiṣṇavī tathā .. 55 ..
3.4.d:
गोवर्धनी च सिंदूरा काली नाम्ना प्रकीर्तिता ॥
ब्राह्मी माहेश्वरी चैव कौमारी वैष्णवी तथा ॥ 55 ॥
3.4.m: and Govardhanī, Siṃdūrā, and celebrated by the name Kālī. / They became, in succession, Brāhmī, Māheśvarī, Kaumārī, Vaiṣṇavī,

3.4.s:
vārāhī ca tathendrāṇī cāmuṇḍāḥ kramato'bhavan..
ekadā bhūpateḥ patnī taṃtunā mṛttikāghaṭam .. .. 56 ..
3.4.d:
वाराही च तथेन्द्राणी चामुण्डाः क्रमतोऽभवन्॥
एकदा भूपतेः पत्नी तंतुना मृत्तिकाघटम् ॥ ॥ 56 ॥
3.4.m: Vārāhī, and likewise Indrāṇī and Cāmuṇḍā. / Once, the king's wife, with a thread, [lowered] an earthen jar

3.4.s:
kūpe kṛtavatī premṇā yathā pūrvaṃ tathādya sā ..
dadarśa bahulā nārīrnānābhūṣaṇabhūṣitāḥ .. 57 ..
3.4.d:
कूपे कृतवती प्रेम्णा यथा पूर्वं तथाद्य सा ॥
ददर्श बहुला नारीर्नानाभूषणभूषिताः ॥ 57 ॥
3.4.m: into a well with love, just as before, so today. / She beheld numerous women adorned with various ornaments.

3.4.s:
svayamekaiva vasanā manoglānimupāyayau ..
tadaiva sa ghaṭo bhūmau na prāptaḥ sapravṛttikām .. 58 ..
3.4.d:
स्वयमेकैव वसना मनोग्लानिमुपाययौ ॥
तदैव स घटो भूमौ न प्राप्तः सप्रवृत्तिकाम् ॥ 58 ॥
3.4.m: Wearing only a single garment herself, she fell into dejection of mind. / Right then, that jar did not reach the ground in its proper state.

3.4.s:
dṛṣṭvā kanyāvatī devī ghaṭahīnā gṛhaṃ yayau ..
tadā tu saptakanyāśca śilābhūtā gṛhe sthitāḥ .. 59 ..
3.4.d:
दृष्ट्वा कन्यावती देवी घटहीना गृहं ययौ ॥
तदा तु सप्तकन्याश्च शिलाभूता गृहे स्थिताः ॥ 59 ॥
3.4.m: Seeing this, Queen Kanyāvatī went home without the jar. / At that time, the seven maidens stood in the house, turned to stone.

3.4.s:
śrutvā veṇustadāgatya bhartsayitvā svakāṃ priyām ..
brahmacaryavrataṃ tyaktvā ramayāmāsa yoṣitam .. 3.4.3.60 ..
3.4.d:
श्रुत्वा वेणुस्तदागत्य भर्त्सयित्वा स्वकां प्रियाम् ॥
ब्रह्मचर्यव्रतं त्यक्त्वा रमयामास योषितम् ॥ 3.4.3.60 ॥
3.4.m: Hearing this, Veṇu came there, rebuked his beloved, / abandoned his vow of celibacy, and took pleasure with the woman.

3.4.s:
nṛpādvai vīravatyāṃ ca yaśovigraha ātmajaḥ ..
babhūva balavāndharmī cāryadeśapatiḥ svayam .. 61 ..
3.4.d:
नृपाद्वै वीरवत्यां च यशोविग्रह आत्मजः ॥
बभूव बलवान्धर्मी चार्यदेशपतिः स्वयम् ॥ 61 ॥
3.4.m: From the king and Vīravatī was born a son, Yaśovigraha, / mighty, righteous, and lord of the Ārya country in his own right.

3.4.s:
viṃśadvarṣaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tena rājñā mahītale ..
mahīcaṃdrastasya sutaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 62 ..
3.4.d:
विंशद्वर्षं कृतं राज्यं तेन राज्ञा महीतले ॥
महीचंद्रस्तस्य सुतः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥ 62 ॥
3.4.m: For twenty years did that king rule upon the earth. / His son was Mahīcandra; he held office equal to his father.

3.4.s:
caṃdradevastasya suto rājyaṃ tena pituḥ samam ..
kṛtaṃ tasmātsuto jāto maṃdapālo mahīpatiḥ .. 63 ..
3.4.d:
चंद्रदेवस्तस्य सुतो राज्यं तेन पितुः समम् ॥
कृतं तस्मात्सुतो जातो मंदपालो महीपतिः ॥ 63 ॥
3.4.m: His son was Candradeva; he ruled for a time equal to his father. / From him a son was born, King Mandapāla.

3.4.s:
tasya bhūpasya samaye sarve bhūpāḥ samantataḥ ..
tyaktvā taṃ maṃdapālaṃ ca taddatte saṃsthitā gṛhe .. 64 ..
3.4.d:
तस्य भूपस्य समये सर्वे भूपाः समन्ततः ॥
त्यक्त्वा तं मंदपालं च तद्दत्ते संस्थिता गृहे ॥ 64 ॥
3.4.m: In the time of that king, all the kings around / abandoned that Mandapāla and stayed in the dwelling granted by him.

3.4.s:
piturarddhaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ kumbhapālastato 'bhavat ..
rājanīyā ca nagarī piśācaviṣaye sthitā .. 65 ..
3.4.d:
पितुरर्द्धं कृतं राज्यं कुम्भपालस्ततो ऽभवत् ॥
राजनीया च नगरी पिशाचविषये स्थिता ॥ 65 ॥
3.4.m: He ruled for half his father's term; thereafter came Kumbhapāla. / Now, the city Rājanīyā was situated in the Piśāca country.

3.4.s:
tatpatiśca mahāmodo mlecchapaiśācadharmagaḥ ..
sa jitvā bahudhā deśām̐lluṃṭhayitvā dhanaṃ bahu .. 66 ..
3.4.d:
तत्पतिश्च महामोदो म्लेच्छपैशाचधर्मगः ॥
स जित्वा बहुधा देशाम्̐ल्लुंठयित्वा धनं बहु ॥ 66 ॥
3.4.m: Its ruler was Mahāmoda, given to the ways of the Mlecchas and Piśācas. / Having conquered the lands in many ways and plundered much wealth,

3.4.s:
mlecchadharmakaraḥ prāptaḥ kumbhapālo yataḥ sthitaḥ ..
kumbhapālastu taṃ dṛṣṭvā kalinā nirmitaṃ nṛpa .. 67 ..
3.4.d:
म्लेच्छधर्मकरः प्राप्तः कुम्भपालो यतः स्थितः ॥
कुम्भपालस्तु तं दृष्ट्वा कलिना निर्मितं नृप ॥ 67 ॥
3.4.m: he who practiced the customs of the Mlecchas arrived where Kumbhapāla stayed. / Seeing him fashioned by Kali, O king,

3.4.s:
mahāmodaṃ samāgamya praṇanāma sa buddhimān ..
tadā mlecchapatiḥ śūro dattvā tasmai dhanaṃ bahu .. 68 ..
3.4.d:
महामोदं समागम्य प्रणनाम स बुद्धिमान् ॥
तदा म्लेच्छपतिः शूरो दत्त्वा तस्मै धनं बहु ॥ 68 ॥
3.4.m: the wise Kumbhapāla approached Mahāmoda and bowed down. / Then the valiant Mleccha lord, having given him much wealth,

3.4.s:
rājanīyāṃ ca nagarīṃ prāptavānmūrtikhaṃḍakam ..
viṃśadabdaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ kuṃbhapālena dhīmatā .. 69 ..
3.4.d:
राजनीयां च नगरीं प्राप्तवान्मूर्तिखंडकम् ॥
विंशदब्दं कृतं राज्यं कुंभपालेन धीमता ॥ 69 ॥
3.4.m: and the city Rājanīyā, gained the fragment of an idol. / For twenty years the wise Kumbhapāla ruled.

3.4.s:
tatputro devapālaścānaṃgabhūpasya kanyakām ..
samudvāhya vidhānena caṃdrakāṃtiṃ tayā saha .. 3.4.3.70 ...
3.4.d:
तत्पुत्रो देवपालश्चानंगभूपस्य कन्यकाम् ॥
समुद्वाह्य विधानेन चंद्रकांतिं तया सह ॥ 3.4.3.70 ॥।
3.4.m: His son Devapāla married according to rite the maiden / Candrakānti, the daughter of King Anaṅga. Together with her,

3.4.s:
kānyakubjagṛhaṃ prāpya jitvā bhūpānanekaśaḥ ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasyobhau tanayau smṛtau .. 71..
3.4.d:
कान्यकुब्जगृहं प्राप्य जित्वा भूपाननेकशः ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं तस्योभौ तनयौ स्मृतौ ॥ 71॥
3.4.m: having obtained the realm of Kānyakubja and conquered many kings, / he ruled for a term equal to his father. Two sons are remembered of him:

3.4.s:
jayacaṃdro ratnabhānurdiśaṃ pūrvāṃ tathottarām ..
āryadeśasya vai jitvā vaiṣṇavo rājyamāptavān..72..
3.4.d:
जयचंद्रो रत्नभानुर्दिशं पूर्वां तथोत्तराम् ॥
आर्यदेशस्य वै जित्वा वैष्णवो राज्यमाप्तवान्॥72॥
3.4.m: Jayacandra and Ratnabhānu. Having conquered the eastern and northern / quarters of the Ārya country, the Vaiṣṇava [king] obtained the kingdom.

3.4.s:
ratnabhānośca tanayo lakṣaṇo nāma viśrutaḥ ..
kurukṣetre raṇaṃ prāpya tyaktvā prāṇāndivaṃ gataḥ..73..
3.4.d:
रत्नभानोश्च तनयो लक्षणो नाम विश्रुतः ॥
कुरुक्षेत्रे रणं प्राप्य त्यक्त्वा प्राणान्दिवं गतः॥73॥
3.4.m: Ratnabhānu's son was famous by the name Lakṣaṇa. / Having joined battle at Kurukṣetra, he gave up his life and went to heaven.

3.4.s:
samāptimagamadvaṃśo vaiśyapālasya dhīmataḥ ..
kuṃbhapālasya śauklasya vaiśyānāṃ rakṣakasya ca ..74..
3.4.d:
समाप्तिमगमद्वंशो वैश्यपालस्य धीमतः ॥
कुंभपालस्य शौक्लस्य वैश्यानां रक्षकस्य च ॥74॥
3.4.m: The lineage of the wise Vaiśyapāla came to an end, / of Kumbhapāla the Śaukla, the protector of the Vaiśyas.

3.4.s:
viṣvaksenānvaye jātā viṣvaksenā(viśvaknenā?) nṛpāḥ smṛtāḥ..
visenasya kule jātā visenāḥ kṣatriyāḥ smṛtāḥ .. 75 ..
3.4.d:
विष्वक्सेनान्वये जाता विष्वक्सेना(विश्वक्नेना?) नृपाः स्मृताः॥
विसेनस्य कुले जाता विसेनाः क्षत्रियाः स्मृताः ॥ 75 ॥
3.4.m: Born in the lineage of Viṣvaksena, kings are remembered as Viṣvaksenas; / born in the family of Visena, kṣatriyas are remembered as Visenas.

3.4.s:
guhilasya kule jātā gauhilāḥ kṣatriyā hi te ..
rāṣṭrapālānvaye jātā rāṣṭrapālā nṛpāḥ smṛtāḥ .. 76 ..
3.4.d:
गुहिलस्य कुले जाता गौहिलाः क्षत्रिया हि ते ॥
राष्ट्रपालान्वये जाता राष्ट्रपाला नृपाः स्मृताः ॥ 76 ॥
3.4.m: Those born in the family of Guhila are indeed Gauhila kṣatriyas; / born in the lineage of Rāṣṭrapāla, kings are remembered as Rāṣṭrapālas.

3.4.s:
vaiśyapālasya vai vaṃśe kuṃbhapālasya dhīmataḥ ..
vaiśyapālāśca rājanyā babhūburbahudhā hi te .. 77 ..
3.4.d:
वैश्यपालस्य वै वंशे कुंभपालस्य धीमतः ॥
वैश्यपालाश्च राजन्या बभूबुर्बहुधा हि ते ॥ 77 ॥
3.4.m: In the lineage of Vaiśyapāla, the wise Kumbhapāla, / there arose many Vaiśyapāla warriors.

3.4.s:
lakṣaṇe maraṇaṃ prāpte śukla vaṃśadhuraṃdhure ..
sarve te kṣatriyā mukhyāḥ kurukṣetre layaṃ gatāḥ .. 78 ..
3.4.d:
लक्षणे मरणं प्राप्ते शुक्ल वंशधुरंधुरे ॥
सर्वे ते क्षत्रिया मुख्याः कुरुक्षेत्रे लयं गताः ॥ 78 ॥
3.4.m: When Lakṣaṇa met his death, the bearer of the yoke of the Śukla lineage, / all those foremost kṣatriyas met their destruction at Kurukṣetra.

3.4.s:
śeṣāstu kṣudrabhūpālā varṇasaṃkarasaṃbhavāḥ ..
mlecchaiśca dūṣitā jātā mleccharājye bhayānake .. 79 .. ..
3.4.d:
शेषास्तु क्षुद्रभूपाला वर्णसंकरसंभवाः ॥
म्लेच्छैश्च दूषिता जाता म्लेच्छराज्ये भयानके ॥ 79 ॥ ॥
3.4.m: The remaining petty kings, born of the mixture of castes, / became corrupted by the Mlecchas in the dread Mleccha kingdom.

3.4.s:
..sūta uvāca .. ..
bhṛguvarya śṛṇu tvaṃ vai vaṃśaṃ pariharasya ca ..
jitvā bauddhānpariharo'tharvavedaparāyaṇaḥ .. 1 ..
3.4.d:
॥सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
भृगुवर्य शृणु त्वं वै वंशं परिहरस्य च ॥
जित्वा बौद्धान्परिहरोऽथर्ववेदपरायणः ॥ 1 ॥
3.4.m: Sūta said: / O best of the Bhṛgus, hear the lineage of Parihara. / Having conquered the Buddhists, Parihara, devoted to the Atharvaveda,

3.4.s:
śaktiṃ sarvamayīṃ nityāṃ dhyātvā premaparo'bhavat ..
prasannā sā tadā devī sārdhayojanamāyatam .. 2 ..
3.4.d:
शक्तिं सर्वमयीं नित्यां ध्यात्वा प्रेमपरोऽभवत् ॥
प्रसन्ना सा तदा देवी सार्धयोजनमायतम् ॥ 2 ॥
3.4.m: meditated on the eternal, all-pervading Śakti and became filled with devotion. / Pleased then, that goddess made a city on Mount Citrakūṭa,

3.4.s:
nagaraṃ citrakūṭādrau cakāra kalinirjaram ..
kaliryatra bhavedbaddho nagare'sminsurapriye .. 3 ..
3.4.d:
नगरं चित्रकूटाद्रौ चकार कलिनिर्जरम् ॥
कलिर्यत्र भवेद्बद्धो नगरेऽस्मिन्सुरप्रिये ॥ 3 ॥
3.4.m: one and a half yojanas in extent, which defeated Kali. / Because Kali would be bound in this city dear to the gods,

3.4.s:
ataḥ kaliṃjaro nāmnā prasiddho'bhūnmahītale ..
dvādaśābdaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tena pūrvapradeśake .. 4 ..
3.4.d:
अतः कलिंजरो नाम्ना प्रसिद्धोऽभून्महीतले ॥
द्वादशाब्दं कृतं राज्यं तेन पूर्वप्रदेशके ॥ 4 ॥
3.4.m: it became famed by the name Kaliñjara on the earth. / For twelve years he exercised rule in the eastern region.

3.4.s:
gauravarmā tasya sutaḥ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ pituḥ samam ..
svānujaṃ ghoravarmāṇaṃ tatrāsthāpya mudānvitaḥ .. 5 ..
3.4.d:
गौरवर्मा तस्य सुतः कृतं राज्यं पितुः समम् ॥
स्वानुजं घोरवर्माणं तत्रास्थाप्य मुदान्वितः ॥ 5 ॥
3.4.m: His son was Gauravarmā; he ruled for a period equal to his father. / Having installed his younger brother Ghoravarmā there, full of joy,

3.4.s:
gauḍadeśaṃ samāgamya tatra rājyamakārayat ..
suparṇo nāma nṛpatistato'bhūdgauravarmaṇaḥ .. 6 ..
3.4.d:
गौडदेशं समागम्य तत्र राज्यमकारयत् ॥
सुपर्णो नाम नृपतिस्ततोऽभूद्गौरवर्मणः ॥ 6 ॥
3.4.m: he went to the Gauḍa country and ruled there. / From Gauravarmā there arose a king named Suparṇa.

3.4.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ rūpaṇastatsuto'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ kāravarmā suto'bhavat ..7..
3.4.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं रूपणस्तत्सुतोऽभवत् ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं कारवर्मा सुतोऽभवत् ॥7॥
3.4.m: He ruled for a period equal to his father; his son was Rūpaṇa. / He ruled for a period equal to his father; his son was Kāravarmā.

3.4.s:
śako nāma tato rājā mahālakṣmīṃ sanātanīm ..
trivarṣāṃte ca sā devī kāmākṣīrūpadhāriṇī .. 8 ..
3.4.d:
शको नाम ततो राजा महालक्ष्मीं सनातनीम् ॥
त्रिवर्षांते च सा देवी कामाक्षीरूपधारिणी ॥ 8 ॥
3.4.m: Then there was a king named Śaka. [He worshipped] eternal Mahālakṣmī; / and at the end of three years, that goddess, assuming the form of Kāmākṣī,

3.4.s:
svabhaktapālanā caiva tatra vāsamakārayat ..
śatārddhābdaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tena vai kāmavarmaṇā .. 9 ..
3.4.d:
स्वभक्तपालना चैव तत्र वासमकारयत् ॥
शतार्द्धाब्दं कृतं राज्यं तेन वै कामवर्मणा ॥ 9 ॥
3.4.m: made her dwelling there in order to protect her devotee. / For half a century that Kāmavarmā exercised rule.

3.4.s:
mithunaṃ janayāmāsa bhogo bhogavatī hi sā ..
vikramāyaiva nṛpatiḥ sutāṃ bhogavatīṃ dadau .. .. 3.4.4.10 ..
3.4.d:
मिथुनं जनयामास भोगो भोगवती हि सा ॥
विक्रमायैव नृपतिः सुतां भोगवतीं ददौ ॥ ॥ 3.4.4.10 ॥
3.4.m: He begot a pair of twins: Bhoga and Bhogavatī. / The king gave his daughter Bhogavatī to Vikrama,

3.4.s:
svarājyaṃ ca svaputrāya pradadau bhogavarmaṇe ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ kālivarmā suto'vat .. 11 ..
3.4.d:
स्वराज्यं च स्वपुत्राय प्रददौ भोगवर्मणे ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं कालिवर्मा सुतोऽवत् ॥ 11 ॥
3.4.m: and bestowed his own kingdom on his son Bhogavarmā. / He ruled for a period equal to his father; his son was Kālivarmā.

3.4.s:
mahotsavaṃ mahākālyāḥ kṛtavānsa ca bhūpatiḥ ..
tasmai prasannā varadā kālī bhūtvā svayaṃ sthitā .. 12..
3.4.d:
महोत्सवं महाकाल्याः कृतवान्स च भूपतिः ॥
तस्मै प्रसन्ना वरदा काली भूत्वा स्वयं स्थिता ॥ 12॥
3.4.m: And that king performed a great festival for Mahākālī. / Pleased with him, Kālī stood there in person to grant a boon.

3.4.s:
kalikā bahupuṣpāṇāṃ sā cakāra svaharṣataḥ ..
tābhirbhavaṃ ca nagaraṃ saṃjātaṃ ca manoharam .. 13 ..
3.4.d:
कलिका बहुपुष्पाणां सा चकार स्वहर्षतः ॥
ताभिर्भवं च नगरं संजातं च मनोहरम् ॥ 13 ॥
3.4.m: Out of her joy she made a bud of many flowers. / From those arose a charming city,

3.4.s:
kalikātā purī nāmnā prasiddhābhūnmahītale ..
kauśikastasya tanayaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 14 ..
3.4.d:
कलिकाता पुरी नाम्ना प्रसिद्धाभून्महीतले ॥
कौशिकस्तस्य तनयः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥ 14 ॥
3.4.m: known on the surface of the earth by the name Kalikātā. / His son was Kauśika, who held a position equal to his father's.

3.4.s:
kātyāyanastasya sutaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..
tasya putro hemavataḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 15 ..
3.4.d:
कात्यायनस्तस्य सुतः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥
तस्य पुत्रो हेमवतः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥ 15 ॥
3.4.m: His son was Kātyāyana, who held a position equal to his father's. / His son was Hemavata, who held a position equal to his father's.

3.4.s:
śivavarmā ca tatputraḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..
bhavavarmā ca tatputraḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 16 ..
3.4.d:
शिववर्मा च तत्पुत्रः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥
भववर्मा च तत्पुत्रः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥ 16 ॥
3.4.m: And his son was Śivavarmā, who held a position equal to his father's. / And his son was Bhavavarmā, who held a position equal to his father's.

3.4.s:
rudravarmā ca tatputraḥ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ pituḥ samam ..
bhojavarmā ca tatputrastyaktvā vai paitṛkaṃ padam .. 17 ..
3.4.d:
रुद्रवर्मा च तत्पुत्रः कृतं राज्यं पितुः समम् ॥
भोजवर्मा च तत्पुत्रस्त्यक्त्वा वै पैतृकं पदम् ॥ 17 ॥
3.4.m: And his son was Rudravarmā, who ruled equal to his father. / And abandoning his ancestral position, his son Bhojavarmā

3.4.s:
bhojarāṣṭraṃ vanoddeśe kārayāmāsa vīryavān ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ gavavarmā nṛpobhavat ..18..
3.4.d:
भोजराष्ट्रं वनोद्देशे कारयामास वीर्यवान् ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं गववर्मा नृपोभवत् ॥18॥
3.4.m: valorous, established the realm of Bhoja in a forested region. / Gavavarmā became king, who ruled equal to his father.

3.4.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ viṃdhyavarmā nṛpo'bhavat ..
svānujāya svakaṃ rājyaṃ dattvā vaṃgamupāyayau .. 19 ..
3.4.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं विंध्यवर्मा नृपोऽभवत् ॥
स्वानुजाय स्वकं राज्यं दत्त्वा वंगमुपाययौ ॥ 19 ॥
3.4.m: Vindhyavarmā became king, who ruled equal to his father; / having given his kingdom to his younger brother, he departed for Vaṅga.

3.4.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ sukhasenastato'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ balākastasya cātmajaḥ .. 3.4.4.20 ..
3.4.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं सुखसेनस्ततोऽभवत् ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं बलाकस्तस्य चात्मजः ॥ 3.4.4.20 ॥
3.4.m: Then came Sukhasena, who ruled equal to his father. / And his son was Balāka, who ruled equal to his father.

3.4.s:
daśavarṣaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ lakṣmaṇastatsuto'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ mādhavastatsuto'bhavat .. 21 ..
3.4.d:
दशवर्षं कृतं राज्यं लक्ष्मणस्तत्सुतोऽभवत् ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं माधवस्तत्सुतोऽभवत् ॥ 21 ॥
3.4.m: Lakṣmaṇa, his son, ruled for ten years. / His son Mādhava ruled equal to his father.

3.4.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ veśavastatsuto' bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ surasenastato'bhavat .. 22 ..
3.4.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं वेशवस्तत्सुतो' भवत् ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं सुरसेनस्ततोऽभवत् ॥ 22 ॥
3.4.m: His son Veśava ruled equal to his father. / Then came Surasena, who ruled equal to his father.

3.4.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tato nārāyaṇo'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ śāṃtivarmā sutobhavat .. 23 ..
3.4.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं ततो नारायणोऽभवत् ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं शांतिवर्मा सुतोभवत् ॥ 23 ॥
3.4.m: Then came Nārāyaṇa, who ruled equal to his father. / His son Śāntivarmā ruled equal to his father.

3.4.s:
gaṃgākūle śāṃtipuraṃ racitaṃ tena dhīmatā ..
nivāsaṃ kṛtavānbhūpaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 24 ..
3.4.d:
गंगाकूले शांतिपुरं रचितं तेन धीमता ॥
निवासं कृतवान्भूपः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥ 24 ॥
3.4.m: That wise king built Śāntipura on the bank of the Gaṅgā. / Taking up residence there, the king held a position equal to his father's.

3.4.s:
nadīvarmā tasya suto gaṃgādattavaro balī ..
cakāra nagarīṃ ramyāṃ nadīhāṃ gauḍarāṣṭragām .. 25 ..
3.4.d:
नदीवर्मा तस्य सुतो गंगादत्तवरो बली ॥
चकार नगरीं रम्यां नदीहां गौडराष्ट्रगाम् ॥ 25 ॥
3.4.m: His son Nadīvarmā was mighty, having received a boon from the Gaṅgā. / He founded the delightful city of Nadīhā situated in the realm of Gauḍa.

3.4.s:
gaṃgayā ca tadāhūtobhijño vidyādharaḥ svayam..
tenaiva rakṣitā cāsītpurī vedaparāyaṇā .. 26 ..
3.4.d:
गंगया च तदाहूतोभिज्ञो विद्याधरः स्वयम्॥
तेनैव रक्षिता चासीत्पुरी वेदपरायणा ॥ 26 ॥
3.4.m: And a wise Vidyādhara was summoned in person by the Gaṅgā; / by him alone was that city, devoted to the Veda, protected.

3.4.s:
viṃśadvarṣaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tena rājñā mahātmanā ..
gaṃgāvaṃśastato jāto viśruto'bhūnmahītale .. 27 ..
3.4.d:
विंशद्वर्षं कृतं राज्यं तेन राज्ञा महात्मना ॥
गंगावंशस्ततो जातो विश्रुतोऽभून्महीतले ॥ 27 ॥
3.4.m: A reign of twenty years was held by that noble-minded king. / From him arose the Gaṅgā dynasty, celebrated across the earth.

3.4.s:
śārṅgadevastasya suto balavānharipūjakaḥ ..
gauḍadeśamupāgamya haridhyānaparobhavat .. 28 ..
3.4.d:
शार्ङ्गदेवस्तस्य सुतो बलवान्हरिपूजकः ॥
गौडदेशमुपागम्य हरिध्यानपरोभवत् ॥ 28 ॥
3.4.m: His son Śārṅgadeva was powerful and a worshipper of Hari; / having arrived in the Gauḍa region, he became devoted to meditating on Hari.

3.4.s:
daśavarṣaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ gaṃgādevastu tatsutaḥ ..
viṃśadvarṣaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ cānaṃgastasya bhūpatiḥ .. 29 ..
3.4.d:
दशवर्षं कृतं राज्यं गंगादेवस्तु तत्सुतः ॥
विंशद्वर्षं कृतं राज्यं चानंगस्तस्य भूपतिः ॥ 29 ॥
3.4.m: His son was Gaṅgādeva, who ruled for ten years; / and his [son], the king Anaṅga, ruled for twenty years.

3.4.s:
tanayo balavāṃścāsīdgauḍadeśamahīpatiḥ ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājya tato rājeśvaro'bhavat .. 3.4.4.30 ..
3.4.d:
तनयो बलवांश्चासीद्गौडदेशमहीपतिः ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्य ततो राजेश्वरोऽभवत् ॥ 3.4.4.30 ॥
3.4.m: His son was powerful, a ruler over the Gauḍa region. / Then came Rājeśvara, who ruled equal to his father.

3.4.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ nṛsiṃha stanayo'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ kalivarmā suto'bhavat .. 31 ..
3.4.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं नृसिंह स्तनयोऽभवत् ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं कलिवर्मा सुतोऽभवत् ॥ 31 ॥
3.4.m: His son was Nṛsiṃha, who ruled equal to his father. / His son Kalivarmā ruled equal to his father.

3.4.s:
rāṣṭradeśamupāgamya jitvā tasya nṛpaṃ balī ..
mahāvatīṃ purīṃ ramyāmadhyāsya sukhito'bhavat .. 32 ..
3.4.d:
राष्ट्रदेशमुपागम्य जित्वा तस्य नृपं बली ॥
महावतीं पुरीं रम्यामध्यास्य सुखितोऽभवत् ॥ 32 ॥
3.4.m: Coming to the Rāṣṭra region, that mighty one conquered its king / and, settling in the delightful city of Mahāvatī, lived happily.

3.4.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ dhṛtivarmā suto'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasya putro mahīpatiḥ .. 33 ..
3.4.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं धृतिवर्मा सुतोऽभवत् ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं तस्य पुत्रो महीपतिः ॥ 33 ॥
3.4.m: His son Dhṛtivarmā ruled equal to his father. / His son Mahīpati ruled equal to his father.

3.4.s:
jayacaṃdrājñayā bhūpa urvīmāyāmiti smṛtām ..
nagarīṃ kārayāmāsa tatra vāsamakārayat .. 34 ..
3.4.d:
जयचंद्राज्ञया भूप उर्वीमायामिति स्मृताम् ॥
नगरीं कारयामास तत्र वासमकारयत् ॥ 34 ॥
3.4.m: By order of Jayacandra, the king built a city / known as Urvīmāyā and took up residence there.

3.4.s:
kurukṣetre hatāḥ sarve kṣatriyāścaṃdravaṃśinaḥ ..
tadā mahīpatī rājā mahāvatyadhipo'bhavat .. 35 ..
3.4.d:
कुरुक्षेत्रे हताः सर्वे क्षत्रियाश्चंद्रवंशिनः ॥
तदा महीपती राजा महावत्यधिपोऽभवत् ॥ 35 ॥
3.4.m: When all the kṣatriyas of the lunar race were slain at Kurukṣetra, / king Mahīpati then became ruler of Mahāvatī.

3.4.s:
viṃśadvarṣaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ sahoddīnena vai tataḥ ..
kurukṣetre mṛtiṃ prāptāḥ suyodhanakalāṃśakāḥ .. 36 ..
3.4.d:
विंशद्वर्षं कृतं राज्यं सहोद्दीनेन वै ततः ॥
कुरुक्षेत्रे मृतिं प्राप्ताः सुयोधनकलांशकाः ॥ 36 ॥
3.4.m: Then, having ruled for twenty years along with Sahoddīna, / those who were portions of the essence of Suyodhana met death at Kurukṣetra.

3.4.s:
ghoravarmā tu nṛpatiḥ sutaḥ pariharasya vai..
kaliṃjare kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ śārdūlastatsuto'bhavat.. 37 ..
3.4.d:
घोरवर्मा तु नृपतिः सुतः परिहरस्य वै॥
कलिंजरे कृतं राज्यं शार्दूलस्तत्सुतोऽभवत्॥ 37 ॥
3.4.m: King Ghoravarmā, the son of Parihara, / ruled at Kaliñjara; his son was Śārdūla.

3.4.s:
tadanvaye ca ye bhūpāḥ śārdūlīyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ..
bhūpānāṃ bahudhā rāṣṭraṃ śārdūlānvayasaṃbhavam..38..
3.4.d:
तदन्वये च ये भूपाः शार्दूलीयाः प्रकीर्तिताः ॥
भूपानां बहुधा राष्ट्रं शार्दूलान्वयसंभवम्॥38॥
3.4.m: And the kings in his lineage are celebrated as the Śārdūlīyas. / Through the lineage of Śārdūla, a kingdom was formed in manifold ways for kings

3.4.s:
babhūva sarvato bhūmau mahāmāyāprasādataḥ ..
iti te kathitaṃ vipra pāvakīyamahībhujām..39..
3.4.d:
बभूव सर्वतो भूमौ महामायाप्रसादतः ॥
इति ते कथितं विप्र पावकीयमहीभुजाम्॥39॥
3.4.m: everywhere on earth, by the grace of Mahāmāyā. / Thus have I told you, O brahmin, of the kings born of fire,

3.4.s:
kulaṃ sakalapāpaghnaṃ yathaiva śaśisūryayoḥ ..
punaranyatpravakṣyāmi yathā jātaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ ..3.4.4.40..
3.4.d:
कुलं सकलपापघ्नं यथैव शशिसूर्ययोः ॥
पुनरन्यत्प्रवक्ष्यामि यथा जातः स्वयं हरिः ॥3.4.4.40॥
3.4.m: a lineage that destroys all sin, just like those of the Moon and the Sun. / Next I shall relate another matter: how Hari himself was born.

3.4.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
madhyāhnakāle saṃprāpte brahmaṇo'vyaktajanmanaḥ ..
cākṣuṣāṃtaramevāpi mahāvāyurbabhūva ha .. 1 ..
3.4.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
मध्याह्नकाले संप्राप्ते ब्रह्मणोऽव्यक्तजन्मनः ॥
चाक्षुषांतरमेवापि महावायुर्बभूव ह ॥ 1 ॥
3.4.m: Sūta said: / When the midday time of Brahmā, whose birth is unmanifest, arrived, / right at the transitional deluge of Cākṣuṣa Manu, a great wind arose.

3.4.s:
tatprabhāvena hemādriḥ kaṃpamānaḥ punaḥpunaḥ..
yathā vṛkṣastathaivāsau tatkaṃpādeva maṃḍalaḥ ..2..
3.4.d:
तत्प्रभावेन हेमाद्रिः कंपमानः पुनःपुनः॥
यथा वृक्षस्तथैवासौ तत्कंपादेव मंडलः ॥2॥
3.4.m: Through its force the Golden Mountain trembled repeatedly; / and from that trembling, its orb shook just like a tree.

3.4.s:
nabhaso bhūtale prāptastadā bhūmiḥ prakaṃpitā ..
babhūva muniśārdūla sarvalokavināśinī .. 3..
3.4.d:
नभसो भूतले प्राप्तस्तदा भूमिः प्रकंपिता ॥
बभूव मुनिशार्दूल सर्वलोकविनाशिनी ॥ 3॥
3.4.m: It fell from the sky onto the surface of the earth; then the earth shook, / O tiger among sages, bringing destruction to all the worlds.

3.4.s:
saptadvīpāḥ samudrāśca jalabhūtā babhūvire ..
lokālokastadā śeṣo'bhavatsottaraparvataḥ .. 4 ..
3.4.d:
सप्तद्वीपाः समुद्राश्च जलभूता बभूविरे ॥
लोकालोकस्तदा शेषोऽभवत्सोत्तरपर्वतः ॥ 4 ॥
3.4.m: The seven continents and the oceans were turned entirely to water; / then the Lokāloka mountain alone remained, together with the Northern Mountain.

3.4.s:
śeṣā bhūmirlayaṃ prāptā manvaṃtare laye ..
sahasrābdāṃtare bhūmirbabhūva jalamadhyagā.. .. 5 ..
3.4.d:
शेषा भूमिर्लयं प्राप्ता मन्वंतरे लये ॥
सहस्राब्दांतरे भूमिर्बभूव जलमध्यगा॥ ॥ 5 ॥
3.4.m: The rest of the earth dissolved in the dissolution between the Manvantaras; / for an interval of a thousand years the earth lay in the midst of the waters.

3.4.s:
tadā sa bhagavānviṣṇurbhavena vidhinā saha ..
śaiśumāraṃ śubhaṃ cakraṃ cakāra nabhasi sthitam .. 6 ..
3.4.d:
तदा स भगवान्विष्णुर्भवेन विधिना सह ॥
शैशुमारं शुभं चक्रं चकार नभसि स्थितम् ॥ 6 ॥
3.4.m: Then the blessed Viṣṇu, together with Bhava and the Creator, / fashioned the auspicious Śaiśumāra system situated in the sky.

3.4.s:
gṛhītvā sakalāstārā grahānsarvānyathāvidhi ..
sthāpayāmāsa bhagavānyathāyogyaṃ pitāmahaḥ ..7..
3.4.d:
गृहीत्वा सकलास्तारा ग्रहान्सर्वान्यथाविधि ॥
स्थापयामास भगवान्यथायोग्यं पितामहः ॥7॥
3.4.m: Taking all the stars and all the planets according to rule, / the blessed Grandfather installed them each in its proper place.

3.4.s:
punarvai jyotiṣāṃ cakraiḥ śoṣitā sakalā mahī ..
sthalībhūyāyutābdānte dṛśyamānā babhūva ha .. 8 ..
3.4.d:
पुनर्वै ज्योतिषां चक्रैः शोषिता सकला मही ॥
स्थलीभूयायुताब्दान्ते दृश्यमाना बभूव ह ॥ 8 ॥
3.4.m: Then the entire earth was dried by the spheres of celestial lights; / having turned dry at the end of ten thousand years, it became visible.

3.4.s:
tadā sa bhagavānbrahmā mukhātsomaṃ cakāra ha ..
dvijarājaṃ mahāprājñaṃ sarvavedaviśāradam .. 9 ..
3.4.d:
तदा स भगवान्ब्रह्मा मुखात्सोमं चकार ह ॥
द्विजराजं महाप्राज्ञं सर्ववेदविशारदम् ॥ 9 ॥
3.4.m: Then the blessed Brahmā produced Soma from his mouth, / the king of the twice-born, deeply wise and versed in all the Vedas.

3.4.s:
bhujābhyāṃ bhagavānbrahmā kṣatrarājaṃ mahābalam ..
sūryaṃ ca janayāmāsa rājanītiparāyaṇam .. 3.4.5.10 ..
3.4.d:
भुजाभ्यां भगवान्ब्रह्मा क्षत्रराजं महाबलम् ॥
सूर्यं च जनयामास राजनीतिपरायणम् ॥ 3.4.5.10 ॥
3.4.m: From his two arms the blessed Brahmā brought forth Sūrya, / the king of kṣatriyas, possessed of great strength and devoted to royal statecraft.

3.4.s:
ūrubhyāṃ vaiśyarājaṃ ca samudraṃ saritāṃ patim..
ratnākaraṃ ca kṛtavānparameṣṭhī pitāmahaḥ ..11..
3.4.d:
ऊरुभ्यां वैश्यराजं च समुद्रं सरितां पतिम्॥
रत्नाकरं च कृतवान्परमेष्ठी पितामहः ॥11॥
3.4.m: From his thighs the Grandfather, the supreme lord, created the king of vaiśyas: / the ocean, lord of rivers and mine of jewels.

3.4.s:
padbhyāṃ ca janayāmāsa viśvakarmāṇamuttamam ..
dakṣaṃ nāma kalābhijñaṃ śūdrarājaṃ sukṛtyakam ..12..
3.4.d:
पद्भ्यां च जनयामास विश्वकर्माणमुत्तमम् ॥
दक्षं नाम कलाभिज्ञं शूद्रराजं सुकृत्यकम् ॥12॥
3.4.m: And from his two feet he generated the supreme Viśvakarman / named Dakṣa, skilled in arts, the king of śūdras, dutiful in action.

3.4.s:
somādvai brāhmaṇā jātāḥ sūryādrājanyavaṃśajāḥ ..
samudrātsakalā vaiśyā dakṣācchūdrā babhūvire ..13..
3.4.d:
सोमाद्वै ब्राह्मणा जाताः सूर्याद्राजन्यवंशजाः ॥
समुद्रात्सकला वैश्या दक्षाच्छूद्रा बभूविरे ॥13॥
3.4.m: From Soma were born the brāhmaṇas, from Sūrya those of the royal lineages, / from the ocean all the vaiśyas, and from Dakṣa were born the śūdras.

3.4.s:
sūryamaṃḍalato jāto manurvaivasvataḥ svayam ..
tasya rājyamabhūtsarvaṃ prāṇināṃ lokavāsinām ..14..
3.4.d:
सूर्यमंडलतो जातो मनुर्वैवस्वतः स्वयम् ॥
तस्य राज्यमभूत्सर्वं प्राणिनां लोकवासिनाम् ॥14॥
3.4.m: From the orb of the sun, Vaivasvata Manu himself was born; / his was the sovereignty over all living beings dwelling in the world.

3.4.s:
divyānāṃ ca yugānāṃ ca tajjñeyaṃ caikasaptatiḥ ..
tadā sa bhagavānviṣṇurviśvarūpā'vatārakaḥ .. 15 ..
3.4.d:
दिव्यानां च युगानां च तज्ज्ञेयं चैकसप्ततिः ॥
तदा स भगवान्विष्णुर्विश्वरूपाऽवतारकः ॥ 15 ॥
3.4.m: And that [duration] is to be known as seventy-one celestial yugas. / At that time, the Blessed Lord Viṣṇu, who incarnates as the universal form,

3.4.s:
viṣṇuḥ pūrvārddhato jātaḥ parārddhādvāmanaḥ svayam ..
bālaḥ satyayuge devo viśvarūpaḥ sanātanaḥ ..16..
3.4.d:
विष्णुः पूर्वार्द्धतो जातः परार्द्धाद्वामनः स्वयम् ॥
बालः सत्ययुगे देवो विश्वरूपः सनातनः ॥16॥
3.4.m: Viṣṇu was born from the first half, and from the second half Vāmana himself. / In the Kṛtayuga the eternal Lord of universal form was a child.

3.4.s:
catuśśatāni varṣāṇi paramāyurnṛṇāṃ tadā ..
tretāyāṃ yauvanaṃ prāptaḥ pūrvārddhātsaṃbhavo hareḥ .. 17 ..
3.4.d:
चतुश्शतानि वर्षाणि परमायुर्नृणां तदा ॥
त्रेतायां यौवनं प्राप्तः पूर्वार्द्धात्संभवो हरेः ॥ 17 ॥
3.4.m: At that time, the maximum lifespan of mortals was four hundred years. / In the Tretā[yuga], Hari, born from the first half, attained youth.

3.4.s:
varṣāṇāṃ triśatānāṃ ca nṛṇāmāyuḥ prakīrtitam ..
dvāpare vārddhiko devo nṛṇāmāyuḥ śatadvayam .. 18 ..
3.4.d:
वर्षाणां त्रिशतानां च नृणामायुः प्रकीर्तितम् ॥
द्वापरे वार्द्धिको देवो नृणामायुः शतद्वयम् ॥ 18 ॥
3.4.m: And the lifespan of mortals was proclaimed to be three hundred years. / In the Dvāpara[yuga] the Lord was an old man, and the lifespan of mortals was two hundred [years].

3.4.s:
kalau tu maraṇaṃ prāpto viśvarūpo hariḥ svayam ..
nṛṇāmāyuḥ śatābdaṃ ca keṣāṃciddharmaśālinām .. 19 ..
3.4.d:
कलौ तु मरणं प्राप्तो विश्वरूपो हरिः स्वयम् ॥
नृणामायुः शताब्दं च केषांचिद्धर्मशालिनाम् ॥ 19 ॥
3.4.m: In the Kali[yuga], however, Hari himself of universal form met his death. / And the lifespan of mortals, for some who possess righteousness, is one hundred years.

3.4.s:
parārddhādvāmano devo mahendrāvarajo hariḥ ..
caturbhujo mahāśyāmo garuḍopari saṃsthitaḥ .. 3.4.5.20 ..
3.4.d:
परार्द्धाद्वामनो देवो महेन्द्रावरजो हरिः ॥
चतुर्भुजो महाश्यामो गरुडोपरि संस्थितः ॥ 3.4.5.20 ॥
3.4.m: From the second half [came] Lord Vāmana, Hari, the younger brother of Mahendra, / four-armed, exceedingly dark, seated upon Garuḍa.

3.4.s:
viśvarūpahitārthāya triyugī saṃbabhūva ha ..
vāmanārddhācca triyugī jāto nārāyaṇaḥ svayam..21..
3.4.d:
विश्वरूपहितार्थाय त्रियुगी संबभूव ह ॥
वामनार्द्धाच्च त्रियुगी जातो नारायणः स्वयम्॥21॥
3.4.m: He became Triyugī for the welfare of the universal form. / And from the half [constituting] Vāmana, Nārāyaṇa himself was born as Triyugī.

3.4.s:
śvetarūpo hariḥ satye haṃsākhyo bhagavānsvayam ..
tretāyāṃ raktarūpaśca yajñākhyo bhagavānsvayam ..
dvāpare pītarūpaśca svarṇagarbho hariḥ svayam ..22..
3.4.d:
श्वेतरूपो हरिः सत्ये हंसाख्यो भगवान्स्वयम् ॥
त्रेतायां रक्तरूपश्च यज्ञाख्यो भगवान्स्वयम् ॥
द्वापरे पीतरूपश्च स्वर्णगर्भो हरिः स्वयम् ॥22॥
3.4.m: In the Kṛtayuga Hari was white in form, the Blessed Lord himself named Haṃsa. / In the Tretā[yuga] he was red in form, the Blessed Lord himself named Yajña. / In the Dvāpara[yuga] Hari was yellow in form, Svarṇagarbha himself.

3.4.s:
kalikāle tu saṃprāpte saṃdhyāyāṃ dvāpare yuge ..
kalā tu sakalā viṣṇorvāmanasya tathā kalā ..
ekībhūtā ca devakyāṃ jāto viṣṇustadā svayam .. 23 ..
3.4.d:
कलिकाले तु संप्राप्ते संध्यायां द्वापरे युगे ॥
कला तु सकला विष्णोर्वामनस्य तथा कला ॥
एकीभूता च देवक्यां जातो विष्णुस्तदा स्वयम् ॥ 23 ॥
3.4.m: When the Kali age arrived, at the twilight of the Dvāparayuga, / all the portions of Viṣṇu and the portions of Vāmana / became united, and Viṣṇu himself was then born in Devakī.

3.4.s:
vasudevagṛhe ramye mathurāyāṃ ca devatāḥ ..
brahmādyāstuṣṭuvurdevaṃ paraṃ brahma sanātanam .. 24 ..
3.4.d:
वसुदेवगृहे रम्ये मथुरायां च देवताः ॥
ब्रह्माद्यास्तुष्टुवुर्देवं परं ब्रह्म सनातनम् ॥ 24 ॥
3.4.m: In the delightful house of Vasudeva in Mathurā, the deities / headed by Brahmā praised the eternal Lord, the supreme Brahman.

3.4.s:
tadā prasanno bhagavāndevānāha śubhaṃ vacaḥ ..
devānāṃ ca hitārthāya daityānāṃ nidhanāya ca ..
ahaṃ kalau ca bahudhā bhavāmi surasattamāḥ .. 25 ..
3.4.d:
तदा प्रसन्नो भगवान्देवानाह शुभं वचः ॥
देवानां च हितार्थाय दैत्यानां निधनाय च ॥
अहं कलौ च बहुधा भवामि सुरसत्तमाः ॥ 25 ॥
3.4.m: Then the Blessed Lord, being pleased, spoke an auspicious word to the gods: / “For the welfare of the gods and for the destruction of the daityas, / I shall become many in the Kali[yuga], O best of gods.

3.4.s:
divyaṃ vṛṃdāvanaṃ ramyaṃ sūkṣmaṃ bhūtalasaṃsthitam ..
tatrāhaṃ ca rahaḥkrīḍāṃ kariṣyāmi kalau yuge .. 26 ..
3.4.d:
दिव्यं वृंदावनं रम्यं सूक्ष्मं भूतलसंस्थितम् ॥
तत्राहं च रहःक्रीडां करिष्यामि कलौ युगे ॥ 26 ॥
3.4.m: There is celestial Vṛndāvana, delightful and subtle, situated on the earth's surface. / There I shall perform secret pastimes in the Kaliyuga.

3.4.s:
sarve vedāḥ kalau ghore gopībhūtāḥ samaṃtataḥ ..
raṃsyante hi mayā sārddhaṃ tyaktvā bhūmaṃḍalaṃ tadā .. 27 ..
3.4.d:
सर्वे वेदाः कलौ घोरे गोपीभूताः समंततः ॥
रंस्यन्ते हि मया सार्द्धं त्यक्त्वा भूमंडलं तदा ॥ 27 ॥
3.4.m: In the terrible Kali[yuga], all the Vedas, having become cowherd women all around, / having abandoned the terrestrial sphere, shall sport with me.

3.4.s:
rādhayā prārthito'haṃ vai yadā kaliyugāṃtake ..
samāpya ca rahaḥkrīḍāṃ kalkī ca bhavitāsmyaham .. 28 ..
3.4.d:
राधया प्रार्थितोऽहं वै यदा कलियुगांतके ॥
समाप्य च रहःक्रीडां कल्की च भवितास्म्यहम् ॥ 28 ॥
3.4.m: When besought by Rādhā at the end of the Kaliyuga, / having concluded my secret pastimes, I shall become Kalki.

3.4.s:
yugāṃtapralayaṃ kṛtvā punarbhūtvā dvidhātanuḥ ..
satyadharmaṃ kariṣyāmi satye prāpte surottamāḥ .. 29 ..
3.4.d:
युगांतप्रलयं कृत्वा पुनर्भूत्वा द्विधातनुः ॥
सत्यधर्मं करिष्यामि सत्ये प्राप्ते सुरोत्तमाः ॥ 29 ॥
3.4.m: Having caused the dissolution at the end of the yuga, and having again assumed a twofold body, / I shall establish true righteousness when the Kṛtayuga arrives, O best of gods.”

3.4.s:
iti śrutvā tu te devāstatraivāntarlayaṃ gatāḥ ..
evaṃ yugeyuge krīḍā hareradbhutakarmaṇaḥ .. 3.4.5.30 ..
3.4.d:
इति श्रुत्वा तु ते देवास्तत्रैवान्तर्लयं गताः ॥
एवं युगेयुगे क्रीडा हरेरद्भुतकर्मणः ॥ 3.4.5.30 ॥
3.4.m: Having heard this, those gods vanished right there. / Such is the sport, in yuga after yuga, of Hari of wondrous deeds.

3.4.s:
ye tu vai viṣṇubhaktāśca te hi jānaṃti viśvagam ..
yathaiva nṛpaterdāsāḥ svarājñaḥ kāryagauravam ..
jānaṃti nāpare vipra tathā dāsā hareḥ svayam ..31..
3.4.d:
ये तु वै विष्णुभक्ताश्च ते हि जानंति विश्वगम् ॥
यथैव नृपतेर्दासाः स्वराज्ञः कार्यगौरवम् ॥
जानंति नापरे विप्र तथा दासा हरेः स्वयम् ॥31॥
3.4.m: Those who are devotees of Viṣṇu indeed know the all-pervading one. / Just as the servants of a king know the gravity of their king's affairs / and others do not, O brahmin, so do Hari's own servants.

3.4.s:
viṣṇuvāṃchānusāreṇa viṣṇumāyā sanātanī ..
racitvā vividhām̐llokānmahākālī babhūva ha ..32..
3.4.d:
विष्णुवांछानुसारेण विष्णुमाया सनातनी ॥
रचित्वा विविधाम्̐ल्लोकान्महाकाली बभूव ह ॥32॥
3.4.m: In accordance with Viṣṇu's desire, the eternal Viṣṇumāyā, / having fashioned the manifold worlds, became Mahākālī.

3.4.s:
kṛtvā kālamayaṃ sarvaṃ jagadeccarācaram ..
paścāttu bhakṣayitvā tānmahāgaurī bhaviṣyati ..33..
3.4.d:
कृत्वा कालमयं सर्वं जगदेच्चराचरम् ॥
पश्चात्तु भक्षयित्वा तान्महागौरी भविष्यति ॥33॥
3.4.m: Having made this entire universe of moving and unmoving beings full of time, / and having subsequently devoured them, she will become Mahāgaurī.

3.4.s:
namastasyai mahākālyai viṣṇumāye namonamaḥ ..
mahāgauri namastubhyamasmānpāhi bhayānvitān ..34..
3.4.d:
नमस्तस्यै महाकाल्यै विष्णुमाये नमोनमः ॥
महागौरि नमस्तुभ्यमस्मान्पाहि भयान्वितान् ॥34॥
3.4.m: Obeisance to her, Mahākālī; repeated obeisance to Viṣṇumāyā! / O Mahāgaurī, obeisance to you! Protect us who are filled with fear!

3.4.s:
.. ṛṣiruvāca .. ..
mahīrājānmuniśreṣṭha ke rājāno babhūvire ..
tānno vada mahābhāga sarvajño'sti bhavānsadā ..1..
3.4.d:
॥ ऋषिरुवाच ॥ ॥
महीराजान्मुनिश्रेष्ठ के राजानो बभूविरे ॥
तान्नो वद महाभाग सर्वज्ञोऽस्ति भवान्सदा ॥1॥
3.4.m: The sage said: / Which kings arose on earth, O best of sages? / Tell us of them, O fortunate one; you are ever omniscient.

3.4.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
paiśācaḥ kutukoddīno dehalīrājyamāsthitaḥ ..
valīgaḍhaṃ mahāramyaṃ yādavai rakṣitaṃ puram ..
yayau tatra sa paiśācaḥ śūrāyutasamanvitaḥ ..2..
3.4.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
पैशाचः कुतुकोद्दीनो देहलीराज्यमास्थितः ॥
वलीगढं महारम्यं यादवै रक्षितं पुरम् ॥
