arbudācca samudbhūto rājanyaḥ khaḍgacarmadhṛk . . 122
mahendraṃ śaraṇaṃ jagmuḥ sumerugirimūrddhani .
tadarthe bhagavāñchakrastuṣṭāva jagadambikām . . 115
kanyāmūrtimayī devī surānprāha śivaṅkarī .
mamāṅgadarśanāddevāḥ kṣuttṛḍbhyāṃ ca vinā sadā . . 116
bhavadhvaṃ ca tato yūyaṃ madvilokanatatparāḥ .
iti śrutvā tu te devā harṣitāḥ sambamūvire . . 117
ābhīrītanayo rāhuḥ kṛtvā rājyaṃ śataṃ samāḥ .
tyaktvā prāṇānkalau līno babhūva munisattama . . 118
tadanvaye sārddhaśatamayutābdāntarebhavat .
mahāmadamataṃ ghoraṃ cirakālādvināśitam . . 119
taiḥ punaścoddhṛtaṃ bhūmau sarve mlecchā babhūvire .
na vedāśca na devāśca na varṇāśca kalau yuge . . 120
dṛśyante na ca maryādā kalikāle tadanvaye .
dvijaśeṣāḥ sahasrāśca punararbudamūrddhani . . 121
3.4.d:
द्वादशाहं प्रयत्नेन देवानाराधितुं क्षमा ।
अर्बुदाच्च समुद्भूतो राजन्यः खड्गचर्मधृक् ॥ 122
महेन्द्रं शरणं जग्मुः सुमेरुगिरिमूर्द्धनि ।
तदर्थे भगवाञ्छक्रस्तुष्टाव जगदम्बिकाम् ॥ 115
कन्यामूर्तिमयी देवी सुरान्प्राह शिवङ्करी ।
ममाङ्गदर्शनाद्देवाः क्षुत्तृड्भ्यां च विना सदा ॥ 116
भवध्वं च ततो यूयं मद्विलोकनतत्पराः ।
इति श्रुत्वा तु ते देवा हर्षिताः सम्बमूविरे ॥ 117
आभीरीतनयो राहुः कृत्वा राज्यं शतं समाः ।
त्यक्त्वा प्राणान्कलौ लीनो बभूव मुनिसत्तम ॥ 118
तदन्वये सार्द्धशतमयुताब्दान्तरेभवत् ।
महामदमतं घोरं चिरकालाद्विनाशितम् ॥ 119
तैः पुनश्चोद्धृतं भूमौ सर्वे म्लेच्छा बभूविरे ।
न वेदाश्च न देवाश्च न वर्णाश्च कलौ युगे ॥ 120
दृश्यन्ते न च मर्यादा कलिकाले तदन्वये ।
द्विजशेषाः सहस्राश्च पुनरर्बुदमूर्द्धनि ॥ 121
3.4.m:
Being capable, worshipped the gods diligently for twelve days. / And from Arbuda arose a warrior bearing a sword and a shield.
They went to Mahendra for refuge on the summit of Mount Sumeru. / On their behalf, the blessed Śakra praised the Mother of the Universe.
The goddess, embodying the form of a maiden, the bringer of auspiciousness, said to the gods: / 'O gods, by the sight of my body, you shall always be free from hunger and thirst;
Therefore, remain devoted to gazing upon me.' / Hearing this, those gods became joyful.
Rāhu, the son of the Ābhīra woman, having ruled for a hundred years / And having yielded up his breath, merged into Kali, O best of sages.
In his lineage there were one hundred and fifty [kings] over the span of ten thousand years. / The dread doctrine of Mahāmada, which had been destroyed for a long time,
Was revived again on earth by them, and all became Mlecchas. / In the Kali age neither the Vedas, nor the gods, nor the social orders
Nor proper boundaries are to be seen in his lineage during the Kali age. / The thousands of remaining twice-born again on the summit of Arbuda,

3.4.s:
dvādaśāhaṃ prayatnena devānārādhituṃ kṣamā .
arbudācca samudbhūto rājanyaḥ khaḍgacarmadhṛk . . 122
3.4.d:
द्वादशाहं प्रयत्नेन देवानाराधितुं क्षमा ।
अर्बुदाच्च समुद्भूतो राजन्यः खड्गचर्मधृक् ॥ 122
3.4.m: Being capable, worshipped the gods diligently for twelve days. / And from Arbuda arose a warrior bearing a sword and a shield.

3.4.s:
jitvā mlecchāndurādharṣānnāmnā cārvabalī hyabhūt .
pañcayojanamānā sa bhūmirātmavivṛddhaye . . 123
3.4.d:
जित्वा म्लेच्छान्दुराधर्षान्नाम्ना चार्वबली ह्यभूत् ।
पञ्चयोजनमाना स भूमिरात्मविवृद्धये ॥ 123
3.4.m: Conquering the invincible Mlecchas, he was indeed known by the name Cārvabalī. / A territory measuring five yojanas was fashioned by that pure one

3.4.s:
nirmitā tena śuddhena nāmnā cārvapurī smṛtā .
śanaiḥ śanairāryakulaṃ punastatra vavarddha ha . . 124
3.4.d:
निर्मिता तेन शुद्धेन नाम्ना चार्वपुरी स्मृता ।
शनैः शनैरार्यकुलं पुनस्तत्र ववर्द्ध ह ॥ 124
3.4.m: For his own growth, and was known by the name Cārvapurī. / Little by little the noble lineage increased there once again.

3.4.s:
śatārddhābdaṃ prayatnena tena rājyaṃ mahatkṛtam .
tadanvaye sārddhaśataṃ nṛpāścāsaṃstadā mune . . 125
3.4.d:
शतार्द्धाब्दं प्रयत्नेन तेन राज्यं महत्कृतम् ।
तदन्वये सार्द्धशतं नृपाश्चासंस्तदा मुने ॥ 125
3.4.m: For half a century a great reign was maintained by him with effort. / In his lineage there were then one hundred and fifty kings, O sage,

3.4.s:
ayutābdāntare vīrā mlecchamitrāśca saṅkarāḥ .
mlecchakanyodvahā ghorā nāmamātrāryyamārgagāḥ . . 126
3.4.d:
अयुताब्दान्तरे वीरा म्लेच्छमित्राश्च सङ्कराः ।
म्लेच्छकन्योद्वहा घोरा नाममात्रार्य्यमार्गगाः ॥ 126
3.4.m: Over the span of ten thousand years—warriors, allies of the Mlecchas, of mixed breed, / Marrying Mleccha maidens, fearsome, following the Aryan path in name only.

3.4.s:
tadā malayadeśasthairmlecchairlakṣapramāṇakaiḥ .
ārvudāryaiḥ samaṃ yuddhamabhavallomaharṣaṇam . . 127
3.4.d:
तदा मलयदेशस्थैर्म्लेच्छैर्लक्षप्रमाणकैः ।
आर्वुदार्यैः समं युद्धमभवल्लोमहर्षणम् ॥ 127
3.4.m: Then between the Mlecchas dwelling in the Malaya country, one hundred thousand in number, / And the noble folk of Arbuda, there occurred a hair-raising battle.

3.4.s:
varṣamātrāntare jitvā mālavasthā mahābalāḥ .
maṇḍalīkapadātaiśca muktamāryaiḥ samantataḥ . . 128
3.4.d:
वर्षमात्रान्तरे जित्वा मालवस्था महाबलाः ।
मण्डलीकपदातैश्च मुक्तमार्यैः समन्ततः ॥ 128
3.4.m: Those mightily strong ones dwelling in Mālava, having conquered within a year, / Abandoned the Aryans on all sides with district foot-soldiers.

3.4.s:
catvāriṃśatsahasrāṇi varṣāṇi jagatītale .
mlecchabhūpāśca śataśo babhūvuḥ svalpajīvinaḥ . . 129
3.4.d:
चत्वारिंशत्सहस्राणि वर्षाणि जगतीतले ।
म्लेच्छभूपाश्च शतशो बभूवुः स्वल्पजीविनः ॥ 129
3.4.m: For forty thousand years on the surface of the earth, / Short-lived Mleccha kings arose by the hundreds;

3.4.s:
paṃcaviṃśatsahasrāṇi teṣāṃ saṃkhyā ca bhūbhujām .
ye tu puṇyā mahīpālāḥ pūrvajanmatapodbhavāḥ . . 3.4.23.130
3.4.d:
पंचविंशत्सहस्राणि तेषां संख्या च भूभुजाम् ।
ये तु पुण्या महीपालाः पूर्वजन्मतपोद्भवाः ॥ 3.4.23.130
3.4.m: The count of those kings was twenty-five thousand. / Those rulers of the earth who were meritorious, born of the austerities of previous births,

3.4.s:
teṣāṃ līlā ca munibhiḥ purāṇeṣu prakīrtitā .
nānāsaṃvatkarāḥ sarve paiśācā dharmadūṣakāḥ . . 131
3.4.d:
तेषां लीला च मुनिभिः पुराणेषु प्रकीर्तिता ।
नानासंवत्कराः सर्वे पैशाचा धर्मदूषकाः ॥ 131
3.4.m: Their deeds have been proclaimed by the sages in the Purāṇas. / All [the others] were founders of various eras, demonic, and spoilers of dharma.

3.4.s:
navatyabdasahasrāṇi vyatītāni kalau yuge .
jātā mlecchamayī bhūmiralakṣmīstu janejane . . 132
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe pratisargaparvaṇi caturyugakhaṇḍāparaparyāye
kaliyugīyetihāsasamuccayavarṇanaṃ nāma trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ . 23
kaliyugīyetihāsasamuccayavarṇanam
3.4.d:
नवत्यब्दसहस्राणि व्यतीतानि कलौ युगे ।
जाता म्लेच्छमयी भूमिरलक्ष्मीस्तु जनेजने ॥ 132
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे प्रतिसर्गपर्वणि चतुर्युगखण्डापरपर्याये
कलियुगीयेतिहाससमुच्चयवर्णनं नाम त्रयोविंशोऽध्यायः । 23
कलियुगीयेतिहाससमुच्चयवर्णनम्
3.4.m:
Ninety thousand years elapsed in the Kali age; / The earth became full of Mlecchas, and misfortune clung to every person.
Thus ends the twenty-third chapter, entitled 'A Description of the Collection of Histories of the Kali Age,' in the Pratisargaparvan in the section on the four yugas, in the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.
A description of the collection of histories of the Kali age

3.4.s:
sūta uvāca
tataste sakalā daityāḥ kalinā ca puraskṛtāḥ .
kṛtvā ca jalayānāni harikhaṇḍamupāyayuḥ . . 1
3.4.d:
सूत उवाच
ततस्ते सकला दैत्याः कलिना च पुरस्कृताः ।
कृत्वा च जलयानानि हरिखण्डमुपाययुः ॥ 1
3.4.m: Sūta said: / Then all those demons, led by Kali, / Made water-vessels and went to Harikhaṇḍa.

3.4.s:
manujā harikhaṇḍe ca devatulyā mahābalāḥ .
ayudhyaṃstānmahāśastrairayutābdaprajīvinaḥ . . 2
3.4.d:
मनुजा हरिखण्डे च देवतुल्या महाबलाः ।
अयुध्यंस्तान्महाशस्त्रैरयुताब्दप्रजीविनः ॥ 2
3.4.m: The humans in Harikhaṇḍa, equal to gods and mightily strong, / Living for ten thousand years, fought them with great weapons.

3.4.s:
daśavarṣāntare sarve māyāyuddhaiḥ parājitāḥ .
mahendraṃ śaraṇaṃ jagmurharikhaṇḍanivāsinaḥ . . 3
3.4.d:
दशवर्षान्तरे सर्वे मायायुद्धैः पराजिताः ।
महेन्द्रं शरणं जग्मुर्हरिखण्डनिवासिनः ॥ 3
3.4.m: Over a span of ten years, all the inhabitants of Harikhaṇḍa, / Defeated by battles fought with illusory arts, went to Mahendra for refuge.

3.4.s:
tadā tu bhagavāñchakro viśvakarmāṇamabravīt .
bhramiśca nāmayantro'yaṃ saṃsthitaḥ saptasindhuṣu . . 4
3.4.d:
तदा तु भगवाञ्छक्रो विश्वकर्माणमब्रवीत् ।
भ्रमिश्च नामयन्त्रोऽयं संस्थितः सप्तसिन्धुषु ॥ 4
3.4.m: Then the blessed Śakra spoke to Viśvakarman: / 'This mechanism named Bhrami, situated in the seven seas,

3.4.s:
tvayā viracitastāta tatprabhāvānnarā bhuvi .
anyakhaṇḍe na gacchanti sa ca yantrastu māyinā . . 5
3.4.d:
त्वया विरचितस्तात तत्प्रभावान्नरा भुवि ।
अन्यखण्डे न गच्छन्ति स च यन्त्रस्तु मायिना ॥ 5
3.4.m: Was fashioned by you, dear father; by its power men on earth / Do not cross over to another continent. But that machine, by the sorcerer

3.4.s:
mayena bhraṃśito bhrātrā mlecchaiḥ sārddhaṃ samantataḥ .
saptadvīpeṣu yāsyanti manujā mama vairiṇaḥ . . 6
3.4.d:
मयेन भ्रंशितो भ्रात्रा म्लेच्छैः सार्द्धं समन्ततः ।
सप्तद्वीपेषु यास्यन्ति मनुजा मम वैरिणः ॥ 6
3.4.m: Maya, along with his brother and with Mlecchas on every side, has been broken. / My human enemies will go into the seven continents;

3.4.s:
ato naḥ pāhi maryādāṃ bhūmadhye bhavatā kṛtām .
iti śrutvā viśvakarmā divyayantramacīkarat . . 7
3.4.d:
अतो नः पाहि मर्यादां भूमध्ये भवता कृताम् ।
इति श्रुत्वा विश्वकर्मा दिव्ययन्त्रमचीकरत् ॥ 7
3.4.m: Therefore protect for us the boundary established by you in the midst of the earth.' / Hearing this, Viśvakarman constructed a divine mechanism.

3.4.s:
tena yantraprabhāvena bhramitāste babhūvire .
bhramiyantrānmahāvāyurjjāto mlecchavināśakaḥ . . 8
3.4.d:
तेन यन्त्रप्रभावेन भ्रमितास्ते बभूविरे ।
भ्रमियन्त्रान्महावायुर्ज्जातो म्लेच्छविनाशकः ॥ 8
3.4.m: By the power of that mechanism, they were thrown into confusion. / From the whirl-machine a mighty wind arose, destroying the Mlecchas.

3.4.s:
tadvāyorabhavatputro vātyo vātyāsamudbhavaḥ .
daityayakṣām̐śca paiśācāñjitvā jñānamayo balī . . 9
3.4.d:
तद्वायोरभवत्पुत्रो वात्यो वात्यासमुद्भवः ।
दैत्ययक्षाम्̐श्च पैशाचाञ्जित्वा ज्ञानमयो बली ॥ 9
3.4.m: From that wind was born a son, Vātya, born of a whirlwind; / Having conquered the Daityas, Yakṣas, and Piśācas, he was mighty and full of wisdom.

3.4.s:
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāstrivarṇāstena satkṛtāḥ .
balānmlecchānvarṇamayānkṛtvā vātyo mahābalaḥ . . 3.4.24.10
3.4.d:
ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्यास्त्रिवर्णास्तेन सत्कृताः ।
बलान्म्लेच्छान्वर्णमयान्कृत्वा वात्यो महाबलः ॥ 3.4.24.10
3.4.m: The three classes—the Brāhmaṇas, Kṣatriyas, and Vaiśyas—were honoured by him. / Having forcibly brought the barbarians into the class system, the mighty Vātya

3.4.s:
śatārddhābdaṃ maṇḍalīkaṃ padaṃ bhuvi gṛhītavān .
tadanvaye sahasrāśca nṛpāścāsankalau yuge . . 11
3.4.d:
शतार्द्धाब्दं मण्डलीकं पदं भुवि गृहीतवान् ।
तदन्वये सहस्राश्च नृपाश्चासन्कलौ युगे ॥ 11
3.4.m: held the status of an overlord on earth for fifty years. / In his lineage, there were thousands of kings in the Kali Age.

3.4.s:
vāyupakṣāstrivarṇāḍhyāḥ ṣoḍaśābdasahasrake .
vāyorjātaḥ svayaṃ brahmā vāyorjātaḥ sa vai hariḥ . . 12
3.4.d:
वायुपक्षास्त्रिवर्णाढ्याः षोडशाब्दसहस्रके ।
वायोर्जातः स्वयं ब्रह्मा वायोर्जातः स वै हरिः ॥ 12
3.4.m: Siding with the Wind and enriched by the three classes, for sixteen thousand years [they ruled]. / Brahmā himself was born of the Wind; Hari was indeed born of the Wind;

3.4.s:
vāyorjāto mahādevaḥ sarvaṃ vāyumayaṃ jagat .
vinā vāyuṃ mṛtāḥ sarve vāyunā bhuvi jīvinaḥ . . 13
3.4.d:
वायोर्जातो महादेवः सर्वं वायुमयं जगत् ।
विना वायुं मृताः सर्वे वायुना भुवि जीविनः ॥ 13
3.4.m: Mahādeva was born of the Wind; the entire universe is composed of the Wind. / Without the Wind, all are dead; through the Wind, they live upon earth.

3.4.s:
iti matvā tu te lokā vāyuṃ ca samatarpayan .
punastadā kalirghoro daityarājaṃ baliṃ prabhum . . 14
3.4.d:
इति मत्वा तु ते लोका वायुं च समतर्पयन् ।
पुनस्तदा कलिर्घोरो दैत्यराजं बलिं प्रभुम् ॥ 14
3.4.m: Thinking thus, those people propitiated the Wind. / Then again, the terrible Kali, bowed before the Daitya king, the lord Bali,

3.4.s:
natvā nivedayāmāsa duḥkhito'bhūttadā baliḥ .
vāmanāntikamāgamya kalimitreṇa saṃyutaḥ . . 15
3.4.d:
नत्वा निवेदयामास दुःखितोऽभूत्तदा बलिः ।
वामनान्तिकमागम्य कलिमित्रेण संयुतः ॥ 15
3.4.m: and made an appeal. Then Bali was grieved. / Approaching Vāmana together with his friend Kali,

3.4.s:
natvovāca sa vai rājā devadevaṃ janārdanam .
tvayā kaliḥ kṛto mahyaṃ prasannena surottama . . 16
3.4.d:
नत्वोवाच स वै राजा देवदेवं जनार्दनम् ।
त्वया कलिः कृतो मह्यं प्रसन्नेन सुरोत्तम ॥ 16
3.4.m: bowing down, that king said to Janārdana, the god of gods: / 'Kali was granted to me by you when you were pleased, O best of gods.

3.4.s:
vātyairdvijaiḥ karmabhūmeḥ kalistu sa nirākṛtaḥ .
ekapādo vyatīto'yaṃ kiñcidūnaṃ kaleḥ prabhoḥ . . 17
3.4.d:
वात्यैर्द्विजैः कर्मभूमेः कलिस्तु स निराकृतः ।
एकपादो व्यतीतोऽयं किञ्चिदूनं कलेः प्रभोः ॥ 17
3.4.m: Yet Kali has been driven out from the land of ritual actions by the twice-born born of Vātya. / One quarter of the lord Kali has now passed, with a little remaining.

3.4.s:
mayā samyaktu vai bhuktā bhūmirdevendramāyayā .
sahasrābdaṃ kalau prāpte mayā bhuktaṃ mahītalam . . 18
3.4.d:
मया सम्यक्तु वै भुक्ता भूमिर्देवेन्द्रमायया ।
सहस्राब्दं कलौ प्राप्ते मया भुक्तं महीतलम् ॥ 18
3.4.m: By me the earth was indeed properly enjoyed through the illusion of the lord of the gods. / When Kali arrived, for a thousand years the surface of the earth was enjoyed by me.

3.4.s:
tataḥ sārddhaṃ sahasrābdaṃ devairbhuktaṃ surasthalam .
tataḥ paṃcaśataṃ varṣaṃ kiñcidadhikameva ca . . 19
3.4.d:
ततः सार्द्धं सहस्राब्दं देवैर्भुक्तं सुरस्थलम् ।
ततः पंचशतं वर्षं किञ्चिदधिकमेव च ॥ 19
3.4.m: Then for fifteen hundred years the abode of the gods was enjoyed by the gods. / Then for five hundred years and a little more,

3.4.s:
mayā bhuktā karmabhūmiḥ sarvalokasya kāraṇāt .
tataḥ sārddhaṃ sahasrābdaṃ devairbhukteyamuttamā . . 3.4.24.20
3.4.d:
मया भुक्ता कर्मभूमिः सर्वलोकस्य कारणात् ।
ततः सार्द्धं सहस्राब्दं देवैर्भुक्तेयमुत्तमा ॥ 3.4.24.20
3.4.m: the land of ritual actions was enjoyed by me for the sake of all the worlds. / Then for fifteen hundred years this excellent [earth] was enjoyed by the gods.

3.4.s:
tataḥ sārddhasahasrābdaṃ kiñcidūnaṃ mayā dhṛtā .
sārddhatriṃśatsahasrābdaṃ devairdetyaistathā mahī . . 21
3.4.d:
ततः सार्द्धसहस्राब्दं किञ्चिदूनं मया धृता ।
सार्द्धत्रिंशत्सहस्राब्दं देवैर्देत्यैस्तथा मही ॥ 21
3.4.m: Then for fifteen hundred years, lacking a little, it was held by me. / For thirty-five thousand years, the earth [was enjoyed] by the gods and likewise by the Daityas;

3.4.s: bhuktā daityaiḥ punardevaiḥ tathā devaiśca dānavaiḥ . . 22
3.4.d: भुक्ता दैत्यैः पुनर्देवैः तथा देवैश्च दानवैः ॥ 22
3.4.m: enjoyed by the Daityas, then again by the gods, and likewise by the gods and the Dānavas.

3.4.s:
tvayā datto hi me deva kaliḥ kalivināśana .
nādhikāraṃ kṛtaṃ nātha satyaṃ satyapriyakṣama . . 23
3.4.d:
त्वया दत्तो हि मे देव कलिः कलिविनाशन ।
नाधिकारं कृतं नाथ सत्यं सत्यप्रियक्षम ॥ 23
3.4.m: Kali was indeed given to me by you, O God, O destroyer of distress! / Authority was not established, O Lord, who are truthful, fond of truth, and forgiving.'

3.4.s:
iti śrutvā balervākyaṃ bhagavānvāmano hariḥ .
svāṃśānmahītale prāpto daityapakṣavivardhanaḥ . . 24
3.4.d:
इति श्रुत्वा बलेर्वाक्यं भगवान्वामनो हरिः ।
स्वांशान्महीतले प्राप्तो दैत्यपक्षविवर्धनः ॥ 24
3.4.m: Hearing this speech of Bali, the blessed Vāmana, Hari, / arrived upon the surface of the earth through his own portion, increasing the faction of the Daityas.

3.4.s:
kāmaśarmā tadā vipro yamunātaṭasaṃsthitaḥ .
hariṃ tuṣṭāva manasā dvādaśābdaṃ prayatnataḥ . . 25
3.4.d:
कामशर्मा तदा विप्रो यमुनातटसंस्थितः ।
हरिं तुष्टाव मनसा द्वादशाब्दं प्रयत्नतः ॥ 25
3.4.m: At that time, a Brāhmaṇa named Kāmaśarman, residing on the bank of the Yamunā, / diligently praised Hari in his mind for twelve years.

3.4.s:
tadā tu vāmanaḥ śrīmānvacaḥ prāha dvijottamam .
varaṃ brūhi dvijaśreṣṭha yatte manasi saṃsthitam . .
iti śrutvā kāmaśarmā tuṣṭāva ślakṣṇayā girā . . 26
3.4.d:
तदा तु वामनः श्रीमान्वचः प्राह द्विजोत्तमम् ।
वरं ब्रूहि द्विजश्रेष्ठ यत्ते मनसि संस्थितम् ॥
इति श्रुत्वा कामशर्मा तुष्टाव श्लक्ष्णया गिरा ॥ 26
3.4.m: Then the glorious Vāmana spoke words to that best of the twice-born: / 'Choose a boon, O best of the twice-born, whatever is in your heart.' / Hearing this, Kāmaśarman praised him with smooth speech.

3.4.s:
kāmaśarmovāca
namo devāya mahate sarvapūjyāya te namaḥ . . 27
3.4.d:
कामशर्मोवाच
नमो देवाय महते सर्वपूज्याय ते नमः ॥ 27
3.4.m: Kāmaśarman said: / 'Obeisance to the great God, obeisance to you who are worthy of all worship!

3.4.s:
dharmapriyāya dharmāya devadaityakarāya ca .
daivādhīnanṛṇāṃ bhartre karmakartre namo namaḥ . . 28
3.4.d:
धर्मप्रियाय धर्माय देवदैत्यकराय च ।
दैवाधीननृणां भर्त्रे कर्मकर्त्रे नमो नमः ॥ 28
3.4.m: To the one who loves righteousness, who is righteousness, who creates gods and Daityas, / to the master of men who are subject to fate, to the creator of actions, obeisance, obeisance!

3.4.s:
daivādhīnāśca te devā daivollaṅghāśca dānavāḥ .
teṣāṃ bharttā kramāddhartā tasmai devāya te namaḥ . . 29
3.4.d:
दैवाधीनाश्च ते देवा दैवोल्लङ्घाश्च दानवाः ।
तेषां भर्त्ता क्रमाद्धर्ता तस्मै देवाय ते नमः ॥ 29
3.4.m: Those gods are subject to fate, and the Dānavas transgress fate. / To you, the god who is their master and in turn their destroyer, obeisance!

3.4.s:
putro bhava hare svāminsaphalaṃ vāñchitaṃ kuru .
iti śrutvā hariḥ sākṣādvāmano balirakṣakaḥ . . 3.4.24.30
3.4.d:
पुत्रो भव हरे स्वामिन्सफलं वाञ्छितं कुरु ।
इति श्रुत्वा हरिः साक्षाद्वामनो बलिरक्षकः ॥ 3.4.24.30
3.4.m: Become my son, O master Hari; make my desire fruitful!' / Hearing this, Hari himself, Vāmana the protector of Bali,

3.4.s:
svapūrvārddhāddevahūtyāṃ tatpatnyāṃ ca samudbhavaḥ .
dvidhā bhūtvā mahī jātau divyāṅgau divyavigrahau . . 31
3.4.d:
स्वपूर्वार्द्धाद्देवहूत्यां तत्पत्न्यां च समुद्भवः ।
द्विधा भूत्वा मही जातौ दिव्याङ्गौ दिव्यविग्रहौ ॥ 31
3.4.m: was born from his own front half in Devahūti, his wife. / Having become two, they were born on earth with divine limbs and divine forms:

3.4.s:
bhogasihaḥ kelisiṃha devapo daityapo hariḥ .
jitvā vātyodbhavānbhūpātkalpakṣetramupasthitaḥ . . 32
3.4.d:
भोगसिहः केलिसिंह देवपो दैत्यपो हरिः ।
जित्वा वात्योद्भवान्भूपात्कल्पक्षेत्रमुपस्थितः ॥ 32
3.4.m: Bhogasiṃha and Kelisiṃha, Hari as the protector of gods and protector of Daityas. / Having conquered the kings descended from Vātya, he reached the Kalpakṣetra.

3.4.s:
rahaḥ krīḍāvatī nāma nagarī mayanirmitā .
tatroṣya balavantau tau dadhatuśca kalerdhuram . . 33
3.4.d:
रहः क्रीडावती नाम नगरी मयनिर्मिता ।
तत्रोष्य बलवन्तौ तौ दधतुश्च कलेर्धुरम् ॥ 33
3.4.m: There is a city named Rahaḥkrīḍāvatī, built by Maya. / Residing there, those two mighty ones bore the burden of Kali.

3.4.s:
patnīyaṃ sarvadharmāṇāṃ sārabhūtā sanātanī .
pativratāyāṃ ye jātā narā āryāḥ surapriyāḥ . . 34
3.4.d:
पत्नीयं सर्वधर्माणां सारभूता सनातनी ।
पतिव्रतायां ये जाता नरा आर्याः सुरप्रियाः ॥ 34
3.4.m: A wife is the essence of all dharmas, eternal. / Men born of a devoted wife are noble and dear to the gods;

3.4.s:
dūṣitāyāṃ narā jātāste sarve varṇasaṅkarāḥ .
iti sañcintya bhagavānkṛtvā kāmamayaṃ vapuḥ . . 35
3.4.d:
दूषितायां नरा जातास्ते सर्वे वर्णसङ्कराः ।
इति सञ्चिन्त्य भगवान्कृत्वा काममयं वपुः ॥ 35
3.4.m: men born of a corrupted woman are all of mixed caste.' / Thinking thus, the Blessed One assumed a form made of desire.

3.4.s:
dine dine sahasrāṇi yoṣito bubhuje hariḥ .
tāḥ sarvā garbhamādhāya yamau suṣuvire mudā . . 36
3.4.d:
दिने दिने सहस्राणि योषितो बुभुजे हरिः ।
ताः सर्वा गर्भमाधाय यमौ सुषुविरे मुदा ॥ 36
3.4.m: Day after day, Hari enjoyed thousands of women. / They all conceived and joyfully gave birth to twins.

3.4.s:
nāryā tayā sahodaryā remire te sahodarāḥ .
evaṃ ca bahudhā sṛṣṭisteṣāṃ jātā kalau yuge . . 37
3.4.d:
नार्या तया सहोदर्या रेमिरे ते सहोदराः ।
एवं च बहुधा सृष्टिस्तेषां जाता कलौ युगे ॥ 37
3.4.m: Those brothers made love with that sister born of the same womb; / and thus their diverse offspring arose in the Kali Age.

3.4.s:
pūrvajātāstrivarṇāśca bhakṣayitvā dinedine .
karmabhūmyāṃ vavṛdhire pakṣiṇaśca yathā drume . . 38
3.4.d:
पूर्वजातास्त्रिवर्णाश्च भक्षयित्वा दिनेदिने ।
कर्मभूम्यां ववृधिरे पक्षिणश्च यथा द्रुमे ॥ 38
3.4.m: Consuming day after day the previously born members of the three classes, / they increased in the land of ritual actions like birds upon a tree.

3.4.s:
ubhayābdasahasrānte tairannāḥ pūrvamānavāḥ .
tadā kaleśca caraṇo dvitīyo bhuvi cāgamat . . 39
3.4.d:
उभयाब्दसहस्रान्ते तैरन्नाः पूर्वमानवाः ।
तदा कलेश्च चरणो द्वितीयो भुवि चागमत् ॥ 39
3.4.m: At the end of two thousand years, the former humans were devoured by them. / Then the second quarter of Kali arrived upon the earth.

3.4.s:
sāmprataṃ vartate vārtā kinnarāṇāṃ ca bhūtale .
dvikiṣkumātrāśca narāḥ sārddhā daityamayāḥ smṛtāḥ . . 3.4.24.40
3.4.d:
साम्प्रतं वर्तते वार्ता किन्नराणां च भूतले ।
द्विकिष्कुमात्राश्च नराः सार्द्धा दैत्यमयाः स्मृताः ॥ 3.4.24.40
3.4.m: Presently the condition of Kinnaras exists on the surface of the earth: / men are remembered as measuring only two and a half cubits, consisting of Daityas.

3.4.s:
yathā khagāḥ karmahīnāścatvāriṃśābdajīvinaḥ .
bhūmigāśca tathā te vai bhedaṃ teṣveṣu naiva bhoḥ . . 41
3.4.d:
यथा खगाः कर्महीनाश्चत्वारिंशाब्दजीविनः ।
भूमिगाश्च तथा ते वै भेदं तेष्वेषु नैव भोः ॥ 41
3.4.m: Just as birds devoid of ritual action live for forty years, / so too do those on earth; there is indeed no difference among them, O sirs!

3.4.s:
dṛśyante cādya yuṣmābhirbhūtale kinnarā narāḥ .
dvitīyacaraṇānte ca bhaviṣyantyevameva hi . .4 2
na vivāho na bhūpaśca nodyamo na hi karmakṛt .
bhavitā ca tadā teṣāṃ dvitīyacaraṇāntike . .4 3
sapādalakṣābdamitamadyaprabhṛti bho dvijāḥ .
bhogakelyanvayodbhūtā bhaviṣyanti mahītale . . 44
3.4.d:
दृश्यन्ते चाद्य युष्माभिर्भूतले किन्नरा नराः ।
द्वितीयचरणान्ते च भविष्यन्त्येवमेव हि ॥4 2
न विवाहो न भूपश्च नोद्यमो न हि कर्मकृत् ।
भविता च तदा तेषां द्वितीयचरणान्तिके ॥4 3
सपादलक्षाब्दमितमद्यप्रभृति भो द्विजाः ।
भोगकेल्यन्वयोद्भूता भविष्यन्ति महीतले ॥ 44
3.4.m: Today Kinnara men are seen by you on the surface of the earth; / and at the end of the second quarter, they will indeed be just like that: / there will be no marriage, no king, no enterprise, and no performer of rites / at the end of the second quarter for them. / From this day forward for one hundred and twenty-five thousand years, O twice-born, / those born in the lineage of Bhoga and Keli shall exist on the earth.

3.4.s:
ato mayā ca sahitā bhavanto munisattamāḥ .
kṛṣṇacaitanyamāgamya gamiṣyāmastadājñayā . . 45
3.4.d:
अतो मया च सहिता भवन्तो मुनिसत्तमाः ।
कृष्णचैतन्यमागम्य गमिष्यामस्तदाज्ञया ॥ 45
3.4.m: Therefore, accompanied by me, you best of sages, / having approached Kṛṣṇacaitanya, shall depart by his command.'

3.4.s:
vyāsa uvāca
iti śrutvā tu munayo viśālāpūrnivāsinaḥ .
bho namaste gamiṣyanti yajñāṃśaṃ prati harṣitāḥ . .46
3.4.d:
व्यास उवाच
इति श्रुत्वा तु मुनयो विशालापूर्निवासिनः ।
भो नमस्ते गमिष्यन्ति यज्ञांशं प्रति हर्षिताः ॥46
3.4.m: Vyāsa said: / Hearing this, the sages residing in the city of Viśālā / joyfully said, 'Hail to you!' and will go towards Yajñāṃśa.

3.4.s:
natvā sarve muniśreṣṭhā yajñāṃśaṃ yajñarūpiṇam .
vacanaṃ ca vadiṣyanti dehyājñāṃ bhagavanprabho . . 47
3.4.d:
नत्वा सर्वे मुनिश्रेष्ठा यज्ञांशं यज्ञरूपिणम् ।
वचनं च वदिष्यन्ति देह्याज्ञां भगवन्प्रभो ॥ 47
3.4.m: All the best sages, bowing to Yajñāṃśa, who embodies the sacrifice, / will speak these words: 'Give your command, O Blessed Lord!

3.4.s:
indraloke gamiṣyāmo nākamadhyaṃ manoharam .
iti śrutvā tu yajñāṃśaḥ sarvaśiṣyasamanvitaḥ . .48
3.4.d:
इन्द्रलोके गमिष्यामो नाकमध्यं मनोहरम् ।
इति श्रुत्वा तु यज्ञांशः सर्वशिष्यसमन्वितः ॥48
3.4.m: We shall go to the world of Indra, into the middle of the enchanting heaven.' / Hearing this, Yajñāṃśa, accompanied by all his disciples,

3.4.s:
taiḥ sarvaiḥ saha svarlokaṃ gamiṣyati surapriyaḥ .
tadā kaliḥ samaṃ daityairbhajiṣyati mahītalam . .
kimanyacchrotumicchā te hṛṣīkottama tadvada . .49
3.4.d:
तैः सर्वैः सह स्वर्लोकं गमिष्यति सुरप्रियः ।
तदा कलिः समं दैत्यैर्भजिष्यति महीतलम् ॥
किमन्यच्छ्रोतुमिच्छा ते हृषीकोत्तम तद्वद ॥49
3.4.m: dear to the gods, will go together with all of them to heaven. / Then Kali, along with the Daityas, will enjoy the surface of the earth. / What else do you wish to hear, O best of senses? Speak that.'

3.4.s:
manuruvāca
bhagavanvistarādbrūhi bhogakelicaritrakam .
kalau yathā bhaviṣyanti manujāstattathā prabho . . 3.4.24.50
3.4.d:
मनुरुवाच
भगवन्विस्तराद्ब्रूहि भोगकेलिचरित्रकम् ।
कलौ यथा भविष्यन्ति मनुजास्तत्तथा प्रभो ॥ 3.4.24.50
3.4.m: Manu said: / 'O Blessed Lord, relate in detail the deeds of Bhoga and Keli, / and how men will be in Kali, O Master.'

3.4.s:
vyāsa uvāca
bhogasiṃhe kelisiṃhe vāmanāṃśasamudbhave . . 51
3.4.d:
व्यास उवाच
भोगसिंहे केलिसिंहे वामनांशसमुद्भवे ॥ 51
3.4.m: Vyāsa said: / 'When Bhogasiṃha and Kelisiṃha were born of a portion of Vāmana,

3.4.s:
jitvā daityānnaramayānnarānvātyodbhavānbhuvi .
vāmanāṃśamupāgamya harṣitāḥ sambabhūvire . . 52
3.4.d:
जित्वा दैत्यान्नरमयान्नरान्वात्योद्भवान्भुवि ।
वामनांशमुपागम्य हर्षिताः सम्बभूविरे ॥ 52
3.4.m: having conquered on earth the Daityas made of men and the men born of Vātya, / they approached the portion of Vāmana and became overjoyed.

3.4.s:
tadā tu duḥkhitā devāstyaktvā mūrtīḥ samantataḥ .
kṛṣṇacaitanyamāgamya natvocurnatakandharāḥ . . 53
3.4.d:
तदा तु दुःखिता देवास्त्यक्त्वा मूर्तीः समन्ततः ।
कृष्णचैतन्यमागम्य नत्वोचुर्नतकन्धराः ॥ 53
3.4.m: Then the grieved gods, abandoning their forms on all sides, / approached Kṛṣṇacaitanya and, bowing their heads, spoke:

3.4.s:
bhagavaṃstvatprasādena caraṇaṃ prathamaṃ kaleḥ .
bhuktā tathā mahī svāmiñjitvā vai daityaprapūjakān . . 54
3.4.d:
भगवंस्त्वत्प्रसादेन चरणं प्रथमं कलेः ।
भुक्ता तथा मही स्वामिञ्जित्वा वै दैत्यप्रपूजकान् ॥ 54
3.4.m: 'O Blessed Lord, by your grace the first quarter of Kali / and the earth were enjoyed, O Master, having conquered the worshippers of the Daityas.'

3.4.s:
kiṃ kartavyaṃ ca yajñāṃśa namaste karuṇākara .
iti śrutvā hariḥ prāha tadā śṛṇudhvaṃ surasattamāḥ . . 55
3.4.d:
किं कर्तव्यं च यज्ञांश नमस्ते करुणाकर ।
इति श्रुत्वा हरिः प्राह तदा शृणुध्वं सुरसत्तमाः ॥ 55
3.4.m: "And what should be done, O portion of the sacrifice? Salutations to you, O maker of compassion!" / Hearing this, Hari then spoke: "Listen, O best of gods:

3.4.s:
ahaṃ svargaṃ gamiṣyāmi bhavadbhiḥ saha harṣitaḥ .
ato yūyaṃ surāḥ sarve devavaṃśānnarānsadā . . 56
3.4.d:
अहं स्वर्गं गमिष्यामि भवद्भिः सह हर्षितः ।
अतो यूयं सुराः सर्वे देववंशान्नरान्सदा ॥ 56
3.4.m: Delighted, I shall go to heaven together with you. / Therefore, O all you gods, always [gathering] men of divine descent,

3.4.s:
utthāpya śīghramāgamya gacchadhvaṃ ca triviṣṭapam .
iti sūtena kathite munīnprati sumaṇḍalam . . 57
3.4.d:
उत्थाप्य शीघ्रमागम्य गच्छध्वं च त्रिविष्टपम् ।
इति सूतेन कथिते मुनीन्प्रति सुमण्डलम् ॥ 57
3.4.m: rousing them, coming quickly, go to heaven!" / When this was spoken by Sūta to the sages, O mind,

3.4.s:
devā vimānamādāya tatra yāsyanti bho manaḥ .
sūtādīṃśca munīnsarvānsamāruhya surāstadā . . 58
3.4.d:
देवा विमानमादाय तत्र यास्यन्ति भो मनः ।
सूतादींश्च मुनीन्सर्वान्समारुह्य सुरास्तदा ॥ 58
3.4.m: the gods, taking celestial chariots, will go there, O mind. / Then the gods, having mounted, [taking] Sūta and all the other sages,

3.4.s:
yajñāṃśaṃ ca gamiṣyanti nadīhopavane tadā .
ahlādaśca tadā yogī gorakhādyāstathaiva ca . . 59
3.4.d:
यज्ञांशं च गमिष्यन्ति नदीहोपवने तदा ।
अह्लादश्च तदा योगी गोरखाद्यास्तथैव च ॥ 59
3.4.m: and the portion of the sacrifice, will go to the river grove then. / And then the yogin Āhlāda, and likewise Gorakha and others,

3.4.s:
śaṅkarādyāśca rudrāṃśā nṛpo bhartṛharistadā .
anye tu yoganiṣṭhāśca gamiṣyanti hitapradāḥ . . 3.4.24.60
3.4.d:
शङ्कराद्याश्च रुद्रांशा नृपो भर्तृहरिस्तदा ।
अन्ये तु योगनिष्ठाश्च गमिष्यन्ति हितप्रदाः ॥ 3.4.24.60
3.4.m: and the portions of Rudra headed by Śaṅkara, and then king Bhartṛhari, / and others devoted to yoga, who bestow benefit, will depart.

3.4.s:
taiḥ sārddhaṃ kṛṣṇacaitanyo devalokaṃ gamiṣyati .
tadā tau vāmanāṃśau ca dvitīyacaraṇe kalau . . 61
3.4.d:
तैः सार्द्धं कृष्णचैतन्यो देवलोकं गमिष्यति ।
तदा तौ वामनांशौ च द्वितीयचरणे कलौ ॥ 61
3.4.m: Together with them, Kṛṣṇacaitanya will go to the world of the gods. / Then those two portions of Vāmana, in the second quarter of the Kali [age],

3.4.s:
yoganiṣṭhāṃ samādhāya kalpakṣetre vasiṣyataḥ .
tadaiva sakalā daityā harṣitāstairnṛbhirmuhuḥ . . 62
3.4.d:
योगनिष्ठां समाधाय कल्पक्षेत्रे वसिष्यतः ।
तदैव सकला दैत्या हर्षितास्तैर्नृभिर्मुहुः ॥ 62
3.4.m: having attained steadfastness in yoga, will dwell in Kalpakṣetra. / At that very time, all the Daityas, repeatedly gladdened by those men,

3.4.s:
vivarānvarddhayiṣyanti pātālādyānsamantataḥ .
kalestutīyacaraṇe samprāpte kinnarāśca te . . 63
3.4.d:
विवरान्वर्द्धयिष्यन्ति पातालाद्यान्समन्ततः ।
कलेस्तुतीयचरणे सम्प्राप्ते किन्नराश्च ते ॥ 63
3.4.m: will enlarge the chasms all around, beginning with Pātāla. / When the third quarter of the Kali [age] has arrived, those Kinnaras

3.4.s:
śanaiḥśanaiḥ kṣayaṃ bhūmau gamiṣyanti samantataḥ .
ṣaḍviṃśābdasahasre ca tṛtīyacaraṇe gate . . 64
3.4.d:
शनैःशनैः क्षयं भूमौ गमिष्यन्ति समन्ततः ।
षड्विंशाब्दसहस्रे च तृतीयचरणे गते ॥ 64
3.4.m: will gradually perish on the earth on every side. / And when twenty-six thousand years of the third quarter have passed,

3.4.s:
rudrājñayā bhṛṅgaṛṣirbhūtapakṣo gamiṣyati .
saurabhī nāma tatpatnī janiṣyati mahābalān . . 65
3.4.d:
रुद्राज्ञया भृङ्गऋषिर्भूतपक्षो गमिष्यति ।
सौरभी नाम तत्पत्नी जनिष्यति महाबलान् ॥ 65
3.4.m: by order of Rudra, the sage Bhṛṅga, siding with the bhūtas, will go forth. / His wife named Saurabhī will bear immensely powerful [sons]—

3.4.s:
kaulakalpānnarānghorānsarvakinnarabhakṣakān .
ṣaḍviṃśābdavayasteṣāṃ bhaviṣyati tadā kalau . . 66
3.4.d:
कौलकल्पान्नरान्घोरान्सर्वकिन्नरभक्षकान् ।
षड्विंशाब्दवयस्तेषां भविष्यति तदा कलौ ॥ 66
3.4.m: dreadful men resembling Kaulas, devourers of all Kinnaras. / Their lifespan will then be twenty-six years in the Kali [age].

3.4.s:
śaraṇaṃ vāmanāṃśaṃ ca gamiṣyanti sakinnarāḥ .
bhogasihaḥ kelisiṃhastaiśca sārddhaṃ mahadraṇam . . 67
3.4.d:
शरणं वामनांशं च गमिष्यन्ति सकिन्नराः ।
भोगसिहः केलिसिंहस्तैश्च सार्द्धं महद्रणम् ॥ 67
3.4.m: The Kinnaras will go for refuge to the portion of Vāmana. / Bhogasiṃha and Kelisiṃha, together with them, a great battle

3.4.s:
kariṣyati daśābdaṃ ca punastaiśca parājitau .
daityaiḥ sārddhaṃ ca pātālaṃ vāmanāṃśo gamiṣyataḥ . . 68
3.4.d:
करिष्यति दशाब्दं च पुनस्तैश्च पराजितौ ।
दैत्यैः सार्द्धं च पातालं वामनांशो गमिष्यतः ॥ 68
3.4.m: will wage for ten years, and defeated again by them, / the two portions of Vāmana will go to Pātāla along with the Daityas.

3.4.s:
bhṛṅgasṛṣṭirmahāghorā bhaviṣyati tadā kalau .
mātṛḥ svasuḥ sutāste vai narāśca paśurūpiṇaḥ . . 69
3.4.d:
भृङ्गसृष्टिर्महाघोरा भविष्यति तदा कलौ ।
मातृः स्वसुः सुतास्ते वै नराश्च पशुरूपिणः ॥ 69
3.4.m: The creation of Bhṛṅga will then be exceedingly dreadful in the Kali [age]. / Enjoying their mothers, sisters, and daughters with lust, those men,

3.4.s:
bhuktvā prītyā ca kāmāndhā janiṣyanti sutānbahūn .
kalestṛtīyacaraṇe samāpte tāstu sṛṣṭayaḥ . . 3.4.24.70
3.4.d:
भुक्त्वा प्रीत्या च कामान्धा जनिष्यन्ति सुतान्बहून् ।
कलेस्तृतीयचरणे समाप्ते तास्तु सृष्टयः ॥ 3.4.24.70
3.4.m: blinded by desire like beasts, will father many sons. / When the third quarter of the Kali [age] is completed, those creations,

3.4.s:
tiryyagyonidharā ghorāḥ kṣayiṣyanti kalau yuge .
kaleścaturthacaraṇe samprāpte tu tadā narāḥ . . 71
3.4.d:
तिर्य्यग्योनिधरा घोराः क्षयिष्यन्ति कलौ युगे ।
कलेश्चतुर्थचरणे सम्प्राप्ते तु तदा नराः ॥ 71
3.4.m: bearing the wombs of beasts, dreadful, will perish in the Kali age. / But when the fourth quarter of the Kali [age] arrives, men

3.4.s:
viṃśadabdavayaskāśca mariṣyanti ca nārakāḥ .
yathā jalamanuṣyāśca yathaiva vanajā narāḥ . . 72
3.4.d:
विंशदब्दवयस्काश्च मरिष्यन्ति च नारकाः ।
यथा जलमनुष्याश्च यथैव वनजा नराः ॥ 72
3.4.m: will have a lifespan of twenty years, and hellish people will die, / just like water-dwelling humans and forest-born men.

3.4.s:
kandamūlaphalāhārā bhaviṣyanti kalau tadā .
ālokā ye tu vikhyātāstāmisrādyā bhayānakāḥ . . 73
3.4.d:
कन्दमूलफलाहारा भविष्यन्ति कलौ तदा ।
आलोका ये तु विख्यातास्तामिस्राद्या भयानकाः ॥ 73
3.4.m: They will subsist on bulbs, roots, and fruits then in the Kali [age]. / The famous realms of hell, dreadful, beginning with Tāmisra,

3.4.s:
te sarve pūrṇameṣyanti karmabhūmibhavairnaraiḥ .
yathā satyasya prathame caraṇe satyalokakaḥ . . 74
3.4.d:
ते सर्वे पूर्णमेष्यन्ति कर्मभूमिभवैर्नरैः ।
यथा सत्यस्य प्रथमे चरणे सत्यलोककः ॥ 74
3.4.m: will all become full of men born in the land of ritual action. / Just as in the first quarter of the Satya [age], the Satyaloka [was filled],

3.4.s:
dvitīye ca tapoloke janalokastṛtīyakaḥ .
caturthe svargalokaśca pūritaḥ karmabhūmijaiḥ . . 75
3.4.d:
द्वितीये च तपोलोके जनलोकस्तृतीयकः ।
चतुर्थे स्वर्गलोकश्च पूरितः कर्मभूमिजैः ॥ 75
3.4.m: and in the second, Tapoloka; Janaloka was the third; / and in the fourth, Svargaloka was filled by those born in the land of ritual action;

3.4.s:
tretāyugādyacaraṇe bhuvarlokaṃ bhuvāspadam .
svargalokaṃ yathā taiśca manujaiḥ pūritaṃ smṛtam . . 76
3.4.d:
त्रेतायुगाद्यचरणे भुवर्लोकं भुवास्पदम् ।
स्वर्गलोकं यथा तैश्च मनुजैः पूरितं स्मृतम् ॥ 76
3.4.m: in the first quarter of the Tretā yuga, Bhuvarloka, the abode of the earth, / and Svargaloka, as is remembered, were filled by those men;

3.4.s:
dvitīye ṛṣilokaṃ ca tṛtīye grahaviṣṭapam .
caturthe ca bhuvarlokaṃ pūritaṃ karmajairnaraiḥ . . 77
3.4.d:
द्वितीये ऋषिलोकं च तृतीये ग्रहविष्टपम् ।
चतुर्थे च भुवर्लोकं पूरितं कर्मजैर्नरैः ॥ 77
3.4.m: in the second, the world of sages; in the third, the realm of the planets; / and in the fourth, Bhuvarloka was filled by men born of action;

3.4.s:
dvāparādyapade pūrṇe bhaveddvīpaḥ sa puṣkara .
dvitīye śālmalaḥ krauñcastṛtīye dvīpaśeṣakaḥ . . 78
3.4.d:
द्वापराद्यपदे पूर्णे भवेद्द्वीपः स पुष्कर ।
द्वितीये शाल्मलः क्रौञ्चस्तृतीये द्वीपशेषकः ॥ 78
3.4.m: when the first quarter of the Dvāpara [yuga] was filled, that Puṣkara continent was [filled]; / in the second, Śālmala and Krauñca; in the third, the remaining continents;

3.4.s:
jambūdvīpaścaturthe ca caraṇe munibhiḥ smṛtaḥ .
kaleśca caraṇe cādyedhaścordhvaṃ pūritaṃ jagat . . 79
3.4.d:
जम्बूद्वीपश्चतुर्थे च चरणे मुनिभिः स्मृतः ।
कलेश्च चरणे चाद्येधश्चोर्ध्वं पूरितं जगत् ॥ 79
3.4.m: and in the fourth quarter, Jambūdvīpa is remembered by the sages [to have been filled]. / And in the first quarter of the Kali [age], the world below and above was filled;

3.4.s:
dvitīye saptapātālastṛtīye bhūtaviṣṭapam .
pūritaṃ manujaistatra karmabhūmisamudbhavaiḥ . . 3.4.24.80
3.4.d:
द्वितीये सप्तपातालस्तृतीये भूतविष्टपम् ।
पूरितं मनुजैस्तत्र कर्मभूमिसमुद्भवैः ॥ 3.4.24.80
3.4.m: in the second, the seven subterranean realms; in the third, the realm of the bhūtas / was filled by men born in the land of ritual action.

3.4.s:
tadādyanārakāssarve pūrṇameṣyanti tairnaraiḥ .
iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ yatpṛṣṭo'haṃ mano tvayā . . 81
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe pratisargaparvaṇi caturyugakhaṇḍāparaparyāye
kaliyugīyetihāsasamuccayo nāma caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ . 24
kaliyugīyetihāsasamuccayavarṇanam
3.4.d:
तदाद्यनारकास्सर्वे पूर्णमेष्यन्ति तैर्नरैः ।
इति ते कथितं सर्वं यत्पृष्टोऽहं मनो त्वया ॥ 81
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे प्रतिसर्गपर्वणि चतुर्युगखण्डापरपर्याये
कलियुगीयेतिहाससमुच्चयो नाम चतुर्विंशोऽध्यायः । 24
कलियुगीयेतिहाससमुच्चयवर्णनम्
3.4.m:
Then, all those primary hells will become filled with those men. / Thus all that was asked by you, O Manu, has been told to you by me."
Thus ends the twenty-fourth chapter, entitled "The Summary of the History of the Kali Age", in the Pratisargaparvan, also termed the Caturyugakhaṇḍa, of the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.
Description of the Summary of the History of the Kali Age

3.4.s:
vyāsa uvāca
caturthacaraṇe jātairmanujairekaviṃśatiḥ .
ajīrṇabhūtā narakā yāsyanti ca yamālayam . . 1
3.4.d:
व्यास उवाच
चतुर्थचरणे जातैर्मनुजैरेकविंशतिः ।
अजीर्णभूता नरका यास्यन्ति च यमालयम् ॥ 1
3.4.m: Vyāsa said: / By the men born in the fourth quarter, the twenty-one / hells, having suffered indigestion, will go to the abode of Yama.

3.4.s:
namaste dharmarājāya naśca tṛptikarāya ca .
vacanaṃ śṛṇu sarvajña naśca jātamajīrṇakam . . 2
3.4.d:
नमस्ते धर्मराजाय नश्च तृप्तिकराय च ।
वचनं शृणु सर्वज्ञ नश्च जातमजीर्णकम् ॥ 2
3.4.m: "Salutations to you, O king of Dharma, who grant satisfaction to us! / Hear our words, O omniscient one: indigestion has arisen in us!

3.4.s:
yathā bhajāma prakṛtiṃ tathā kuru surottama .
iti śrutvā dharmarājaścitraguptena saṃyutaḥ . . 3
3.4.d:
यथा भजाम प्रकृतिं तथा कुरु सुरोत्तम ।
इति श्रुत्वा धर्मराजश्चित्रगुप्तेन संयुतः ॥ 3
3.4.m: Act in such a way, O best of gods, that we may return to our natural state." / Hearing this, the king of Dharma, accompanied by Citragupta,

3.4.s:
brahmāṇaṃ ca gamiṣyanti sandhyāyāṃ ca kalau yuge .
caturaśca yamāndṛṣṭvā parameṣṭhī pitāmahaḥ . . 4
3.4.d:
ब्रह्माणं च गमिष्यन्ति सन्ध्यायां च कलौ युगे ।
चतुरश्च यमान्दृष्ट्वा परमेष्ठी पितामहः ॥ 4
3.4.m: will go to Brahmā at the twilight [period] in the Kali yuga. / Seeing the four Yamas, the Grandfather Parameṣṭhin,

3.4.s:
tadīritaṃ svayaṃ jñātvā kṣīrābdhiṃ prati yāsyati .
pūjayityā jagannāthaṃ devadevaṃ vṛṣākapim . . 5
3.4.d:
तदीरितं स्वयं ज्ञात्वा क्षीराब्धिं प्रति यास्यति ।
पूजयित्या जगन्नाथं देवदेवं वृषाकपिम् ॥ 5
3.4.m: understanding what was said by them, will go to the Ocean of Milk. / Having worshipped Jagannātha, the god of gods, Vṛṣākapi,

3.4.s: sāṅkhyaśāstramayaiḥ stotraiḥ saṃstoṣyati param prabhum . . 6
3.4.d: साङ्ख्यशास्त्रमयैः स्तोत्रैः संस्तोष्यति परम् प्रभुम् ॥ 6
3.4.m: he will praise the supreme Lord with hymns composed of the Sāṅkhya doctrine:

3.4.s:
jaya jaya jaya nirguṇa guṇadhārinragajagajīvatattvaśubhakārin .
sārabhūtasadguṇamaya tattvairdevānracayati pāti guṇasattvaiḥ . .
tasmai namo namo guṇarāśe devavṛndahṛdi kṛṣṇavikāśe . . 7
3.4.d:
जय जय जय निर्गुण गुणधारिन्रगजगजीवतत्त्वशुभकारिन् ।
सारभूतसद्गुणमय तत्त्वैर्देवान्रचयति पाति गुणसत्त्वैः ॥
तस्मै नमो नमो गुणराशे देववृन्दहृदि कृष्णविकाशे ॥ 7
3.4.m: "Victory, victory, victory, O attribute-less bearer of attributes, causer of auspiciousness for the principles of dynamic, moving living beings! / Essential, consisting of true virtues, through the principles He fashions the gods, and protects them through virtuous goodness. / Homage, homage to Him, O heap of virtues, manifest as Kṛṣṇa in the hearts of the multitude of gods!

3.4.s:
rajobhūtatattvebhya utāśu viracati bhuvi ca narānsvayamāśu .
pāti hanti yo deva udārastasya śirasi saṃsthitajagabhāraḥ . .
pāhi nātha no daityavināśinkālajanitalīlāguṇabhāsin . . 8
3.4.d:
रजोभूततत्त्वेभ्य उताशु विरचति भुवि च नरान्स्वयमाशु ।
पाति हन्ति यो देव उदारस्तस्य शिरसि संस्थितजगभारः ॥
पाहि नाथ नो दैत्यविनाशिन्कालजनितलीलागुणभासिन् ॥ 8
3.4.m: From the principles consisting of passion, indeed, He swiftly creates men on earth by Himself. / The noble god who protects and destroys, upon whose head rests the burden of the world: / protect us, O Lord, destroyer of the Daityas, shining with the qualities of sport born of time!"

3.4.s:
teṣāmiti vacanaṃ prabhuḥ śrutvā hyavanimivāśu .
yathā janiṣyati sa prabhustacchṛṇu vai mana āśu . . 9 ?
namrībhūtānturānviṣṇurnamovākyena tānprati .
vadiṣyati vaco ramyaṃ lokamaṅgalahetave . . 3.4.25.10
3.4.d:
तेषामिति वचनं प्रभुः श्रुत्वा ह्यवनिमिवाशु ।
यथा जनिष्यति स प्रभुस्तच्छृणु वै मन आशु ॥ 9 ?
नम्रीभूतान्तुरान्विष्णुर्नमोवाक्येन तान्प्रति ।
वदिष्यति वचो रम्यं लोकमङ्गलहेतवे ॥ 3.4.25.10
3.4.m: Hearing their words, the Lord quickly [decided to descend] upon the earth. / Listen quickly, O Manu, how that Lord will be born! / To the gods who had bowed down with words of homage, Viṣṇu / will speak pleasing words for the welfare of the world:

3.4.s:
bhoḥ surāḥ sambhalagrāme kaśyapo'yaṃ janiṣyati .
nāmnā viṣṇuyaśāḥ khyāto viṣṇukīrtistu tatpriyā . . 11
3.4.d:
भोः सुराः सम्भलग्रामे कश्यपोऽयं जनिष्यति ।
नाम्ना विष्णुयशाः ख्यातो विष्णुकीर्तिस्तु तत्प्रिया ॥ 11
3.4.m: "O gods, in the village of Sambhala, this Kaśyapa will be born, / renowned by the name Viṣṇuyaśas, and Viṣṇukīrti will be his beloved.

3.4.s:
kṛṣṇalīlāmayaṃ granthaṃ narāṃstāñchrāvayiṣyati .
tadā te nandino bhūtvā caikībhūya samantataḥ . . 12
3.4.d:
कृष्णलीलामयं ग्रन्थं नरांस्ताञ्छ्रावयिष्यति ।
तदा ते नन्दिनो भूत्वा चैकीभूय समन्ततः ॥ 12
3.4.m: He will recite the text consisting of Kṛṣṇa's sports to those men. / Then they, having become followers of Nandin and uniting on all sides,

3.4.s:
taṃ dvijaṃ viṣṇuyaśasaṃ gṛhītvā nigaḍairdṛḍhaiḥ .
baddhvā sarve sapatnīkaṃ kārāgāre dṛḍhāyase . . 13
3.4.d:
तं द्विजं विष्णुयशसं गृहीत्वा निगडैर्दृढैः ।
बद्ध्वा सर्वे सपत्नीकं कारागारे दृढायसे ॥ 13
3.4.m: having seized that twice-born Viṣṇuyaśas and binding [him] / together with his wife in firm iron chains in a strong prison,

3.4.s:
kariṣyanti mahādhūrtā nārakā iva dāruṇāḥ .
viṣṇukīrtyā sa bhagavānpūrṇo nārāyaṇo hariḥ . . 14
3.4.d:
करिष्यन्ति महाधूर्ता नारका इव दारुणाः ।
विष्णुकीर्त्या स भगवान्पूर्णो नारायणो हरिः ॥ 14
3.4.m: will do so, being great scoundrels, cruel like the denizens of hell. / From Viṣṇukīrti, that Lord, the full Nārāyaṇa Hari,

3.4.s:
janiṣyati mahāviṣṇuḥ sarvalokaśivaṅkaraḥ .
niśīthe tamasodbhūte mārgakṛṣṇāṣṭamīdine . . 15
3.4.d:
जनिष्यति महाविष्णुः सर्वलोकशिवङ्करः ।
निशीथे तमसोद्भूते मार्गकृष्णाष्टमीदिने ॥ 15
3.4.m: Mahāviṣṇu, who brings welfare to all the worlds, will be born / at midnight, when darkness has arisen, on the eighth day of the dark fortnight of Mārgaśīrṣa."

3.4.s:
brahmāṇḍaṃ maṅgalaṃ kurvansurāḥ prādurbhaviṣyati .
brahma viṣṇurharaścaiva gaṇeśo vāsavo guruḥ . . 16
3.4.d:
ब्रह्माण्डं मङ्गलं कुर्वन्सुराः प्रादुर्भविष्यति ।
ब्रह्म विष्णुर्हरश्चैव गणेशो वासवो गुरुः ॥ 16
3.4.m:
Bringing auspiciousness to the universe, O gods, he will appear:
Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Hara, Gaṇeśa, Vāsava, Guru,

3.4.s:
vahniḥ pitṛpatiḥ pakṣo varuṇaḥ savibhīṣaṇaḥ .
citro vāyurdhruvo viśve raviḥ somaḥ kujo budhaḥ . . 17
3.4.d:
वह्निः पितृपतिः पक्षो वरुणः सविभीषणः ।
चित्रो वायुर्ध्रुवो विश्वे रविः सोमः कुजो बुधः ॥ 17
3.4.m:
Vahni, the Lord of the Pitṛs, Pakṣa, Varuṇa with Vibhīṣaṇa,
Citra, Vāyu, Dhruva, the Viśvedevas, Ravi, Soma, Kuja, Budha,

3.4.s:
guruḥ śukraḥ śaniḥ rāhuḥ ketustatra gamiṣyati .
padyaikaikena te devāḥ stoṣyanti parameśvaram . . 18
3.4.d:
गुरुः शुक्रः शनिः राहुः केतुस्तत्र गमिष्यति ।
पद्यैकैकेन ते देवाः स्तोष्यन्ति परमेश्वरम् ॥ 18
3.4.m:
Guru, Śukra, Śani, Rāhu, and Ketu will go there.
With one verse each, those gods will praise the Supreme Lord.

3.4.s:
mahattamā mūrtimayī tavājā tadāsya pūrvājjanitoha'mādau .
mayā tataṃ viśvamidaṃ sadaiva yato namastatpuruṣottamāya . . 19
3.4.d:
महत्तमा मूर्तिमयी तवाजा तदास्य पूर्वाज्जनितोहऽमादौ ।
मया ततं विश्वमिदं सदैव यतो नमस्तत्पुरुषोत्तमाय ॥ 19
3.4.m:
[Brahmā said:]
“Your unborn, supreme embodied form—from its eastern face I was born in the beginning.
By me this entire universe is ever pervaded; wherefore, praise be to that Supreme Person!”

3.4.s:
ajasya yāmyājjanito'hamādau viṣṇurmahākalpakaro'dhikārī .
svakīyanāmnā tu mayā tataṃ tadviśve sadaivaṃ ca namo namaste . . 3.4.25.20
3.4.d:
अजस्य याम्याज्जनितोऽहमादौ विष्णुर्महाकल्पकरोऽधिकारी ।
स्वकीयनाम्ना तु मया ततं तद्विश्वे सदैवं च नमो नमस्ते ॥ 3.4.25.20
3.4.m:
[Viṣṇu said:]
“From the southern [face] of the unborn [Lord] I, Viṣṇu, was born in the beginning, the overseer who makes the great cosmic eon.
By my own name, indeed, it is pervaded in the universe always thus; praise, praise be to you!”

3.4.s:
avyaktapāścātyamukhātsujanmā śivo'hamādau suratattvakārī .
mayā mahākalpakarastṛtīyā tvadājñayā deva namo namaste . . 21
3.4.d:
अव्यक्तपाश्चात्यमुखात्सुजन्मा शिवोऽहमादौ सुरतत्त्वकारी ।
मया महाकल्पकरस्तृतीया त्वदाज्ञया देव नमो नमस्ते ॥ 21
3.4.m:
[Śiva said:]
“From the unmanifest western face of noble birth, I, Śiva, in the beginning produced the essence of the gods.
By me the third great cosmic eon is made by your command; O god, praise, praise be to you!”

3.4.s:
pradhānavaktrottarato'hamādau jāto gaṇeśaḥ kila kalpakartā .
mayā tataṃ viśvamidaṃ sadaiva tasmai namaḥ kāruṇikottamāya . . 22
3.4.d:
प्रधानवक्त्रोत्तरतोऽहमादौ जातो गणेशः किल कल्पकर्ता ।
मया ततं विश्वमिदं सदैव तस्मै नमः कारुणिकोत्तमाय ॥ 22
3.4.m:
[Gaṇeśa said:]
“From the northern face of the Pradhāna I, Gaṇeśa, was indeed born in the beginning as the maker of the eon.
By me this universe is ever pervaded; praise be to him, the best of the compassionate!”

3.4.s:
ajārddhavaktrājjanito'hamādau marunmahākalpakaro mahendraḥ .
mayā tataṃ viśvamidaṃ svakalpe yadājñayā deva namo namaste . . 23
3.4.d:
अजार्द्धवक्त्राज्जनितोऽहमादौ मरुन्महाकल्पकरो महेन्द्रः ।
मया ततं विश्वमिदं स्वकल्पे यदाज्ञया देव नमो नमस्ते ॥ 23
3.4.m:
[Indra said:]
“From half the face of the unborn one I was born in the beginning as the Wind, Mahendra, the maker of the great cosmic eon.
By me this universe is pervaded in my own eon by whose command; O god, praise, praise be to you!”

3.4.s:
prathānabhālākṣisamudbhavo'haṃ vahnermahākalpakaro guhākhyaḥ .
vinirmitaṃ viśvamidaṃ mayā tadyadājñayā nātha namo namaste . . 24
3.4.d:
प्रथानभालाक्षिसमुद्भवोऽहं वह्नेर्महाकल्पकरो गुहाख्यः ।
विनिर्मितं विश्वमिदं मया तद्यदाज्ञया नाथ नमो नमस्ते ॥ 24
3.4.m:
[Kārttikeya said:]
“Born from the eye in the forehead of the Pradhāna, I am named Guha, the maker of the great cosmic eon of fire.
By me this universe was fashioned by whose command; O Lord, praise, praise be to you!”

3.4.s:
ajāmukhātpūrvagatācca jātaścādau mahākalpakaro'hamagniḥ .
brahmāṇḍametacca mayā tataṃ vai brahmāṇḍakalpāya namo namaste . . 25
3.4.d:
अजामुखात्पूर्वगताच्च जातश्चादौ महाकल्पकरोऽहमग्निः ।
ब्रह्माण्डमेतच्च मया ततं वै ब्रह्माण्डकल्पाय नमो नमस्ते ॥ 25
3.4.m:
[Agni said:]
“And born from the eastern face of the unborn one in the beginning, I am Agni, the maker of the great cosmic eon.
And by me this universe is pervaded; praise, praise be to you who are the cosmic eon of the universe!”

3.4.s:
ajābhujāddakṣiṇato'hamādau jāto mahākalpakakaraḥ sadharmaḥ .
mayā sadevai racitaṃ samagraṃ liṅgākhyakalpāya namo namaste . . 26
3.4.d:
अजाभुजाद्दक्षिणतोऽहमादौ जातो महाकल्पककरः सधर्मः ।
मया सदेवै रचितं समग्रं लिङ्गाख्यकल्पाय नमो नमस्ते ॥ 26
3.4.m:
[Yama said:]
“From the southern arm of the unborn one I was born in the beginning, Dharma, maker of the great cosmic eon.
By me the whole [world] was ever fashioned; praise, praise be to you who are the eon named Liṅga!”

3.4.s:
ajābhujātpaścimato'hamādau jāto mahākalpakaraḥ sa yajñaḥ .
mayā tataṃ viśvamidaṃ samagraṃ matsyākhyakalpāya namo namaste . . 27
3.4.d:
अजाभुजात्पश्चिमतोऽहमादौ जातो महाकल्पकरः स यज्ञः ।
मया ततं विश्वमिदं समग्रं मत्स्याख्यकल्पाय नमो नमस्ते ॥ 27
3.4.m:
[Yajña said:]
“From the western arm of the unborn one I was born in the beginning, Yajña, maker of the great cosmic eon.
By me this whole universe is pervaded; praise, praise be to you who are the eon named Matsya!”

3.4.s:
pradhānabāhūttarato'hamādau jāto mahākalpakaraḥ pracetāḥ .
mayā tataṃ nātha tavājñayedaṃ karmākhyakalpāya namo namaste . . 28
3.4.d:
प्रधानबाहूत्तरतोऽहमादौ जातो महाकल्पकरः प्रचेताः ।
मया ततं नाथ तवाज्ञयेदं कर्माख्यकल्पाय नमो नमस्ते ॥ 28
3.4.m:
[Varuṇa said:]
“From the northern arm of the Pradhāna I was born in the beginning, Pracetas, maker of the great cosmic eon.
By me, O Lord, this [universe] is pervaded by your command; praise, praise be to you who are the eon named Karma!”

3.4.s:
brahmāṇḍatamaso jātastvaddāso'haṃ vibhīṣaṇaḥ .
mayā tataṃ trilokaṃ ca namaste manurūpiṇe . . 29
3.4.d:
ब्रह्माण्डतमसो जातस्त्वद्दासोऽहं विभीषणः ।
मया ततं त्रिलोकं च नमस्ते मनुरूपिणे ॥ 29
3.4.m:
[Vibhīṣaṇa said:]
“Born from the darkness of the universe, I am your servant Vibhīṣaṇa.
And by me the three worlds are pervaded; praise be to you who possess the form of Manu!”

3.4.s:
brahmāṇḍasadguṇājjātaścitto'haṃ manukārakaḥ .
mayā tataṃ ca trailokyaṃ svāyambhuva namo'stu te . . 3.4.25.30
3.4.d:
ब्रह्माण्डसद्गुणाज्जातश्चित्तोऽहं मनुकारकः ।
मया ततं च त्रैलोक्यं स्वायम्भुव नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 3.4.25.30
3.4.m:
[Citra said:]
“Born from the good quality of the universe, I am Citta, maker of a Manu.
And by me the three worlds are pervaded; O Svāyambhuva, let there be praise to you!”

3.4.s:
brahmāṇḍarajaso jāto vāyurmanvantaraṃ tatam .
mayā svārociṣaṃ svāminnamaste manurūpiṇe . . 31
3.4.d:
ब्रह्माण्डरजसो जातो वायुर्मन्वन्तरं ततम् ।
मया स्वारोचिषं स्वामिन्नमस्ते मनुरूपिणे ॥ 31
3.4.m:
[Vāyu said:]
“Born from the passion of the universe, I am Vāyu; the Svārociṣa Manvantara was pervaded
by me, O Master; praise be to you who possess the form of Manu!”

3.4.s:
brahmāṇḍamanaso jāto dhruvo'haṃ manukārakaḥ .
mayottamaṃ ca racitaṃ namaste'stu tavājñayā . . 32
3.4.d:
ब्रह्माण्डमनसो जातो ध्रुवोऽहं मनुकारकः ।
मयोत्तमं च रचितं नमस्तेऽस्तु तवाज्ञया ॥ 32
3.4.m:
[Dhruva said:]
“Born from the cosmic mind, I am Dhruva, maker of a Manu.
And the Uttama [Manvantara] was fashioned by me by your command; let there be praise to you!”

3.4.s:
brahmāṇḍaśravaṇājjāto viśvakarmāhamīśvaraḥ .
mayā tataṃ raivataṃ ca namo deva tavājñayā . . 33
3.4.d:
ब्रह्माण्डश्रवणाज्जातो विश्वकर्माहमीश्वरः ।
मया ततं रैवतं च नमो देव तवाज्ञया ॥ 33
3.4.m:
[Viśvakarman said:]
“Born from the cosmic ear, I am Viśvakarman, the lord.
And by me the Raivata [Manvantara] was pervaded by your command; praise, O god!”

3.4.s:
brahmāṇḍadehato jātassūryo'haṃ cākṣuṣapradaḥ .
tavājñayā tataṃ viśvaṃ manurūpāya te namaḥ . . 34
3.4.d:
ब्रह्माण्डदेहतो जातस्सूर्योऽहं चाक्षुषप्रदः ।
तवाज्ञया ततं विश्वं मनुरूपाय ते नमः ॥ 34
3.4.m:
[Sūrya said:]
“Born from the cosmic body, I am Sūrya, the bestower of Cākṣuṣa.
By your command the universe is pervaded; praise be to you whose form is Manu!”

3.4.s:
brahmāṇḍanetrato jātaḥ somo'haṃ tu mayā tatam .
vaivasvatāntaraṃ ramyaṃ namaste manurūpiṇe . . 35
3.4.d:
ब्रह्माण्डनेत्रतो जातः सोमोऽहं तु मया ततम् ।
वैवस्वतान्तरं रम्यं नमस्ते मनुरूपिणे ॥ 35
3.4.m:
[Soma said:]
“Born from the cosmic eye, I am Soma; by me the delightful
Vaivasvata era was pervaded; praise be to you who possess the form of Manu!”

3.4.s:
brahmāṇḍarasanājjāto moho'haṃ manukārakaḥ .
namaste manurūpāya mayā sāvarṇikaṃ tatam . . 36
3.4.d:
ब्रह्माण्डरसनाज्जातो मोहोऽहं मनुकारकः ।
नमस्ते मनुरूपाय मया सावर्णिकं ततम् ॥ 36
3.4.m:
[Moha said:]
“Born from the cosmic tongue, I am Moha, maker of a Manu.
Praise be to you whose form is Manu; by me the Sāvarṇika [Manvantara] was pervaded!”

3.4.s:
brahmāṇḍaghrāṇato jāto budho'haṃ nātha kiṅkaraḥ .
nirmitaṃ brahmasāvarṇaṃ mayā tāta namo namaḥ . . 37
3.4.d:
ब्रह्माण्डघ्राणतो जातो बुधोऽहं नाथ किङ्करः ।
निर्मितं ब्रह्मसावर्णं मया तात नमो नमः ॥ 37
3.4.m:
[Budha said:]
“Born from the cosmic nose, I am Budha, O Lord, your servant.
The Brahma-Sāvarṇa [Manvantara] was fashioned by me, O Father; praise, praise!”

3.4.s:
brahmāṇḍavaktrato jāto jīvo'haṃ manukārakaḥ .
mayā vai dakṣasāvarṇaṃ tataṃ tatte namo namaḥ . . 38
3.4.d:
ब्रह्माण्डवक्त्रतो जातो जीवोऽहं मनुकारकः ।
मया वै दक्षसावर्णं ततं तत्ते नमो नमः ॥ 38
3.4.m:
[Bṛhaspati said:]
“Born from the cosmic mouth, I am Jīva, maker of a Manu.
By me, indeed, the Dakṣa-Sāvarṇa [Manvantara] was pervaded; so praise, praise to you!”

3.4.s:
brahmāṇḍakarato jātaḥ śukrohaṃ tava kiṅkaraḥ .
nirmitaṃ rudrasāvarṇaṃ mayā tubhyaṃ namo namaḥ . . 39
3.4.d:
ब्रह्माण्डकरतो जातः शुक्रोहं तव किङ्करः ।
निर्मितं रुद्रसावर्णं मया तुभ्यं नमो नमः ॥ 39
3.4.m:
[Śukra said:]
“Born from the cosmic hand, I am Śukra, your servant.
The Rudra-Sāvarṇa [Manvantara] was fashioned by me; praise, praise to you!”

3.4.s:
brahmāṇḍapadato jātomando'haṃ nātha te'nugaḥ .
tataṃ vai dharmasāvarṇaṃ prabhātesmai namo namaḥ . . 3.4.25.40
3.4.d:
ब्रह्माण्डपदतो जातोमन्दोऽहं नाथ तेऽनुगः ।
ततं वै धर्मसावर्णं प्रभातेस्मै नमो नमः ॥ 3.4.25.40
3.4.m:
[Śani said:]
“Born from the cosmic foot, I am Manda, O Lord, your follower.
The Dharma-Sāvarṇa [Manvantara] was indeed pervaded; at dawn, praise, praise to him!”

3.4.s:
brahmāṇḍaliṅgato jāto rāhuścāhaṃ tava priyaḥ .
mayā bhaumaṃ kṛtaṃ nātha namaste manurūpiṇe . . 41
3.4.d:
ब्रह्माण्डलिङ्गतो जातो राहुश्चाहं तव प्रियः ।
मया भौमं कृतं नाथ नमस्ते मनुरूपिणे ॥ 41
3.4.m:
[Rāhu said:]
“Born from the cosmic phallus, I am Rāhu, your beloved.
By me the Bhauma [Manvantara] was made, O Lord; praise be to you who possess the form of Manu!”

3.4.s:
brahmāṇḍaguhyato jātaḥ ketuścāhaṃ tavānugaḥ .
bhautaṃ manvataraṃ sṛṣṭaṃ tasmai devāya te namaḥ . . 42
3.4.d:
ब्रह्माण्डगुह्यतो जातः केतुश्चाहं तवानुगः ।
भौतं मन्वतरं सृष्टं तस्मै देवाय ते नमः ॥ 42
3.4.m:
[Ketu said:]
“Born from the cosmic secret parts, I am Ketu, your follower.
The Bhauta Manvantara was created; praise be to you, that god!”

3.4.s:
vyāsa uvāca
iti teṣāṃ stavānsvāmī śrutvā devānvadiṣyati .
varaṃ brūhīti vacanaṃ tataṃ prati manuḥ kramāt . .4 3
iti kṛtvā tu te devā bālarūpaṃ hariṃ svayam .
namaskṛtya vadiṣyanti vāñchitaṃ lokahetave . .
keyaṃ bhavānbrūhi lokānāṃ kalpe kalpe tamudbhavam .
tathā manvantare caiva śrotumicchāmahe vayam . .45
3.4.d:
व्यास उवाच
इति तेषां स्तवान्स्वामी श्रुत्वा देवान्वदिष्यति ।
वरं ब्रूहीति वचनं ततं प्रति मनुः क्रमात् ॥4 3
इति कृत्वा तु ते देवा बालरूपं हरिं स्वयम् ।
नमस्कृत्य वदिष्यन्ति वाञ्छितं लोकहेतवे ॥
केयं भवान्ब्रूहि लोकानां कल्पे कल्पे तमुद्भवम् ।
तथा मन्वन्तरे चैव श्रोतुमिच्छामहे वयम् ॥45
3.4.m:
Vyāsa said:
Having heard these praises from them, the Master will speak to the gods,
uttering the words, “Ask a boon,” towards the pervaded [worlds] of each Manu in turn.
Having done thus, those gods, bowing down
to Hari himself in the form of an infant, will speak their wish for the sake of the worlds:
“Tell us what this manifestation of the worlds is in eon after eon,
as well as in each Manvantara; we wish to hear.”

3.4.s:
kalkyuvāca
aṣṭādaśa mahākalpāḥ prakṛteśca tanau sthitāḥ .
ādyo brahmamahākalpastatra brahmā paraḥ pumān . .46
3.4.d:
कल्क्युवाच
अष्टादश महाकल्पाः प्रकृतेश्च तनौ स्थिताः ।
आद्यो ब्रह्ममहाकल्पस्तत्र ब्रह्मा परः पुमान् ॥46
3.4.m:
Kalki said:
“Eighteen great cosmic eons abide in the body of Prakṛti.
The first is the Brahmā great cosmic eon; in it Brahmā is the supreme person.

3.4.s:
tatpūrvārddhātsamudbhūtāstrayastriṃśacca devatāḥ .
parārddhādbhagavānbrahmā yogidhyeyo nirañjanaḥ . .47
3.4.d:
तत्पूर्वार्द्धात्समुद्भूतास्त्रयस्त्रिंशच्च देवताः ।
परार्द्धाद्भगवान्ब्रह्मा योगिध्येयो निरञ्जनः ॥47
3.4.m:
From its first half arose the thirty-three deities;
from its second half, the blessed Brahmā, who is spotless and to be meditated upon by yogins.

3.4.s:
tasminkalpe tu yā līlā brahmapaurāṇikaiḥ smṛtā .
śatakoṭipravistāro brahmapaurāṇikasya vai . .48
3.4.d:
तस्मिन्कल्पे तु या लीला ब्रह्मपौराणिकैः स्मृता ।
शतकोटिप्रविस्तारो ब्रह्मपौराणिकस्य वै ॥48
3.4.m:
And the sport in that eon is remembered by the experts on the Brahma Purāṇa;
the extent of the Brahma Purāṇa is indeed one hundred crores [of verses].

3.4.s:
purāṇapuruṣasyānte mahākalpaḥ smṛto budhaiḥ .
brahmāṇḍapralaye kalpo yugadaivasahasrakaḥ . .4 9
kalpāścāṣṭādaśa khyātāsteṣāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu .
kūrmakalpo matsya kalpaḥ śvetavārāhakalpakaḥ . . 3.4.25.50
3.4.d:
पुराणपुरुषस्यान्ते महाकल्पः स्मृतो बुधैः ।
ब्रह्माण्डप्रलये कल्पो युगदैवसहस्रकः ॥4 9
कल्पाश्चाष्टादश ख्यातास्तेषां नामानि मे शृणु ।
कूर्मकल्पो मत्स्य कल्पः श्वेतवाराहकल्पकः ॥ 3.4.25.50
3.4.m:
At the end of the Purāṇa Person, a great cosmic eon is remembered by the wise;
at the dissolution of the universe, an eon lasts a thousand divine yugas.
And eighteen eons are renowned; hear their names from me:
the Kūrma eon, the Matsya eon, the Śveta-Vārāha eon,

3.4.s:
nṛsiṃhakalpaśca tathā tathā vāmanakalpakaḥ .
skandakalpo rāmakalpaḥ kalpo bhāgavatastathā . . 51
3.4.d:
नृसिंहकल्पश्च तथा तथा वामनकल्पकः ।
स्कन्दकल्पो रामकल्पः कल्पो भागवतस्तथा ॥ 51
3.4.m:
and likewise the Nṛsiṃha eon, and likewise the Vāmana eon,
the Skanda eon, the Rāma eon, and likewise the Bhāgavata eon,

3.4.s:
tathā mārkaṇḍakalpaśca tathā bhaviṣyakalpakaḥ .
liṅgakalpastathā jñeyastathā brahmāṇḍakalpakaḥ . . 52
3.4.d:
तथा मार्कण्डकल्पश्च तथा भविष्यकल्पकः ।
लिङ्गकल्पस्तथा ज्ञेयस्तथा ब्रह्माण्डकल्पकः ॥ 52
3.4.m:
and likewise the Mārkaṇḍa eon, and likewise the Bhaviṣya eon,
the Liṅga eon is to be known as well, and likewise the Brahmāṇḍa eon,

3.4.s:
agnikalpo vāyukalpaḥ padmakalpastathaiva ca .
śivakalpo viṣṇukalpo brahmakalpastathā kramāt . . 53
3.4.d:
अग्निकल्पो वायुकल्पः पद्मकल्पस्तथैव च ।
शिवकल्पो विष्णुकल्पो ब्रह्मकल्पस्तथा क्रमात् ॥ 53
3.4.m:
the Agni eon, the Vāyu eon, and likewise the Padma eon,
the Śiva eon, the Viṣṇu eon, and the Brahma eon, in that order.

3.4.s:
dvisahasramitāvartaireṣāṃ kalpo mahānsmṛtaḥ .
sahasrayugaparyantaṃ brahmāṇḍāyuḥ prakīrtitam . . 54
3.4.d:
द्विसहस्रमितावर्तैरेषां कल्पो महान्स्मृतः ।
सहस्रयुगपर्यन्तं ब्रह्माण्डायुः प्रकीर्तितम् ॥ 54
3.4.m:
A great cosmic eon of these is remembered as measuring two thousand revolutions;
the lifespan of the universe is proclaimed as lasting up to a thousand yugas.

3.4.s:
yannāmnā ca smṛtaḥ kalpastasmājjāto virāḍayam ..
caturdaśamanūnāṃ ca madhye kalpaḥ sa kālavān.. 55..
3.4.d:
यन्नाम्ना च स्मृतः कल्पस्तस्माज्जातो विराडयम् ॥
चतुर्दशमनूनां च मध्ये कल्पः स कालवान्॥ 55॥
3.4.m:
By whose name an eon is remembered, from him this Virāj was born;
and within the fourteen Manus, that eon possesses its divisions of time.

3.4.s:
svāyaṃbhuvāṃtare yadvai jāṃtaṃjātaṃ caturyugam..
tasmiṃścaturyuge sarve nṛṇāmāyurhare śṛṇu ..56..
3.4.d:
स्वायंभुवांतरे यद्वै जांतंजातं चतुर्युगम्॥
तस्मिंश्चतुर्युगे सर्वे नृणामायुर्हरे शृणु ॥56॥
3.4.m:
The four-age cycle that was born repeatedly during the interval of Svāyambhuva—
hear, O Hari, the lifespan of men in that four-age cycle:

3.4.s:
lakṣābdaṃ vai satyayuge tretāyāmayutābdakam ..
dvāpare ca sahasrābdaṃ kalau cāyuśśatābdakam..57..
3.4.d:
लक्षाब्दं वै सत्ययुगे त्रेतायामयुताब्दकम् ॥
द्वापरे च सहस्राब्दं कलौ चायुश्शताब्दकम्॥57॥
3.4.m:
one hundred thousand years in the Satya-yuga, ten thousand years in the Tretā,
one thousand years in the Dvāpara, and a lifespan of one hundred years in the Kali.”

3.4.s:
svārociṣe'ntare aiva jātaṃjātaṃ caturyugam ..
śṛṇu tatra nṛṇāmāyussatyeśītisahasrakam .. 58 ..
3.4.d:
स्वारोचिषेऽन्तरे ऐव जातंजातं चतुर्युगम् ॥
शृणु तत्र नृणामायुस्सत्येशीतिसहस्रकम् ॥ 58 ॥
3.4.m:
In the Svārociṣa period, each four-age cycle was born.
Hear the lifespan of men there: in the Satya [age], eighty thousand [years];

3.4.s:
tretāyāṃ ca tadarddhābdaṃ dvāpare tu tadarddhakam ..
kalau dvika sahasrābdaṃ nṛṇāmāyuḥ prakīrtitam .. 59 ..
3.4.d:
त्रेतायां च तदर्द्धाब्दं द्वापरे तु तदर्द्धकम् ॥
कलौ द्विक सहस्राब्दं नृणामायुः प्रकीर्तितम् ॥ 59 ॥
3.4.m:
and half of that number of years in the Tretā, but half of that in the Dvāpara;
in the Kali [age], the lifespan of men is declared to be two thousand years.

3.4.s:
auttamasyāntare caiva satye ṣaṣṭisahasrakam ..
tretāyāṃ ca tadarddhābdaṃ dvāpare tu tadarddhakam ..3.4.25.60..
3.4.d:
औत्तमस्यान्तरे चैव सत्ये षष्टिसहस्रकम् ॥
त्रेतायां च तदर्द्धाब्दं द्वापरे तु तदर्द्धकम् ॥3.4.25.60॥
3.4.m:
And in the period of Auttama, in the Satya, [it is] sixty thousand [years];
and half of that number of years in the Tretā, but half of that in the Dvāpara;

3.4.s:
kalau sārddhasahasrābdaṃ nṛṇāmāyuḥ prakīrtitam ..
tāmasāntarake caiva ṣaṭtriṃśābdasahasrakam .. 61 ..
3.4.d:
कलौ सार्द्धसहस्राब्दं नृणामायुः प्रकीर्तितम् ॥
तामसान्तरके चैव षट्त्रिंशाब्दसहस्रकम् ॥ 61 ॥
3.4.m:
in the Kali, the lifespan of men is declared to be one thousand five hundred years.
And in the Tāmasa period, thirty-six thousand years

3.4.s:
nṛṇāmāyuḥ satyayuge tretāyāṃ ca tadarddhakam ..
dvāpare ca tadarddhābdaṃ kalau varṣasahasrakam .. 62 ..
3.4.d:
नृणामायुः सत्ययुगे त्रेतायां च तदर्द्धकम् ॥
द्वापरे च तदर्द्धाब्दं कलौ वर्षसहस्रकम् ॥ 62 ॥
3.4.m:
[is] the lifespan of men in the Satya age, and half of that in the Tretā;
and half of that number of years in the Dvāpara, [and] one thousand years in the Kali.

3.4.s:
raivatāntarake caiva satye triṃśatsahasrakam ..
tretāyāṃ ca tadarddhābdaṃ dvāpare ca tadarddhakam .. 63 ..
3.4.d:
रैवतान्तरके चैव सत्ये त्रिंशत्सहस्रकम् ॥
त्रेतायां च तदर्द्धाब्दं द्वापरे च तदर्द्धकम् ॥ 63 ॥
3.4.m:
And in the Raivata period, in the Satya, [it is] thirty thousand [years];
and half of that number of years in the Tretā, but half of that in the Dvāpara;

3.4.s:
kalau cāṣṭaśatābdāyurnṛṇāṃ vedaiḥ prakīrtitam ..
cākṣuṣāntarake caiva satye turyasahasrakam.. 64 ..
3.4.d:
कलौ चाष्टशताब्दायुर्नृणां वेदैः प्रकीर्तितम् ॥
चाक्षुषान्तरके चैव सत्ये तुर्यसहस्रकम्॥ 64 ॥
3.4.m:
and in the Kali, the lifespan of men is declared by the Vedas to be eight hundred years.
And in the Cākṣuṣa period, in the Satya, [it is] four thousand [years];

3.4.s:
tretāyāṃ trisahasrābdaṃ dvāpare dvisahasrakam ..
kalau sahasra varṣāntaṃ nṛṇāmāyuḥ prakīrtitam.. 65 ..
3.4.d:
त्रेतायां त्रिसहस्राब्दं द्वापरे द्विसहस्रकम् ॥
कलौ सहस्र वर्षान्तं नृणामायुः प्रकीर्तितम्॥ 65 ॥
3.4.m:
in the Tretā, three thousand years; in the Dvāpara, two thousand;
[and] in the Kali, the lifespan of men is declared to end at a thousand years.

3.4.s:
vaivasvatentare caiva satye turyasahasrakam ..
tretāyāṃ triśatābdaṃ ca dvāpare dviśatābdakam .. 66 ..
3.4.d:
वैवस्वतेन्तरे चैव सत्ये तुर्यसहस्रकम् ॥
त्रेतायां त्रिशताब्दं च द्वापरे द्विशताब्दकम् ॥ 66 ॥
3.4.m:
And in the Vaivasvata period, in the Satya, [it is] four thousand [years];
and in the Tretā, three hundred years; and in the Dvāpara, two hundred years;

3.4.s:
kalau śatābdakaṃ proktamāyurvedaistathā nṛṇām ..
sāvarṇike'ntare deva nṛṇāṃ viṃśatsahasrakam .. 67 ..
3.4.d:
कलौ शताब्दकं प्रोक्तमायुर्वेदैस्तथा नृणाम् ॥
सावर्णिकेऽन्तरे देव नृणां विंशत्सहस्रकम् ॥ 67 ॥
3.4.m:
in the Kali, the lifespan of men is likewise stated by the Vedas to be a hundred years.
In the Sāvarṇika period, O god, twenty thousand [years] of men

3.4.s:
āyuḥ satye tadarddhaṃ tu tretāyāṃ ca prakīrtitam ..
dvāpare ca tadarddhābdaṃ tadarddhābdaṃ tu vai kalau .. 68 ..
3.4.d:
आयुः सत्ये तदर्द्धं तु त्रेतायां च प्रकीर्तितम् ॥
द्वापरे च तदर्द्धाब्दं तदर्द्धाब्दं तु वै कलौ ॥ 68 ॥
3.4.m:
[is] the lifespan in the Satya, but half of that is declared in the Tretā;
and half of that number of years in the Dvāpara, and indeed half of that number of years in the Kali.

3.4.s:
brahmasāvarṇike caiva satye daśasahasrakam ..
tretāyāṃ ca tadarddhābdaṃ dvāpare tu tadarddhakam .. .. 69 ..
3.4.d:
ब्रह्मसावर्णिके चैव सत्ये दशसहस्रकम् ॥
त्रेतायां च तदर्द्धाब्दं द्वापरे तु तदर्द्धकम् ॥ ॥ 69 ॥
3.4.m:
And in the Brahma-sāvarṇika, in the Satya, [it is] ten thousand [years];
and half of that number of years in the Tretā, but half of that in the Dvāpara;

3.4.s:
kalau caiva tadarddhābdaṃ nṛṇāmāyuḥ prakīrtitam..
dakṣasāvarṇike caiva tathābdāyuścaturyuge .. 3.4.25.70 ..
3.4.d:
कलौ चैव तदर्द्धाब्दं नृणामायुः प्रकीर्तितम्॥
दक्षसावर्णिके चैव तथाब्दायुश्चतुर्युगे ॥ 3.4.25.70 ॥
3.4.m:
and in the Kali, the lifespan of men is declared to be half of that number of years.
And in the Dakṣa-sāvarṇika, the lifespan in years in the four-age cycle is the same.

3.4.s:
rudrasāvarṇike caiva satye cāṣṭasahasrakam ..
tretāyāṃ tadarddhābdaṃ dvāpare ca tadarddhakam .. 71 ..
3.4.d:
रुद्रसावर्णिके चैव सत्ये चाष्टसहस्रकम् ॥
त्रेतायां तदर्द्धाब्दं द्वापरे च तदर्द्धकम् ॥ 71 ॥
3.4.m:
And in the Rudra-sāvarṇika, in the Satya, [it is] eight thousand [years];
half of that number of years in the Tretā, and half of that in the Dvāpara;

3.4.s:
kalau tadarddhakaṃ jñeyaṃ nṛṇāmāyuḥ purātane ..
dharmasāvarṇike caiva tathābdāyuścaturyuge .. 72 ..
3.4.d:
कलौ तदर्द्धकं ज्ञेयं नृणामायुः पुरातने ॥
धर्मसावर्णिके चैव तथाब्दायुश्चतुर्युगे ॥ 72 ॥
3.4.m:
in the Kali, the lifespan of men of old is to be known as half of that.
And in the Dharma-sāvarṇika, the lifespan in years in the four-age cycle is the same.

3.4.s:
bhauma manvaṃtare caiva satye turyasahasrakam ..
tretāyāṃ trisahasrābdaṃ dvāpare ca tadarddhakam .. 73 ..
3.4.d:
भौम मन्वंतरे चैव सत्ये तुर्यसहस्रकम् ॥
त्रेतायां त्रिसहस्राब्दं द्वापरे च तदर्द्धकम् ॥ 73 ॥
3.4.m:
And in the Bhauma manvantara, in the Satya, [it is] four thousand [years];
three thousand years in the Tretā, and half of that in the Dvāpara;

3.4.s:
kalau tadarddhakaṃ jñeyaṃ narāyuścārṣasammatam ..
bhautamanvaṃtare caiva satye turyaśatābdakam.. 74 ..
3.4.d:
कलौ तदर्द्धकं ज्ञेयं नरायुश्चार्षसम्मतम् ॥
भौतमन्वंतरे चैव सत्ये तुर्यशताब्दकम्॥ 74 ॥
3.4.m:
in the Kali, the lifespan of men is to be known as half of that, agreed upon by the ṛṣis.
And in the Bhauta manvantara, in the Satya, [it is] four hundred years;

3.4.s:
tretāyāṃ triśatābdaṃ ca dvāpare tu tadarddhakam ..
tadarddhakaṃ kalau ghore nṛṇāmāyuḥ prakīrtitam .. 75 ..
3.4.d:
त्रेतायां त्रिशताब्दं च द्वापरे तु तदर्द्धकम् ॥
तदर्द्धकं कलौ घोरे नृणामायुः प्रकीर्तितम् ॥ 75 ॥
3.4.m:
and in the Tretā, three hundred years, but in the Dvāpara, half of that;
half of that is declared to be the lifespan of men in the dreadful Kali.

3.4.s:
manvaṃtare tu yannāmnā bhūpāścāsaṃścaturyuge ..
tannāmnā ca nṛpā jātāsteṣāṃ līlāḥ pṛthakpṛthak .. 76 ..
3.4.d:
मन्वंतरे तु यन्नाम्ना भूपाश्चासंश्चतुर्युगे ॥
तन्नाम्ना च नृपा जातास्तेषां लीलाः पृथक्पृथक् ॥ 76 ॥
3.4.m:
In a manvantara, by whichever name kings existed in the four-age cycle,
kings were born by that name; their deeds are each distinct.

3.4.s:
evamanyatra vai jñeyaṃ yuge turye manau manau ..
yo manustasya vaṃśāśca divyaikayugasaptatau .. 77 ..
3.4.d:
एवमन्यत्र वै ज्ञेयं युगे तुर्ये मनौ मनौ ॥
यो मनुस्तस्य वंशाश्च दिव्यैकयुगसप्ततौ ॥ 77 ॥
3.4.m:
Thus it is to be understood elsewhere, in the fourth age, in Manu after Manu:
whoever is the Manu, his lineages also exist during seventy-one divine [four-age] cycles.

3.4.s:
yugāṃte karmabhūmeśca layaḥ kalpaḥ sa vai smṛtaḥ ..
manvante sarvabhūmeśca pralayaḥ sa ca kalpakaḥ .. 78 ..
3.4.d:
युगांते कर्मभूमेश्च लयः कल्पः स वै स्मृतः ॥
मन्वन्ते सर्वभूमेश्च प्रलयः स च कल्पकः ॥ 78 ॥
3.4.m:
At the end of an age, there is the dissolution of the land of religious action; that is indeed remembered as a kalpa.
At the end of a Manu's period, there is a cosmic dissolution of the entire earth, and that is a minor kalpa.

3.4.s:
purāṇa puruṣasyaiva dinānte pralayo hi yaḥ ..
mukhyakalpaḥ sa vai jñeyaḥ sarvalokavināśakaḥ .. 79 ..
3.4.d:
पुराण पुरुषस्यैव दिनान्ते प्रलयो हि यः ॥
मुख्यकल्पः स वै ज्ञेयः सर्वलोकविनाशकः ॥ 79 ॥
3.4.m:
The dissolution that occurs at the end of the day of the Ancient Person—
that is to be known as the primary kalpa, destroying all worlds.

3.4.s:
ṣaḍviṃśatkalpasāhasrairmahākalpo hi yaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
yadā purāṇapuruṣo meṣarāśau samāsthitaḥ ..3.4.25.80..
3.4.d:
षड्विंशत्कल्पसाहस्रैर्महाकल्पो हि यः स्मृतः ॥
यदा पुराणपुरुषो मेषराशौ समास्थितः ॥3.4.25.80॥
3.4.m:
By twenty-six thousand kalpas, a mahākalpa is indeed remembered.
When the Ancient Person stood in the sign of Aries,

3.4.s:
tadā brahmā suraiḥ sārddhaṃ bhūpaṃ svāyaṃbhuvaṃ gataḥ ..
yadā purāṇapuruṣo makare ca samāgataḥ ..81..
3.4.d:
तदा ब्रह्मा सुरैः सार्द्धं भूपं स्वायंभुवं गतः ॥
यदा पुराणपुरुषो मकरे च समागतः ॥81॥
3.4.m:
then Brahmā, together with the gods, went to King Svāyambhuva.
When the Ancient Person arrived in Capricorn,

3.4.s:
svāyaṃbhuvamanormadhye vārāho'bhūtsa vai bhuvi ..
yadā purāṇapuruṣo gataḥ siṃhe svakecchayā .. 82 ..
3.4.d:
स्वायंभुवमनोर्मध्ये वाराहोऽभूत्स वै भुवि ॥
यदा पुराणपुरुषो गतः सिंहे स्वकेच्छया ॥ 82 ॥
3.4.m:
in the midst of the Manu Svāyambhuva, he became the Boar on earth.
When the Ancient Person went into Leo by his own will,

3.4.s:
svārociṣamanorante nṛsiṃho'bhūtsa vai bhuvi ..
yadā purāṇapuruṣo vṛṣarāśau samāsthitaḥ .. 83 ..
3.4.d:
स्वारोचिषमनोरन्ते नृसिंहोऽभूत्स वै भुवि ॥
यदा पुराणपुरुषो वृषराशौ समास्थितः ॥ 83 ॥
3.4.m:
at the end of the Manu Svārociṣa, he became the Man-Lion on earth.
When the Ancient Person stood in the sign of Taurus,

3.4.s:
tadauttamamanormadhye rudro'bhūtsagaṇo bhuvi ..
yadā purāṇapuruṣo mīnarāśau samāsthitaḥ .. 84 ..
3.4.d:
तदौत्तममनोर्मध्ये रुद्रोऽभूत्सगणो भुवि ॥
यदा पुराणपुरुषो मीनराशौ समास्थितः ॥ 84 ॥
3.4.m:
then, in the midst of the Manu Auttama, Rudra arose on earth with his attendants.
When the Ancient Person stood in the sign of Pisces,

3.4.s:
tāmasānte'bhavanmatsyaḥ sa vai bhuvi sanātanaḥ ..
yadā purāṇapuruṣo yugmarāśau samāsthitaḥ .. 85 ..
3.4.d:
तामसान्तेऽभवन्मत्स्यः स वै भुवि सनातनः ॥
यदा पुराणपुरुषो युग्मराशौ समास्थितः ॥ 85 ॥
3.4.m:
at the end of Tāmasa, he, the eternal one, became the Fish on earth.
When the Ancient Person stood in the sign of Gemini,

3.4.s:
vaivasvatamanormadhye kṛṣṇobhūdbhuvi sa prabhuḥ ..
yadā purāṇapuruṣaḥ karkarāśau samāsthitaḥ .. 86 ..
3.4.d:
वैवस्वतमनोर्मध्ये कृष्णोभूद्भुवि स प्रभुः ॥
यदा पुराणपुरुषः कर्कराशौ समास्थितः ॥ 86 ॥
3.4.m:
in the midst of the Manu Vaivasvata, he, the Lord, became Kṛṣṇa on earth.
When the Ancient Person stood in the sign of Cancer,

3.4.s:
raivatānte'bhavatkūrmaḥ sa vai bhuvi sanātanaḥ ..
yadā purāṇapuruṣaḥ kanyārāśau samāsthitaḥ .. 87 ..
3.4.d:
रैवतान्तेऽभवत्कूर्मः स वै भुवि सनातनः ॥
यदा पुराणपुरुषः कन्याराशौ समास्थितः ॥ 87 ॥
3.4.m:
at the end of Raivata, he, the eternal one, became the Tortoise on earth.
When the Ancient Person stood in the sign of Virgo,

3.4.s:
cākṣuṣānte jāmadagnyo'bhavadrāmaḥ sa vai bhuvi ..
yadā purāṇapuruṣaḥ prāpto'lau ca svakecchayā .. 88 ..
3.4.d:
चाक्षुषान्ते जामदग्न्योऽभवद्रामः स वै भुवि ॥
यदा पुराणपुरुषः प्राप्तोऽलौ च स्वकेच्छया ॥ 88 ॥
3.4.m:
at the end of Cākṣuṣa, he became Rāma Jāmadagnya on earth.
When the Ancient Person reached Scorpio by his own will,

3.4.s:
vaivasvatamanorādau vāmano'bhūtsa vai bhuvi ..
yadā purāṇapuruṣastulārāśau samāsthitaḥ .. 89 ..
3.4.d:
वैवस्वतमनोरादौ वामनोऽभूत्स वै भुवि ॥
यदा पुराणपुरुषस्तुलाराशौ समास्थितः ॥ 89 ॥
3.4.m:
at the beginning of the Manu Vaivasvata, he became the Dwarf on earth.
When the Ancient Person stood in the sign of Libra,

3.4.s:
vaivasvatamanormadhye kalkī nāmnāhamāgataḥ ..
yadā purāṇapuruṣaḥ kumbharāśau samāsthitaḥ ..3.4.25.90..
3.4.d:
वैवस्वतमनोर्मध्ये कल्की नाम्नाहमागतः ॥
यदा पुराणपुरुषः कुम्भराशौ समास्थितः ॥3.4.25.90॥
3.4.m:
in the midst of the Manu Vaivasvata, I arrived under the name Kalkī.
When the Ancient Person stood in the sign of Aquarius,

3.4.s:
sāvarṇikādau bhavitā buddho nāmnā sa vai bhuvi ..
yadā purāṇapuruṣo dhanurāśau samāsthitaḥ .. 91 ..
3.4.d:
सावर्णिकादौ भविता बुद्धो नाम्ना स वै भुवि ॥
यदा पुराणपुरुषो धनुराशौ समास्थितः ॥ 91 ॥
3.4.m:
at the beginning of Sāvarṇika, he will be on earth under the name Buddha.
When the Ancient Person stood in the sign of Sagittarius,

3.4.s:
vaivasvatamanormadhye rāmo dāśarathirbhuvi ..
yadā purāṇapuruṣo nakrarāśau samāsthitaḥ .. 92 ..
3.4.d:
वैवस्वतमनोर्मध्ये रामो दाशरथिर्भुवि ॥
यदा पुराणपुरुषो नक्रराशौ समास्थितः ॥ 92 ॥
3.4.m:
[he was] Rāma, son of Daśaratha, on earth in the midst of the Manu Vaivasvata.
When the Ancient Person stood in the sign of Capricorn,

3.4.s:
sarvapūjyāvatāraśca na bhavedvai kadācana ..
asmiṃścaturyuge devāḥ purāṇapuruṣasya hi .. 93 ..
3.4.d:
सर्वपूज्यावतारश्च न भवेद्वै कदाचन ॥
अस्मिंश्चतुर्युगे देवाः पुराणपुरुषस्य हि ॥ 93 ॥
3.4.m:
an incarnation worshipped by all would never occur.
In this four-age cycle, O gods, of the Ancient Person

3.4.s:
trayo'vatārāḥ kathitāstathā nānyaccaturyuge ..
tretāyāḥ prathame pāde rāmo dāśarathiḥ prabhuḥ .. 94 ..
3.4.d:
त्रयोऽवताराः कथितास्तथा नान्यच्चतुर्युगे ॥
त्रेतायाः प्रथमे पादे रामो दाशरथिः प्रभुः ॥ 94 ॥
3.4.m:
three incarnations are spoken of, and not so in any other four-age cycle:
in the first quarter of the Tretā, the lord Rāma, son of Daśaratha;

3.4.s:
dvāparasya tathā kṛṣṇaḥ śeṣeṇa saha vai bhuvi..
kaleśśeṣe tathāhaṃ vai dvātriṃśābdasahasrake .. 95 ..
3.4.d:
द्वापरस्य तथा कृष्णः शेषेण सह वै भुवि॥
कलेश्शेषे तथाहं वै द्वात्रिंशाब्दसहस्रके ॥ 95 ॥
3.4.m:
in the Dvāpara, likewise Kṛṣṇa together with Śeṣa on earth;
and likewise I, at the end of Kali, in the thirty-second thousandth year.

3.4.s:
ataḥ khaṃḍaḥ pavitro'yaṃ nṛṇāṃ pātakanāśanaḥ ..
imaṃ caturyugaṃ khaṇḍaṃ yaḥ paṭhecchrāvayecca yaḥ .. 96 ..
3.4.d:
अतः खंडः पवित्रोऽयं नृणां पातकनाशनः ॥
इमं चतुर्युगं खण्डं यः पठेच्छ्रावयेच्च यः ॥ 96 ॥
3.4.m:
Therefore this section is holy, destroying the sins of men.
Whoever recites or causes to be heard this section of the four-age cycle,

3.4.s:
janma prabhṛti pāpāni tasya naśyaṃti nānyathā ..
iti vaḥ kathitaṃ devā mahākalpacaritrakam .. 97..
3.4.d:
जन्म प्रभृति पापानि तस्य नश्यंति नान्यथा ॥
इति वः कथितं देवा महाकल्पचरित्रकम् ॥ 97॥
3.4.m:
his sins from birth onwards are destroyed, not otherwise.
Thus has been told to you, O gods, the history of the mahākalpa.

3.4.s:
dvitīyo yo mahākalpo viṣṇukalpaḥ sa vai smṛtaḥ ..
tatkathā paṭhitā devā viṣṇupaurāṇikairnaraiḥ .. 98 ..
3.4.d:
द्वितीयो यो महाकल्पो विष्णुकल्पः स वै स्मृतः ॥
तत्कथा पठिता देवा विष्णुपौराणिकैर्नरैः ॥ 98 ॥
3.4.m:
The second mahākalpa is remembered as the Viṣṇukalpa;
its story has been recited, O gods, by men versed in the Viṣṇu Purāṇa.

3.4.s:
śatakoṭipravistāro viṣṇupaurāṇikasya vai ..
tatraiva ca mahākalpo viṣṇornābhisamudbhavaḥ .. .. 99 ..
3.4.d:
शतकोटिप्रविस्तारो विष्णुपौराणिकस्य वै ॥
तत्रैव च महाकल्पो विष्णोर्नाभिसमुद्भवः ॥ ॥ 99 ॥
3.4.m:
The extent of the Viṣṇu Purāṇa is one hundred crores [of verses];
and in that very [Purāṇa is described] the mahākalpa arising from the navel of Viṣṇu.

3.4.s:
pūrvārddhādbhagavānbrahmā .sarvadevasamanvitaḥ ..
parārddhādbhagavānviṣṇuḥ purāṇapuruṣaḥ sa vai .. 3.4.25.100 ..
3.4.d:
पूर्वार्द्धाद्भगवान्ब्रह्मा ।सर्वदेवसमन्वितः ॥
परार्द्धाद्भगवान्विष्णुः पुराणपुरुषः स वै ॥ 3.4.25.100 ॥
3.4.m:
From its first half [comes] the Lord Brahmā, accompanied by all the gods;
from its second half, the Lord Viṣṇu, who is indeed the Ancient Person.

3.4.s:
tṛtīyo yo mahākalpaḥ śivakalpaḥ sa vai smṛtaḥ ..
śivapūrvārddhato jāto viṣṇustasmādvidhiḥ svayam .. 101 ..
3.4.d:
तृतीयो यो महाकल्पः शिवकल्पः स वै स्मृतः ॥
शिवपूर्वार्द्धतो जातो विष्णुस्तस्माद्विधिः स्वयम् ॥ 101 ॥
3.4.m:
The third mahākalpa is remembered as the Śivakalpa;
from the first half of Śiva, Viṣṇu was born, [and] from him, the Creator himself.

3.4.s:
śatakoṭipravistāraḥ śivapaurāṇikaiḥ smṛtaḥ ..
caturtho yo mahākalpaḥ padma kalpaḥ sa vai smṛtaḥ .. 102 ..
3.4.d:
शतकोटिप्रविस्तारः शिवपौराणिकैः स्मृतः ॥
चतुर्थो यो महाकल्पः पद्म कल्पः स वै स्मृतः ॥ 102 ॥
3.4.m: Extending across a hundred million [verses], it is recalled by the Śaiva mythologists. / The fourth great kalpa is remembered as the Padma-kalpa.

3.4.s:
gaṇeśastatra bhagavānpurāṇapuruṣāsane ..
gaṇeśādabhavadrudro rudrādviṣṇuḥ surottamaḥ .. 103 ..
3.4.d:
गणेशस्तत्र भगवान्पुराणपुरुषासने ॥
गणेशादभवद्रुद्रो रुद्राद्विष्णुः सुरोत्तमः ॥ 103 ॥
3.4.m: There the Lord Gaṇeśa sat on the seat of the ancient Puruṣa. / From Gaṇeśa arose Rudra; from Rudra, Viṣṇu, the best of gods.

3.4.s:
viṣṇornābhisamudbhūtaḥ parameṣṭhī pitāmahaḥ ..
kalpekalpe kramādādau devāścāsansamaṃtataḥ ..104..
3.4.d:
विष्णोर्नाभिसमुद्भूतः परमेष्ठी पितामहः ॥
कल्पेकल्पे क्रमादादौ देवाश्चासन्समंततः ॥104॥
3.4.m: From Viṣṇu's navel was born the grandfather, Parameṣṭhin. / In each kalpa, successively at the beginning, the gods emerged all around.

3.4.s:
paṃcamo yo mahākalpo vāyukalpaḥ sa vai smṛtaḥ ..
maheṃdrastatra bhagavānpurāṇa puruṣāsane .. 105 ..
3.4.d:
पंचमो यो महाकल्पो वायुकल्पः स वै स्मृतः ॥
महेंद्रस्तत्र भगवान्पुराण पुरुषासने ॥ 105 ॥
3.4.m: The fifth great kalpa is remembered as the Vāyu-kalpa. / There the Lord Mahendra sat on the seat of the ancient Puruṣa.

3.4.s:
mahendrādabhavatprāpto maheṃdrādiṃdriyāṇi ca ..
indriyebhyaśca taddevāsteṣāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu ..106..
3.4.d:
महेन्द्रादभवत्प्राप्तो महेंद्रादिंद्रियाणि च ॥
इन्द्रियेभ्यश्च तद्देवास्तेषां नामानि मे शृणु ॥106॥
3.4.m: From Mahendra came forth [life], and from Mahendra arose the senses. / And from the senses came their presiding deities; hear their names from me:

3.4.s:
śanirbudho raviḥ śukro viśva karmā bṛhaspatiḥ ..
indro viṣṇustathā brahmā rudraḥ somaḥ kramātsmṛtāḥ ..107..
3.4.d:
शनिर्बुधो रविः शुक्रो विश्व कर्मा बृहस्पतिः ॥
इन्द्रो विष्णुस्तथा ब्रह्मा रुद्रः सोमः क्रमात्स्मृताः ॥107॥
3.4.m: Saturn, Mercury, the Sun, Venus, Viśvakarman, and Jupiter, / Indra, Viṣṇu, Brahmā, Rudra, and Soma are enumerated in order.

3.4.s:
sṛṣṭikartā sa vai brahmā liṅgendriyasamudbhavaḥ .
sṛṣṭipātā sa vai viṣṇuravatāripadodbhavaḥ . . 108
3.4.d:
सृष्टिकर्ता स वै ब्रह्मा लिङ्गेन्द्रियसमुद्भवः ।
सृष्टिपाता स वै विष्णुरवतारिपदोद्भवः ॥ 108
3.4.m: Brahmā is the creator of the cosmos, born from the organ of generation; / Viṣṇu is the protector of the cosmos, born from the realm of incarnations.

3.4.s:
caturviṃśatitattveṣu kalpekalpe prabhurgataḥ .
sanatkumāro haṃsaśca vārāho nāradastathā . . 109
3.4.d:
चतुर्विंशतितत्त्वेषु कल्पेकल्पे प्रभुर्गतः ।
सनत्कुमारो हंसश्च वाराहो नारदस्तथा ॥ 109
3.4.m: Across the twenty-four cosmic principles, in every kalpa the Lord walked: / Sanatkumāra, Haṃsa, the Boar, and Nārada,

3.4.s:
nārāyaṇau ca kapilātreyau yajñāśvakaṇṭakau .
vṛṣabhaśca pṛthurmatsyaḥ kūrmo dhanvantaristathā . . 3.4.25.110
3.4.d:
नारायणौ च कपिलात्रेयौ यज्ञाश्वकण्टकौ ।
वृषभश्च पृथुर्मत्स्यः कूर्मो धन्वन्तरिस्तथा ॥ 3.4.25.110
3.4.m: both Nārāyaṇas, Kapila, Ātreya, Yajña, and Aśvakaṇṭaka, / Vṛṣabha, Pṛthu, the Fish, the Tortoise, and Dhanvantari,

3.4.s:
mohinī ca nṛsiṃhaśca vāmano bhārgavastathā .
rāmo vyāso balaḥ kṛṣṇo buddhaḥ kalkī svatattvagaḥ . . 111
3.4.d:
मोहिनी च नृसिंहश्च वामनो भार्गवस्तथा ।
रामो व्यासो बलः कृष्णो बुद्धः कल्की स्वतत्त्वगः ॥ 111
3.4.m: Mohinī, the Man-Lion, the Dwarf, the Bhārgava, / Rāma, Vyāsa, Bala, Kṛṣṇa, the Buddha, and Kalkin, walking within his own reality.

3.4.s:
guhyajanmā mahādevaḥ sṛṣṭidaityavināśakaḥ .
evaṃ jātāstrayo devā mahākalpe ca pañcame . . 112
3.4.d:
गुह्यजन्मा महादेवः सृष्टिदैत्यविनाशकः ।
एवं जातास्त्रयो देवा महाकल्पे च पञ्चमे ॥ 112
3.4.m: Mahādeva, whose birth is mysterious, is the destroyer of creation and demons. / In this way the three gods arose in the fifth great kalpa.

3.4.s:
ṣaṣṭho yastu mahākalpo vahnikalpaḥ sa vai smṛtaḥ .
skandastatraiva bhagavānpurāṇapuruṣāsane . . 113
3.4.d:
षष्ठो यस्तु महाकल्पो वह्निकल्पः स वै स्मृतः ।
स्कन्दस्तत्रैव भगवान्पुराणपुरुषासने ॥ 113
3.4.m: The sixth great kalpa is remembered as the Vahni-kalpa. / There the Lord Skanda sat on the seat of the ancient Puruṣa.

3.4.s:
puruṣāvyayataḥ skannaḥ skandastasmānmahārcimān .
sūryarūpā mahārciryā tasyāṃ jāto hariḥ svayam . . 114
3.4.d:
पुरुषाव्ययतः स्कन्नः स्कन्दस्तस्मान्महार्चिमान् ।
सूर्यरूपा महार्चिर्या तस्यां जातो हरिः स्वयम् ॥ 114
3.4.m: Emitted from the imperishable Puruṣa, Skanda became possessed of great radiance. / In the great radiance having the form of the sun, Hari was born himself.

3.4.s:
vahnirūpā mahārciryā tasyāṃ jātaḥ pitāmahaḥ .
candrarūpā mahārciryā tasyāṃ jātaḥ sa vai haraḥ . . 115
3.4.d:
वह्निरूपा महार्चिर्या तस्यां जातः पितामहः ।
चन्द्ररूपा महार्चिर्या तस्यां जातः स वै हरः ॥ 115
3.4.m: In the great radiance having the form of fire, the Grandfather was born; / in the great radiance having the form of the moon, Hara was born.

3.4.s:
ṛṣayo munayo varṇā lokā jātāḥ pitāmahāt .
ādityā viśvavasavastuṣitā bhāsvarānilāḥ . . 116
3.4.d:
ऋषयो मुनयो वर्णा लोका जाताः पितामहात् ।
आदित्या विश्ववसवस्तुषिता भास्वरानिलाः ॥ 116
3.4.m: From the Grandfather were born the seers, sages, castes, and worlds. / The Ādityas, Viśves, Vasus, Tuṣitas, Bhāsvaras, and Anilas,

3.4.s:
mahārājikasādhyāśca devā viṣṇusamudbhavāḥ .
yakṣarākṣasagandharvāḥ piśācāḥ kinnarādayaḥ . . 117
3.4.d:
महाराजिकसाध्याश्च देवा विष्णुसमुद्भवाः ।
यक्षराक्षसगन्धर्वाः पिशाचाः किन्नरादयः ॥ 117
3.4.m: the Mahārājikas and Sādhyas—these gods were born from Viṣṇu. / The yakṣas, rākṣasas, gandharvas, piśācas, kinnaras, and so on,

3.4.s:
daityāśca dānavā bhūtāstāmasā rudrasambhavāḥ .
kalpe kalpe samudbhūtamevaṃ brahmāṇḍagocare . . 118
3.4.d:
दैत्याश्च दानवा भूतास्तामसा रुद्रसम्भवाः ।
कल्पे कल्पे समुद्भूतमेवं ब्रह्माण्डगोचरे ॥ 118
3.4.m: the daityas, dānavas, and ghosts, of tamasic nature, originated from Rudra. / In this way, creation appeared in the range of the cosmic egg in kalpa after kalpa.

3.4.s:
saptamo yo mahākalpaḥ sa vai brahmāṇḍakalpakaḥ .
pāvakastatra bhagavānpurāṇapuruṣāsane . . 119
3.4.d:
सप्तमो यो महाकल्पः स वै ब्रह्माण्डकल्पकः ।
पावकस्तत्र भगवान्पुराणपुरुषासने ॥ 119
3.4.m: The seventh great kalpa is indeed the Brahmāṇḍa-kalpa. / There the Lord Pāvaka sat on the seat of the ancient Puruṣa.

3.4.s:
acintyatejasastasmātpuruṣādvahnirudbhavaḥ .
tato jāto mahābdhiśca tasmājjātaṃ virāṇmayam . . 3.4.25.120
3.4.d:
अचिन्त्यतेजसस्तस्मात्पुरुषाद्वह्निरुद्भवः ।
ततो जातो महाब्धिश्च तस्माज्जातं विराण्मयम् ॥ 3.4.25.120
3.4.m: From that Puruṣa of unimaginable splendor, fire arose; / from that the great ocean was born, and from that arose the cosmic body (virāj).

3.4.s:
romṇi romṇi tatastasya brahmāṇḍāḥ koṭiśo'bhavan .
brahmāṇḍādabhavadbrahmā sarvalokapitāmahaḥ . . 121
3.4.d:
रोम्णि रोम्णि ततस्तस्य ब्रह्माण्डाः कोटिशोऽभवन् ।
ब्रह्माण्डादभवद्ब्रह्मा सर्वलोकपितामहः ॥ 121
